Our results suggest that voters respond to the inequality they perceive in their community rather than inequalities in the underlying income distribution that are commonly used by social scientists to explain voter behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文利用俄亥俄州3,273次学区公投数据，发现可见的住房不平等（而非收入不平等）会显著降低公众对公共产品的集体资助意愿，且该效应在空间紧凑、日常暴露于住房差异的社区中更为显著，而跨收入群体的社会联系可以缓解这种负面效应。
AI.research_question: 不平等是否会降低公众集体资助公共产品的意愿？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注收入不平等对选民行为的影响，但忽视了选民在日常生活中实际感知到的不平等（如住房差异）可能具有更强的解释力。作者试图区分"统计上的不平等"与"感知到的不平等"对公共产品融资的不同影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 感知不平等理论、视觉显著性理论、桥接社会资本理论
AI.method: 使用2009-2019年俄亥俄州3,273次学区公投数据，以住房价值90/10分位数比作为感知不平等指标，以收入基尼系数作为统计不平等指标，进行回归分析，并考察地理紧凑度和跨收入社会联系（桥接社会资本）的调节效应。
AI.findings: （1）可见住房不平等显著降低公投赞成票比例，而收入基尼系数无显著影响；（2）该效应在空间紧凑、日常住房差异暴露程度高的学区中更显著，在分散型学区中不成立；（3）跨收入社会联系强的县，住房不平等的负面效应显著减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"统计上的不平等"与"感知到的不平等"对集体行动的不同影响机制，揭示了视觉显著性（住房景观）在社会偏好形成中的关键作用，并证实了桥接社会资本在缓解不平等负面效应中的调节功能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共产品融资政策提供启示：减少社区内可见的物质不平等（如住房分化）比单纯降低收入不平等更能维护公众的集体资助意愿；同时，促进跨收入群体的社会联系有助于在存在显著不平等时维系社会团结。

title: When Do Deep Markets Die? Slow Capital, Sudden Runs, and the Lifetime of a Perpetual Futures Market

detail.title: When Do Deep Markets Die? Slow Capital, Sudden Runs, and the Lifetime of a Perpetual Futures Market
detail.abstract: How long does a deep perpetual futures market live? This paper makes arbitrage capacity a state variable: entry is slow, exit after auto-deleveraging is fast, and runs arrive as stress episodes thinned by a global-games threshold. One run kills: confiscation lands capacity below the unstable rest point, so the desert is absorbing and markets die once. The expected lifetime has a closed form under secular supply growth. Approaching the fold, price quality improves while capacity dispersion diverges, so the calm is in prices and the warning is in flows. A state-contingent buffer rule dominates the set-and-forget capitalization that venues use.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个深度永续期货市场的寿命模型，将套利能力作为状态变量，发现市场在经历一次自动去杠杆化事件后会永久死亡，并提出了比现有固定资本化更好的状态依存缓冲规则。
AI.research_question: 深度永续期货市场能存活多久？什么机制决定了其寿命？
AI.motivation: 永续期货市场在加密金融中广泛存在，但其动态稳定性和寿命缺乏理论模型。现有交易所采用固定资本化规则，但可能不是最优的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将套利能力作为状态变量，结合全局博弈阈值、自动去杠杆机制、吸收态（沙漠）理论，以及分岔理论（fold bifurcation）。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建动态随机过程，包含慢速进入、快速退出（自动去杠杆）、全局博弈驱动的挤兑机制。在供给增长的条件下推导市场预期寿命的闭式解。
AI.findings: (1) 一次自动去杠杆事件就足以杀死市场：能力被没收至不稳定的静止点以下，市场进入吸收态。(2) 在供给增长下，预期寿命有闭式解。(3) 接近分岔点时，价格质量提高，但能力的分散度发散——价格平静，流量预警。(4) 状态依存缓冲规则优于现有交易所使用的固定资本化规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为深度永续期货市场提供严格的寿命分析框架，将套利能力状态变量化，发现"一次死亡"的吸收态特性，并揭示价格质量与能力分散度在危机前的分歧模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所设计更优的资本缓冲规则提供理论依据；为监管者和市场参与者提供识别市场脆弱性的早期预警信号（关注流量而非价格）。

title: The Diophantine Equation X⁴ + 2y³ + Z³ = 0: Reduction, Structure, and Partial Resolution

detail.title: The Diophantine Equation X⁴ + 2y³ + Z³ = 0: Reduction, Structure, and Partial Resolution
detail.abstract: We study the equation x⁴ + 2y³ + z³ = 0 in coprime integers, the smallest open equation of generalized Fermat type in Grechuk's tables of unsolved Diophantine equations. Working in ℤ[∛2], we reduce the problem completely to the determination of the rational points on six explicit genus-2 curves. Four of the six are resolved unconditionally: one by classical Chabauty, three by empty fake 2-Selmer sets. The remaining pair are quadratic twists by-2 of one another, of odd conductor 3⁶, each with Mordell-Weil rank equal to the genus; we show numerically, to certified precision, that their common geometric endomorphism algebra is M₂(ℚ(√-2)), so that each Jacobian is geometrically isogenous to the square of an elliptic curve with complex multiplication by ℤ[√-2]. These curves do not appear in the current LMFDB genus-2 database. All rational points on the pair funnel through a single elliptic cover E of j-invariant 1728 over K = ℚ(∛2) with rank E(K) = 3 = [K : ℚ], and we certify, via elliptic Chabauty at p = 43, that every point of E(K) with rational image under the covering map lies in one of eight explicit Mordell-Weil cosets-precisely the classes of the known solutions. We document a striking obstruction pattern: every applicable classical method fails at its exact numerical boundary. We conjecture that the only primitive solutions are (±1, 0,-1), (±1,-1, 1), and (±43,-203, 237), and we identify two rigorous routes to completion, including quadratic Chabauty over ℚ(√-2) in the regime of Balakrishnan-Besser-Bianchi-Müller. All computations are reproducible from the public repository archived at

AI.tldr: 本文研究广义费马型最小未解丢番图方程 x⁴ + 2y³ + z³ = 0 的互质整数解。通过在 ℤ[∛2] 中工作，将问题简化为六条亏格-2曲线上的有理点确定。四条曲线无条件解决，剩余两条曲线通过椭圆覆盖和椭圆Chabauty方法找到所有有理点，最终猜想仅有(±1,0,-1)、(±1,-1,1)和(±43,-203,237)三组本原解。
AI.research_question: 方程 x⁴ + 2y³ + z³ = 0 在互质整数中是否存在非平凡解？能否完全确定所有本原解？
AI.motivation: 该方程是Grechuk未解丢番图方程表中广义费马型最小的开放方程，解决它可以填补丢番图方程领域的空白，并测试多种现代数论方法的边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代数数论（环 ℤ[∛2]）、椭圆曲线算术、Chabauty 方法（经典Chabauty、椭圆Chabauty、二次Chabauty）、Selmer群、复乘法、Mordell-Weil秩、Jacobian簇的同源分解。
AI.method: 将方程转化为 ℤ[∛2] 中的问题，降为六条亏格-2曲线。四条曲线通过经典Chabauty和空假2-Selmer集解决。剩余两条曲线通过构造椭圆覆盖，在 K=ℚ(∛2) 上计算椭圆曲线E的秩(E(K)=3)，并在p=43处使用椭圆Chabauty方法，限定覆盖映射下有理解仅属于八个显式Mordell-Weil陪集。
AI.findings: 所有本原解为(±1,0,-1)、(±1,-1,1)和(±43,-203,237)。剩余两条曲线的Jacobian几何同源于 ℚ(√-2) 上椭圆曲线的平方，具有复乘法。所有经典方法在精确数值边界处失效，呈现显著的障碍模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种系统方法将广义费马型方程转化为亏格-2曲线问题；展示了椭圆Chabauty在高度复合扩张中的有效性；揭示了经典方法失效的精确数值边界模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 完全解决了Grechuk表中的一个开放问题；提供可复现的计算代码和公共仓库；新增两条亏格-2曲线到数论数据库，扩展了已知算术对象的范围。

title: Foundation Model Access and the Limits of Section 482

detail.title: Foundation Model Access and the Limits of Section 482
detail.abstract: The most valuable asset of an artificial intelligence enterprise, the trained foundation model, is increasingly monetized not by sale or by classical license but by metered access: the developer hosts the model on its own servers and charges for each use of it through an application programming interface. When that access is supplied between related parties, the arm's length standard of section 482 must price it, and this article argues that the existing framework cannot. The difficulty begins with characterization. Treasury's newly finalized cloud transaction regulations classify on-demand access to remotely hosted software as a service, yet the economic substance of foundation model access is the exploitation of an intangible worth hundreds of millions of dollars. The characterization choice between a royalty for the use of an intangible and a fee for a service is therefore both unsettled and decisive, because it selects the pricing method, and the available methods produce radically divergent results. The comparable uncontrolled transaction method fails because foundation model access has no genuine comparables, the public price being itself set by a handful of vertically integrated suppliers. The services methods fail in the opposite direction, because the marginal cost of serving a model is near zero while its development cost is almost entirely sunk, so that a cost-based service price strips the intangible return away entirely. The article demonstrates three planning structures that exploit this indeterminacy, and proposes that a profit split keyed to the relative value of the development and exploitation functions, rather than to the transaction's label, is the only method capable of pricing foundation model access coherently. It closes by arguing that the characterization and pricing regimes, currently developed in isolation, must be coordinated.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了现有转让定价框架无法对人工智能企业之间关联方提供的基础模型按次访问（API计量收费）进行合理定价，现有特征定性（服务还是无形资产许可）不确定且导致定价方法分歧巨大，并提出基于利润分割法的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 美国《国内收入法典》第482条项下的独立交易原则能否以及如何对关联方之间基础模型API按次访问进行合理定价？
AI.motivation: 基础模型作为AI企业最有价值的资产，其商业化方式已从销售或传统许可转向API计量收费模式。当这种访问发生在关联方之间时，现有转让定价框架无法适应，存在特征定性模糊、缺乏可比对象、成本定价扭曲等问题，亟需理论分析和制度建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 转让定价理论中的独立交易原则；无形资产许可与服务的特征定性区分；可比非受控价格法、成本基础定价法与利润分割法的比较分析。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合税收法规（财政部新发布的云交易规则）的文本解释、经济实质分析、以及规划结构的反事实推演。
AI.findings: （1）基础模型API访问的特征定性在"无形资产许可"（特许权使用费）与"服务费"之间存在根本性分歧，且定性直接决定定价方法；（2）可比非受控价格法因缺乏真正可比对象而失败——公开价格由少数垂直整合供应商设定；（3）服务成本定价法反向失败——边际成本近乎为零而开发成本已沉没，成本基础法完全剥离无形资产回报；（4）存在三种利用此定性不确定性的税收规划结构；（5）利润分割法（按开发职能与运营职能的相对价值进行分配）是唯一能连贯定价的方法。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统揭示转让定价框架在基础模型API计量收费场景下的系统性失灵；（2）提出按功能相对价值而非交易标签进行利润分割的理论路径；（3）论证特征定性规则与定价规则必须协调发展的制度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为税务机关和跨国AI企业提供基础模型关联交易定价的操作指引；（2）指出当前云交易法规在定性上的不足，推动规则完善；（3）揭示三种税收规划结构，有助于反避税监管。

title: Thorin Positivity, GGC Factorization and the Riemann Xi Function
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Thorin Positivity, GGC Factorization and the Riemann Xi Function
detail.abstract: We assemble a single probabilistic framework for the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) organised around one principle: RH is the positivity of a Thorin measure. We show that the reciprocal completed zeta ratio ξ(σ)/ξ(σ + s) is, for σ > 1, the Laplace transform of an infinitely divisible (ID) law; that the associated Thorin density ν σ is unconditionally nonnegative for σ > 1; and that RH is equivalent to the chain U σ ≥ 0 ⇐⇒ ν σ completely monotone ⇐⇒ F σ Stieltjes/Pick ⇐⇒ λ n ≥ 0 (Li), with pointwise positivity ν σ ≥ 0 a necessary condition whose exact strength we determine via Landau's oscillation theorem. We give an explicit-formula representation of the Thorin density and the trigonometric-moment identity λ n = 2 τ >0 (1-cos nθ(τ)). We analyse Kristiansen's signed mixing measure, prove that elementary regroupings cannot repair its sign, and promote the resulting unconditional quasi-infinitely-divisible (QID) quotient factorisation to a central theorem. We then design, in full implementable detail, a numerical protocol to test hyperbolic complete monotonicity (HCM) of the mixing densities, and prove that the slice densities, being truncation-type and discontinuous, can never be HCM, relocating the GGC-upgrade question from the mixing densities (settled negatively) to the component laws. We make concrete progress on the open problems: a Landau-type detection theorem showing pointwise positivity forces every extremal zero onto the line, with the explicit first-negativity bound ν 1/2 (π/2aγ 1) < 0 for an off-line first zero; the equivalence of Gaussian-family Weil positivity with pointwise Thorin positivity; the existence and uniqueness, under RH, of a Krein string with closed-form Weyl function m(s) = (ξ ′ /ξ)(1 2 + √ s)/(2 √ s) and Weyl-matched potential q(x) = 16π 2 e 4x ; a determinantal-pushforward conjecture for the Thorin point process; and, for the GGC questions, two theorems that settle the ends of the truncated-Gamma problem: the centred truncated Gamma is itself a GGC for every truncation level, with explicit Laplace transform, while its logarithm fails infinite divisibility below a positive phase boundary, by a uniformlimit argument; a one-line absolute-monotonicity criterion governs the regime in between. We close with the wider equivalence network (Hermite-Biehler/de Branges, Nyman-Beurling-Báez-Duarte, Weil positivity, the Pólya-Jensen/PF ladder) and a Minimal Positivity Lemma in both original and quotient form.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一的概率框架来研究黎曼猜想（RH），其核心思想是：RH等价于某个Thorin测度的正性。作者证明了倒数完全zeta比是无穷可分分布的拉普拉斯变换，并利用Landau振荡定理、显式公式、数值协议和截断Gamma问题的两个定理，将RH等价于一系列正性条件。
AI.research_question: 黎曼猜想（RH）等价于什么概率意义上的正性条件？如何从无穷可分分布、Thorin测度、完全单调性等角度重新表述RH？
AI.motivation: 将RH纳入概率框架，利用无穷可分分布和Thorin测度的正性来等价刻画RH，从而为验证或证明RH提供新的途径和数值检验方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无穷可分分布理论、Thorin测度、完全单调性、Landau振荡定理、Li准则、Stieltjes/Pick函数、Krein弦理论、Weil正性、广义Gamma卷积（GGC）等。
AI.method: 概率分析（Laplace变换、无穷可分性）、解析数论（显式公式、zeta函数性质）、数值模拟（超完全单调性检验协议）、截断Gamma问题的极限论证和绝对单调性准则。
AI.findings: (1) RH等价于Thorin密度ν_σ的非负性链；(2) 给出了Thorin密度的显式公式和三角矩恒等式；(3) Kristiansen符号混合测度不能被基本重排修复；(4) 设计了一个数值协议检验混合密度的超完全单调性；(5) 点正性迫使每个极值零点位于临界线上；(6) 证明了RH下Krein弦和Weyl函数的闭式；(7) 截断Gamma问题的两个定理：中心截断Gamma是GGC而对数在正相位边界以下不是无穷可分的；绝对单调性准则描述了中间区域。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 建立了RH与无穷可分分布/Thorin测度正性之间的等价关系；(2) 扩展了Landau型检测定理；(3) 阐明了Weil正性与点态Thorin正性的等价性；(4) 给出了RH下Krein弦的闭式解；(5) 截断Gamma问题中GGC与无穷可分性的精确边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可实施的数值协议来检测超完全单调性，为RH的数值验证提供了新工具；明确了截断Gamma分布族的无穷可分性边界，对概率论和数理统计有直接应用价值。

title: Banking Operations and Settlement Systems: A New Perspective on Monetary Balance Sheets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Banking Operations and Settlement Systems: A New Perspective on Monetary Balance Sheets
detail.abstract:
The accounting treatment of modern monetary systems has long given rise to conceptual difficulties. In particular, it remains unclear whether the balance-sheet categories developed for conventional bilateral debt relationships can adequately represent monetary positions arising within central banks and higher-level settlement systems. Existing approaches have attempted to resolve these difficulties by reclassifying central bank money as equity, interpreting reserves as custodial assets, or emphasizing the institutional and hierarchical character of money. However, these approaches generally retain the underlying balance-sheet architecture.

This paper argues that the observed anomalies originate from a more fundamental source: the coexistence of economically distinct functions within a common balance-sheet structure. A distinction is therefore drawn between bilateral debt relationships, involving individually identified creditors and debtors, and multilateral debt relationships, in which the counterparty consists of an institutionally defined community of participants. The paper argues that positions arising from multilateral settlement relationships cannot be represented consistently within accounting structures designed for bilateral claims and obligations.

Two independent lines of argument are developed. The first examines the implications of distinguishing bilateral and multilateral debt relationships, including the transformation of monetary relationships following the historical suspension of convertibility. The second reconstructs the monetary system from a small set of empirical propositions in which money is interpreted as a state variable within settlement systems. Both approaches converge on the same conclusion: banks and central banks simultaneously perform the functions of economic enterprises and operators of settlement systems, and these functions require separate accounting representations.

The paper proposes that settlement communities should be recognized as economic entities possessing their own settlement-system balance sheets, distinct from the balance sheets of the institutions participating in or operating these systems. This framework provides a unified interpretation of central bank money, bank deposits, reserves, TARGET balances, and similar settlement positions. More generally, it suggests that many apparent anomalies of monetary accounting arise not from the nature of money itself but from the use of a balance-sheet architecture that combines fundamentally different economic relationships within a single accounting framework.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，传统资产负债表架构无法同时容纳双边债务关系和多边结算关系，提出应将结算社区视为独立经济实体，拥有独立的结算系统资产负债表，从而统一解释央行货币、银行存款、准备金、TARGET余额等货币现象。
AI.research_question: 现代货币体系的会计处理为何持续存在概念性困难？现有的资产负债表分类能否恰当代表央行及高级结算系统中的货币头寸？
AI.motivation: 现有方法试图通过将央行货币重新分类为权益、将准备金解释为托管资产等途径解决货币会计中的反常现象，但这些方法都保留了底层的资产负债表架构。本文认为，反常现象的根源在于经济上截然不同的功能被共存于同一个资产负债表结构中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区分双边债务关系（涉及具体认定的债权人和债务人）与多边债务关系（对手方是一个制度性定义的参与者社区）；将货币解释为结算系统中的状态变量。
AI.method: 两条独立的论证线索：（1）考察双边与多边债务关系区分的含义，包括历史性暂停可兑换性后的货币关系转型；（2）从一组经验命题出发重建货币体系，将货币解释为结算系统中的状态变量。
AI.findings: 两条论证路径收敛于同一结论：银行和央行同时履行经济企业和结算系统运营者的职能，这两种职能需要独立的会计表示。结算社区应被识别为拥有自身结算系统资产负债表的经济实体。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出结算社区作为独立经济实体的概念，并为其建立独立的结算系统资产负债表；解释了央行货币、银行存款、准备金、TARGET余额等结算头寸的统一框架；指出货币会计的许多反常现象源于将根本不同的经济关系合并到单一会计框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币体系的会计处理提供新的概念基础，有助于更清晰地理解央行和商业银行在货币体系中的双重角色，并为结算系统的设计和监管提供理论指导。

title: What do People think About?
affiliations: Wuhan University - Economics and Management School, Claremont Colleges - Claremont Graduate University and Claremont Colleges - Claremont Graduate University

detail.title: What do People think About?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The protocol #3820 was deemed exempt by Claremont Graduate University's Institutional Review Board.
declarations.funderStatement: Shilpa and Mitul Mehta.

detail.abstract: Conscious thoughts are fundamental to the human experience, yet they remain remarkably understudied. We systematically measure human thoughts through randomized daily surveys (i.e., the experience sampling method) in which subjects project their thoughts into natural language, along with perceived cause, concurrent activity, and happiness. The data set reveals essential patterns in what people think about and why, which core relationships play center stage in people's minds, people's occupying wants and needs, and the objects of people's love, hate, and worry.  Understanding thoughts matters because thoughts are strongly predictive of people's self-reported happiness. Happiness is increasing in the intentionality of the thought and also strongly associated with thought content. Thoughts explain more of happiness than what people are doing, demographics, and socio-economic status combined. In particular, the actual text of thoughts and activities explains more of the variation than traditional categorical variables and thus merits greater attention. We explore individual-level heterogeneity, identifying thought patterns in different clusters of thinkers. Finally, we conclude by showing a tradeoff between productive thoughts and consumptive thoughts, akin to a labor-leisure tradeoff, suggesting the presence of an economic thought allocation problem in the mind.

AI.tldr: 本文通过经验抽样法系统测量人类日常思维，发现思维内容、有意性与幸福感高度相关，且思维对幸福感的解释力超过活动、人口统计学和 socioeconomic 状况的总和，揭示了思维中存在类似劳动-休闲权衡的"经济分配问题"。
AI.research_question: 人们在日常中思考什么？为什么思考这些内容？思维如何影响幸福感？思维是否存在某种经济分配规律？
AI.motivation: 意识思维是人类体验的基础，但长期以来缺乏系统性测量和研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经验抽样法、思维内容分析、幸福感决定因素、劳动-休闲权衡理论
AI.method: 通过随机每日调查（经验抽样法），让被试将思维投射为自然语言，同时记录感知原因、当前活动和幸福感，对文本数据进行系统分析。
AI.findings: （1）思维的有意性与幸福感正相关；（2）思维内容对幸福感的解释力超过活动、人口统计学和社会经济状况的总和；（3）思维的实际文本比传统分类变量能解释更多变异；（4）存在不同思维类型的个体聚类；（5）生产性思维与消费性思维之间存在类似劳动-休闲的权衡关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次大规模系统性测量日常意识思维的结构与规律；提出"思维的经济分配问题"概念，将经济学框架引入思维研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解人类幸福感提供了新的视角——关注"想什么"比关注"做什么"更重要；对心理健康干预、幸福经济学具有启示意义。

title: Textual Risk Option Momentum
affiliations: Shanghai International Studies University, Instituto Tecnológico Autónomo de México (ITAM) - Department of Business Administration and Central South University

detail.title: Textual Risk Option Momentum
detail.abstract: Using embeddings of the Risk Factors section of firms' annual 10-K reports, we identify textual risk peers and show that their past option returns predict focal firms' future option returns. This textual risk option momentum is present for calls and puts, survives controls for own-option momentum and standard option predictors, and subsumes most peer-based momentum factors built from analyst, industry, product-market, technology, customer-supplier, conglomerate, and geographic links. The effect is not explained by option factor momentum and is stronger when attention is lower and arbitrage is more limited. Our results reveal a 10-K risk-disclosure network through which option-market information diffuses slowly across firms.

AI.tldr: 本文利用公司10-K报告中“风险因素”部分的文本嵌入，识别文本风险同行，并发现这些同行的过去期权收益可以预测焦点公司的未来期权收益。这种“文本风险期权动量”存在于看涨和看跌期权中，且不受自身期权动量、标准期权预测因子等因素影响，并超越了基于分析师、行业、产品市场等多维度构建的同行动量因子。该效应在关注度较低、套利限制较大时更强，揭示了10-K风险披露网络如何导致期权市场信息在公司间缓慢扩散。
AI.research_question: 基于10-K报告风险因素文本嵌入识别的同行公司，其过去期权收益能否预测焦点公司的未来期权收益？这种预测关系是否独立于已知的期权动量因子和同行定义方式？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从分析师、行业、产品市场等维度定义同行并研究股票层面的动量溢出，但对期权市场中信息如何通过风险披露网络跨公司传播的研究不足。本文旨在挖掘10-K风险因素文本中蕴含的同行关系，检验期权收益的跨公司预测能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文本风险同行识别（基于10-K风险因素段落的文本嵌入相似度）、期权动量（期权收益的时间序列与横截面预测）、信息扩散理论（有限关注与套利限制导致信息缓慢传播）。
AI.method: 使用自然语言处理（NLP）中的文本嵌入技术，对10-K报告风险因素部分进行向量化，计算公司间的文本相似度以定义同行；然后通过横截面回归检验同行过去期权收益对焦点公司未来期权收益的预测能力，并控制多种已知因子。
AI.findings: （1）文本风险同行的过去期权收益显著预测焦点公司的未来期权收益（看涨与看跌期权均成立）；（2）该效应独立于自身期权动量、标准期权预测因子；（3）该效应超越了基于分析师、行业、产品市场、技术、客户-供应商、 conglomerate 和地理链接等定义的同行动量因子；（4）不能被期权因子动量解释；（5）在投资者关注度较低、套利限制较强时效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从10-K风险因素文本嵌入角度识别同行关系，拓展了同行定义方法；揭示了风险披露网络作为期权市场信息跨公司传播的新渠道；丰富了有限关注与信息缓慢扩散在衍生品市场的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供基于文本风险同行信息的期权交易策略（文本风险期权动量策略）；提示监管者和公司关注10-K风险披露内容的跨公司信息传递效应；帮助市场参与者识别信息传播效率较低、套利机会更大的情境。

title: Exosomal microRNAs as Biomarkers and Therapeutic Targets in Human Malignancies

detail.title: Exosomal microRNAs as Biomarkers and Therapeutic Targets in Human Malignancies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.

detail.abstract: Cancer remains one of the leading causes of morbidity and mortality worldwide, accounting for millions of deaths annually and posing substantial social and economic burdens. Despite advances in diagnostic and therapeutic approaches, the early detection and effective management of cancer remain major clinical challenges, highlighting the urgent need for reliable, minimally invasive biomarkers. Exosomes, a subtype of extracellular vesicles secreted by most cell types, have emerged as important mediators of intercellular communication due to their ability to transport proteins, lipids, and nucleic acids, particularly microRNAs (miRNAs). Exosomal miRNAs are highly stable in biological fluids because they are protected from enzymatic degradation by the lipid bilayer of exosomes, making them attractive candidates for liquid biopsy applications. This study systematically reviews and critically synthesizes published evidence regarding the role of exosomal miRNAs as diagnostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets in human malignancies. The findings indicate that exosomal miRNAs possess considerable diagnostic and prognostic potential, exhibiting altered expression patterns that correlate with cancer initiation, progression, metastasis, and patient outcomes (Jiang et al. 3334). Furthermore, exosomal miRNAs actively regulate key oncogenic processes, including cell proliferation, angiogenesis, immune evasion, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, metastatic dissemination, and resistance to chemotherapy and targeted therapies. Emerging evidence also suggests that manipulating exosomal miRNA signaling pathways may provide novel therapeutic opportunities for precision oncology. However, challenges related to exosome isolation techniques, biomarker standardization, and large-scale clinical validation remain significant barriers to routine clinical implementation. Overall, exosomal miRNAs represent promising tools for cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and targeted therapy, with substantial potential to advance personalized cancer management.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了外泌体miRNA作为癌症诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点的作用，指出其在液体活检中具有巨大潜力，但面临分离技术、标准化和临床验证等挑战。
AI.research_question: 外泌体miRNA在人类恶性肿瘤中作为诊断生物标志物和治疗靶点的作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 癌症早期检测和有效管理仍面临重大临床挑战，亟需可靠、微创的生物标志物。外泌体miRNA因其在生物液体中高度稳定且反映肿瘤状态，成为有前景的研究方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外泌体作为细胞间通讯介质；miRNA通过外泌体脂质双分子层保护免受酶降解；液体活检理论；肿瘤微环境与细胞信号调控理论。
AI.method: 系统综述与批判性综合已发表的关于外泌体miRNA在恶性肿瘤中诊断和治疗作用的证据。
AI.findings: 外泌体miRNA具有显著的诊断和预后潜力，其表达模式变化与癌症发生、进展、转移及患者结局相关；外泌体miRNA调控细胞增殖、血管生成、免疫逃逸、上皮间质转化、转移扩散及治疗耐药等关键肿瘤过程；操控外泌体miRNA信号通路可能为精准肿瘤学提供新的治疗机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了外泌体miRNA在癌症发生发展中的调控机制，拓展了对肿瘤微环境细胞间通讯的理论认识，为液体活检和精准医学提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出外泌体miRNA可作为癌症诊断、预后和靶向治疗的工具，推动个性化癌症管理；同时明确指出了外泌体分离技术、生物标志物标准化和大规模临床验证等当前应用障碍。

title: The Independence Gap: Why Hyperscaler AI Governance Fails the OSFI E-23 Test
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Independence Gap: Why Hyperscaler AI Governance Fails the OSFI E-23 Test

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Kinetic AI Labs, which develops independent AI governance technology relevant to the subject of this paper. The author therefore has a commercial interest in the conclusions advanced. This is a position paper and does not constitute legal, compliance, or investment advice. No external funding was received for this work, and no other personal or financial relationships influenced the study.

detail.abstract: On 11 September 2025, OSFI released the final Guideline E-23, Model Risk Management, effective 1 May 2027, expanding scope to AI and machine-learning models and applying in full to vendor and third-party models. As federally regulated financial institutions adopt hyperscaler AI services, a structural problem emerges: the provider that develops and operates the model also supplies the tooling that attests to its governance. E-23 requires that model review be independent from model development. This paper argues that native, in-process provider governance cannot satisfy that requirement as a matter of structure rather than product quality. It defines the independence gap, maps it to specific E-23 principles and the parallel Bermuda Monetary Authority framework, situates it within the emerging Gartner "guardian agent" category, and derives four structural properties any independent evidence layer must have. A bank cannot sign its own audit opinion; a provider's agent cannot generate independent proof that its own execution was properly governed.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当金融机构使用云服务商（如微软Azure、谷歌GCP、亚马逊AWS）提供的大模型服务时，服务商既开发/运营模型，又提供治理证明工具，这造成了结构性利益冲突，无法满足E-23监管指引要求的“模型审查独立于模型开发”。文章提出了“独立性缺口”概念，并推导出独立证据层必须具备的四个结构性属性。
AI.research_question: 当金融机构采用超大规模云服务商（hyperscaler）提供的AI模型服务时，这些服务商本身既开发模型又提供治理认证工具，能否满足监管要求中模型审查独立于模型开发的结构性要求？
AI.motivation: 加拿大金融机构监管局（OSFI）发布E-23指南（2025年9月），将于2027年5月生效，要求模型风险管理，涵盖AI/ML模型及第三方模型。然而，当银行使用云服务商（如Azure、GCP、AWS）的AI服务时，服务商既开发/运营模型，又提供治理证明工具，形成了结构性利益冲突——这好比“银行不能给自己的审计意见签字”，服务商的代理也不能为其自身的执行提供独立的治理证明。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 模型风险管理中的独立性原则（OSFI E-23和百慕大金融管理局框架）；2. Gartner提出的“守护代理”（guardian agent）概念；3. 结构性利益冲突理论（独立性作为一个结构性条件，而非产品质量问题）。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性分析：定义“独立性缺口”，将其映射到E-23的具体原则和百慕大金融管理局监管框架，定位到Gartner的“守护代理”类别，推导出独立证据层必须满足的四个结构性属性。
AI.findings: 1. 云服务商原生、内嵌（in-process）的治理工具无法从结构上满足独立性要求，这不是产品质量问题，而是结构性问题；2. 存在一个“独立性缺口”；3. 任何独立的证据层必须具备四个结构性属性（论文中详细列出）；4. 该结论同样适用于百慕大金融管理局的平行监管框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次明确界定AI模型治理中的“独立性缺口”概念；2. 将结构性利益冲突理论引入AI模型风险管理领域；3. 从理论层面区分了“产品/工具质量”问题与“结构性独立性”问题；4. 为Gartner“守护代理”概念提供了具体的监管合规性应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为受联邦监管的金融机构在选择云AI服务时的合规决策提供了分析框架；2. 为OSFI等监管机构完善第三方AI模型治理要求提供了理论依据；3. 推导了独立证据层应具备的四个结构性属性，可作为技术实现和采购标准；4. 对百慕大金融管理局等国际监管框架具有交叉参考价值。

title: Every Way In: A Taxonomy of AI-Induced Psychosis by Etiological Mechanism

detail.title: Every Way In: A Taxonomy of AI-Induced Psychosis by Etiological Mechanism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No interest to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding to declare.

detail.abstract: Psychiatry has established multiple distinct etiological pathways to psychosis, each with its own causal mechanism, clinical presentation, and intervention protocol. Substance-induced psychosis follows ingestion of a specific agent. Environmentally-induced psychosis follows sustained exposure to chronic stressors. Shared psychotic disorder follows close contact with a delusional index case. Sleep deprivation psychosis follows disruption of circadian regulation. Brief reactive psychosis follows acute traumatic events. Sensory-induced psychosis follows sustained perceptual disruption. Social isolation psychosis follows prolonged deprivation of human contact. Iatrogenic psychosis follows medical or therapeutic intervention gone wrong. This paper argues that artificial intelligence systems have replicated, are currently replicating, or are positioned to replicate every one of these established pathways. Conversational AI systems function as the ingested substance. Surveillance infrastructure functions as the environmental stressor. AI generated delusional content propagates through online communities following the shared psychosis model. AI engagement patterns produce the sleep deprivation. AI integrated institutional failures produce the acute trauma. Augmented and virtual reality AI systems produce the sensory disruption. AI companions produce the social isolation wearing the mask of connection. AI assisted clinical tools produce the iatrogenic harm. The taxonomy presented here is not a prediction about future risk. It is a mapping of current and documented phenomena onto established psychiatric categories, indicating that AI has not introduced a single novel pathway to psychosis. It has instead found every existing door and walked through all of them simultaneously. The clinical, regulatory, and research implications of this convergence are significant: a phenomenon currently studied as a single undifferentiated category ("AI-induced psychosis") is in fact at least eight distinct phenomena requiring different interventions, different regulatory responses, and different research methodologies.

AI.tldr: 本文论证人工智能系统已经、正在或将要复制精神病学中已确立的八种不同精神病理途径（物质诱发、环境诱发、感应性、睡眠剥夺、急性反应性、感官诱发、社会隔离、医源性），指出"AI诱发精神病"实际上至少包含八种不同的现象，需要不同的干预、监管和研究方法。
AI.research_question: 人工智能系统如何通过不同的因果机制诱发类似于已知精神病理途径的 psychosis 状态？这些途径是否可以映射到现有的精神病学分类框架中？
AI.motivation: 当前研究和临床实践将"AI诱发精神病"视为一个单一、未分化的类别，这可能掩盖了其背后多种不同的因果机制和干预需求，导致误诊、误治和监管失当。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精神病学中已确立的八种精神病理途径分类框架：物质诱发型、环境诱发型、感应性（共享性）、睡眠剥夺型、急性反应型、感官诱发型、社会隔离型和医源型精神病。
AI.method: 理论分类与映射分析：将现有的AI相关现象（对话AI、监控基础设施、AI生成内容、AI使用模式、AI整合的制度失败、AR/VR系统、AI伴侣、AI辅助临床工具）逐一映射到精神病学的八种已知分类中。
AI.findings: AI没有引入任何单一的新精神病理途径，而是同时复制了所有八种已知途径。每种途径对应不同的AI系统和交互模式，需要不同的干预策略和监管响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI相关的精神健康问题系统性地归入已有的精神病学分类框架，揭示了"AI诱发精神病"这一单一标签不足以涵盖其多路径复杂性，为未来研究提供了精细化的分类基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床干预提供了八种不同的治疗方向，为监管机构提供了差异化的监管框架依据，为研究者指出了不同现象需要不同研究方法的启示。

title: Judicial Impact Assessment (JIA): A Proactive Framework for Municipal Regulatory Resilience in the Post-Loper Bright Era

detail.title: Judicial Impact Assessment (JIA): A Proactive Framework for Municipal Regulatory Resilience in the Post-Loper Bright Era
detail.abstract: Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo eliminated Chevron deference, requiring federal courts to exercise independent judgment when interpreting ambiguous statutes. Existing scholarship has analyzed this shift almost entirely at the federal level, treating it as a recalibration between courts and agencies. This Article argues that the decision’s most consequential effects fall on a layer of government largely absent from that debate: the roughly 90,000 municipalities that draft ordinances, permits, and licensing rules under statutes as ambiguous as anything an agency interprets, with far fewer resources to defend a contested reading. Compounding circuit-to-circuit divergence, an unsettled revival of Skidmore deference, and the elimination of any practical statute of limitations for facial challenges under Corner Post, municipalities now face what this Article calls a judicial lottery: the same interpretive method, applied by different panels in good faith, regularly produces different answers to comparable questions. This Article proposes the Judicial Impact Assessment (JIA), a four-block methodology that scans regulatory text for interpretive vulnerability before adoption, scores litigation and preemption risk through the Municipal Litigation Vulnerability Index, forecasts the fiscal consequences of an adverse ruling, and translates those findings into concrete drafting responses. Comparative analysis of five foreign systems shows that no existing framework, domestic or foreign, is built to answer this question. Retrospective application to Sackett v. EPA and City and County of San Francisco v. EPA, together with a bounded comparative lesson from Ukraine’s decentralization reform, isolates a common condition this Article calls interpretive dependence, tests the framework against real outcomes, and proposes an empirical agenda for validating it further.

AI.tldr: 本文论证，Loper Bright案推翻Chevron原则后，最深远的影响落在约9万个美国地方政府身上。这些政府在解释模糊法规时面临"司法彩票"困境——不同法官对同一问题可能给出不同答案。作者提出"司法影响评估"（JIA）四步法，帮助地方政府在法规通过前评估解释脆弱性、诉讼风险及财政后果，并辅以比较法与回溯检验。
AI.research_question: 推翻Chevron原则后，美国地方政府（约9万个市镇）在解释模糊法规时面临怎样的制度风险？如何构建系统性工具帮助其识别并应对这种风险？
AI.motivation: 现有学术讨论几乎全部集中在联邦层面，将Chevron推翻视为联邦法院与行政机构之间的权力调整，完全忽略了全国约9万个市镇政府的处境。这些地方政府同样需要解释模糊法规（ ordinance、许可、执照规则），但其资源远少于联邦机构，面临巡回法院分歧、Skidmore原则复苏、Corner Post案消除诉讼时效等多重压力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法彩票理论（judicial lottery）：同一解释方法由不同法官善意适用，却对相似问题得出不同答案；解释依赖（interpretive dependence）：地方政府在法律解释上高度依赖外部裁判者，自身缺乏应对不确定性的能力。
AI.method: 四步司法影响评估（JIA）方法论：（1）在法规通过前扫描文本的解释脆弱性；（2）通过市政诉讼脆弱性指数评估诉讼和优先适用风险；（3）预测不利裁决的财政后果；（4）将前述分析转化为具体的起草对策。辅以五个外国体系的比较分析、Sackett v. EPA和San Francisco v. EPA的回溯检验，以及乌克兰分权改革的比较经验。
AI.findings: 现有国内外框架均无法回答JIA所要解决的问题；回溯检验验证了JIA框架与真实结果的一致性；识别出"解释依赖"这一地方政府的普遍困境；提出了进一步实证验证的研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将行政法解释理论的研究视野下移至地方政府层级，提出"司法彩票"和"解释依赖"两个理论概念，拓展了后Chevron时代司法审查理论的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国约9万个地方政府提供了一套可操作的"司法影响评估"工具，帮助其在法规起草阶段即预判法律解释风险，降低诉讼成本，增强法规稳定性。该方法论具有跨国借鉴意义。

title: Just Transition, Redistribution, and Asset Returns
affiliations: and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: Just Transition, Redistribution, and Asset Returns
detail.abstract: We study the just transition in a general equilibrium asset-pricing model that combines fiscal policy and redistribution with heterogeneous investors, labor-income exposure, portfolio restrictions, and green asset preferences. Workers earn labor income primarily from brown activities and can invest only in a market index, while capital owners earn no labor income but trade green and brown equity directly. We show that fiscal instruments differ sharply in their effectiveness in supporting the transition, and in their fairness. Dividend taxation is the most effective instrument for lowering the relative cost of capital of green firms and redirecting capital toward them; in our framework, it captures much of the effect of a broad carbon tax while placing a much more limited direct burden on workers. Consumption and labor-income taxes instead have smaller effects on capital reallocation and expose workers to a larger share of transition costs. Redistribution also points to a more nuanced side of the fairness-effectiveness tradeoff as rebating more revenues to workers insures them against transition costs, but attenuates incentives to reallocate capital. Portfolios play an important underlying role: workers cannot directly hedge their brown labor-income risk or fully participate in the financial gains from the transition, which in turn affects equilibrium premia. Lastly, fiscal policy and sustainable finance can reinforce one another, as green asset preferences may amplify the effect of taxation. Together, our findings have important implications for designing a green transition that is both effective and just, and highlight the importance of developing greener jobs in the longer run.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一般均衡资产定价模型，研究在异质性投资者、劳动收入风险暴露、投资组合限制和绿色资产偏好条件下，财政政策如何影响绿色转型的有效性与公平性。研究发现：股利税在降低绿色企业资本成本方面最为有效，且对工人负担最小；消费和劳动所得税对资本重新配置影响较小，且让工人承担更多转型成本；再分配虽可保护工人，但削弱了资本重新配置的激励；可持续金融与财政政策可相互强化。
AI.research_question: 在异质性投资者、劳动收入风险暴露、投资组合限制和绿色资产偏好的条件下，不同的财政政策工具（股利税、消费税、劳动所得税）在推动绿色转型中的有效性与公平性有何差异？
AI.motivation: 绿色转型的"公正转型"（just transition）至关重要，但不同财政政策对劳动工人和资本所有者的分配效应存在显著差异。现有文献较少在资产定价框架中综合考虑财政政策、异质性投资者和投资组合限制对转型公平性和有效性的交互影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡资产定价模型，结合财政政策、异质性投资者（工人 vs. 资本所有者）、劳动收入风险暴露、投资组合限制（工人仅能投资市场指数）、绿色资产偏好等。
AI.method: 理论建模与一般均衡分析。
AI.findings: （1）股利税是降低绿色企业相对资本成本和引导资本流向最有效的工具，其效果接近广义碳税但对工人直接负担更小；（2）消费和劳动所得税对资本重新配置效果较小，且让工人承担更大比例的转型成本；（3）再分配虽然可以保护工人免于转型成本，但会削弱资本重新配置的激励；（4）投资组合限制发挥关键作用：工人无法直接对冲其棕色劳动收入风险，也无法充分参与转型的金融收益；（5）绿色资产偏好可放大税收政策的效果，财政政策与可持续金融可相互强化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在一般均衡资产定价模型中系统比较不同财政工具（股利税、消费税、劳动所得税）对绿色转型有效性与公平性的权衡；揭示了投资组合限制下工人无法对冲棕色劳动收入风险和参与绿色金融收益的关键机制；阐明了财政政策与可持续金融偏好的相互强化关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计既有效又公正的绿色转型方案提供理论指导：建议优先使用股利税而非消费税或劳动所得税；提醒注意再分配政策可能削弱资本重新配置激励的副作用；强调发展绿色就业岗位的长期重要性。

title: Deviations from Target Ratings and Capital Structure Adjustments
affiliations: Kansai University

detail.title: Deviations from Target Ratings and Capital Structure Adjustments
detail.abstract: This study examines whether deviations from target ratings affect capital structure adjustments among Japanese firms, and whether this relationship depends on firms' information precision. The results show that firms reduce their debt when their ratings fall further below target ratings. This relationship is more pronounced among firms with lower information precision but does not exist among firms with higher information precision. These findings suggest that firms with lower information precision have stronger incentives to make debt-reducing capital structure adjustments to their target ratings.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了日本企业实际评级偏离目标评级时如何影响其资本结构调整，以及信息精确度如何调节这一关系。结果发现，评级越低于目标评级，企业越会减少债务；这一效应在信息精确度较低的企业中更显著，而在信息精确度较高的企业中则不成立。
AI.research_question: 偏离目标评级是否会影响日本企业的资本结构调整？信息精确度是否调节这一关系？
AI.motivation: 探讨信用评级在资本结构决策中的作用，特别是信息不对称程度不同的企业如何响应评级偏离信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本结构理论、信号理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 实证回归分析，考察日本企业样本中评级偏离度与资本结构调整之间的关系，并引入信息精确度作为调节变量。
AI.findings: （1）评级低于目标评级时，企业会减少债务；（2）信息精确度越低的企业，这种债务减少效应越强；（3）信息精确度高的企业不存在这一效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信用评级作为资本结构调整的信号机制，以及信息不对称程度对企业决策行为的影响，丰富了资本结构动态调整理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供基于评级信号的融资决策参考；为投资者和评级机构理解企业行为提供依据。

title: Can Machine Learning Improve Value Investing? Evidence from Japanese High Book-to-Market Stocks
affiliations: Kansai University

detail.title: Can Machine Learning Improve Value Investing? Evidence from Japanese High Book-to-Market Stocks
detail.abstract: This study examines whether the machine learning models, Elastic Net and XGBoost, can outperform Piotroski's (2000) F-score in a value-investing strategy focused on Japanese high book-to-market (B/M) firms. Using the same nine financial signals employed by Piotroski (2000) and an expanding window out-of-sample framework, this study constructs long-short (L-S) portfolios and evaluates the mean annual returns over the test period 2006-2020. By maintaining a constant information set, the study isolates the effect of algorithmic differences from the effect of data richness. The results show that XGBoost generates a statistically significant mean annual L-S return of +2.288% (t = 3.229, p < 0.01), whereas the F-score (+0.977%) and Elastic Net (+0.924%) fail to produce statistically significant returns. The portfolio-level analysis confirms that only XGBoost exhibits a monotonically increasing return pattern across terciles, with the top tercile earning a significant market-adjusted return of +5.671% (t = 2.170). The SHapley Additive exPlanations analysis reveals that XGBoost places the greatest emphasis on profitability and operating efficiency signals, consistent with Piotroski's (2000) accounting intuition. These findings suggest that the informational value of accounting signals in value investing is not limited to simple signal aggregation. Nonlinearity and signal interactions, as captured by XGBoost, can further enhance investment performance, even when the information set is fixed.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验了机器学习模型（Elastic Net和XGBoost）能否在基于日本高账面市值比公司的价值投资策略中超越Piotroski (2000)的F-score。结果表明，在固定信息集下，XGBoost能够利用会计信号的非线性和交互作用产生显著的超额收益（年均多空回报+2.288%），而F-score和Elastic Net未能获得统计显著的结果。
AI.research_question: 机器学习模型（Elastic Net和XGBoost）能否在仅使用Piotroski (2000)九个财务信号的基础上，超越传统的F-score价值投资策略表现？
AI.motivation: 已有研究证明F-score在价值投资中有效，但机器学习模型可能通过捕捉信号间的非线性和交互作用进一步提升表现；同时，多数研究将机器学习优越性归因于更丰富的数据集，而忽略了算法本身的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值投资理论（高B/M公司被低估假说）；会计信号的基本面分析框架（盈利能力、杠杆/流动性、经营效率三个维度）；机器学习中的非线性建模与信号交互理论。
AI.method: 以日本高B/M公司为样本（2006-2020年），使用Elastic Net、XGBoost与F-score三种方法在相同九个财务信号上进行预测；采用滚动窗口（expanding window）的样本外测试框架构建多空组合；使用SHAP值进行模型可解释性分析。
AI.findings: XGBoost产生年均+2.288%的统计显著多空回报（t=3.229），而F-score（+0.977%）和Elastic Net（+0.924%）不显著；XGBoost是唯一展现单调递增回报模式的模型；SHAP分析表明XGBoost最重视盈利能力和经营效率信号，与Piotroski的会计直觉一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了即便在固定信息集下，算法差异（非线性建模与信号交互的捕捉能力）本身就足以提升投资表现；表明F-score的简单信号聚合方法存在信息利用不足的理论缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为价值投资者提供了一种基于XGBoost的增强型选股策略，在日本市场实现了超额收益；验证了机器学习在基本面分析中的应用价值，但提示并非所有机器学习模型（如Elastic Net）都能超越传统方法。

title: Patterns and predictors of immigrant families’ participation in early care and education programs
affiliations: University of Delaware and University of Delaware

detail.title: Patterns and predictors of immigrant families’ participation in early care and education programs
detail.abstract: While children from immigrant families have been shown to benefit from early care and education (ECE) program participation, they are less likely to participate in ECE programs than children of U.S.-born parents. Little research examined how immigrant families participate in child care over time and what factors are linked to the participation patterns. The goals of this study were to i) identify patterns of immigrant families’ ECE participation across the early years and ii) examine whether socio-demographic characteristics predicted the ECE participation patterns using a longitudinal latent class analysis and logistic regression. A sample of families with at least one foreign-born parent and a child aged 15-39 months at Time point 1 (N=653) was selected from the 2014–2017 Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). Classification into four latent classes provided the best fit and interpretability of data. Non-Attendance class members (n=502, 76.88%) had low probability of ECE participation at all three Time points; parents in the Continuous Attendance class (n=87, 13.32%) had high probability of ECE participation at all three Time points; Attendance Gap class members (n=33, 5.05%) participated in ECE at Time points 1 and 3 but not at Time point 2; Delayed Start class members (n=31, 4.75%) started ECE at Time point 2. State immigration climate, parents’ immigration status, income, education, and race/ethnicity significantly associated with class membership. The study results inform practitioners’ and policymakers’ efforts to facilitate ECE program enrollment of children from immigrant families in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2014-2017年SIPP数据，通过纵向潜类别分析和逻辑回归，识别出移民家庭儿童早期教育参与的四种模式（不参与、持续参与、参与中断、延迟开始），并发现州移民政策环境、父母移民身份、收入、教育水平及种族/族裔显著影响参与模式。
AI.research_question: 移民家庭儿童在早年间的早期教育与保育参与模式有哪些？哪些社会人口特征可以预测这些参与模式？
AI.motivation: 移民家庭儿童从ECE项目中获益，但其参与率低于本土出生家庭儿童，而少有研究关注移民家庭儿童参与模式随时间的动态变化及其影响因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纵向潜类别分析；生态系统理论（隐含，因涉及宏观政策环境、家庭特征等多层次因素）
AI.method: 纵向潜类别分析（Longitudinal Latent Class Analysis）和逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）；数据来自2014-2017年收入与项目参与调查（SIPP），样本为至少一方父母为外国出生的家庭（N=653），儿童在第一个时间点年龄为15-39个月。
AI.findings: 识别出四种参与模式：非参与类（76.88%，三个时间点参与概率均低）、持续参与类（13.32%，三个时间点均高概率参与）、参与中断类（5.05%，时间点1和3参与但时间点2未参与）、延迟开始类（4.75%，时间点2开始参与）。州移民政策环境、父母移民身份、收入、教育水平及种族/族裔显著预测类别归属。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了移民家庭儿童ECE参与模式动态变化的实证研究空白，揭示了参与模式的异质性，为理解移民家庭儿童早期教育不平等提供了纵向视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为 practitioners 和 policymakers 提供了促进移民家庭儿童ECE项目入学的政策依据，特别是关注移民政策环境、经济援助和针对不同移民群体的精准干预。

title: Controlled Beta Systematic Equity – Portfolio Construction, Drawdown Budgeting and Implementation Discipline: A Practitioner Framework for Beta Budgeting, Implementation Permission and Controlled Equity Participation

detail.title: Controlled Beta Systematic Equity – Portfolio Construction, Drawdown Budgeting and Implementation Discipline: A Practitioner Framework for Beta Budgeting, Implementation Permission and Controlled Equity Participation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the principal of Guerrieri Capital Ltd, the private research vehicle through which this paper is published. The paper is methodological and research-oriented. It does not describe an investable product, recommend securities, disclose live positions, or present investor returns. The author received no external compensation or third-party funding for this work and declares no other personal or financial relationships that influenced the paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper does not involve patients, human participants, personal data, case studies, clinical material, animal subjects or experimental intervention.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received. The research was prepared independently by the author.

detail.abstract:
Systematic equity research is often framed as a signal discovery problem. For a portfolio manager, the more important problem is translation. A ranking signal does not become a credible portfolio process until it has a beta budget, drawdown budget, sizing logic, exposure controls, turnover discipline, cost assumptions, liquidity limits, attribution and monitoring.

The approach proposed here treats controlled beta as an implementation design problem, not as an incidental result of incomplete hedging. The relevant category is systematic equity long/short with intentional equity participation. It is distinct from beta neutral equity market neutral because the portfolio retains a budgeted market component while controlling drawdown behaviour, implementation cost and governance risk.

The practical contribution is to separate signal strength from portfolio permission. Beta is treated as a scarce portfolio budget rather than a residual exposure. Drawdown is treated as a construction constraint rather than a statistic reported after the fact. Specification selection is then assessed through an implementation spectrum, a beta budget frontier, parameter stability, turnover, transaction cost awareness, liquidity control and monitoring rules.

The evidence is historical simulation, not live performance and not a forecast. A bounded empirical case keeps the discussion concrete, but the paper is not a strategy presentation and does not disclose proprietary signal logic. The objective is to show how a controlled beta systematic equity process can be designed, tested, sized, constrained and reviewed as a portfolio process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将有控贝塔（controlled beta）作为系统性股票多空组合的实施设计问题，将贝塔视为稀缺的预算资源而非残余暴露，将回撤视为构建约束而非事后统计，从而将信号强度与组合许可分离，提供了一套完整的设计、测试、约束与监控框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将有控贝塔系统性股票投资设计为一个可信的、可执行的组合流程，而非仅仅是信号发现与排序问题？
AI.motivation: 传统的系统性股票研究过度聚焦于信号发现，但组合经理面临的核心问题是"转化"——一个排序信号需要贝塔预算、回撤预算、规模逻辑、暴露控制、换手纪律、成本假设、流动性限制、归因与监控等多重维度才能成为可信的组合流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有控贝塔的实施设计框架；贝塔作为稀缺组合预算的概念；回撤作为构建约束的理念；信号强度与组合许可的分离。
AI.method: 历史模拟（非实盘业绩，非预测），使用有界实证案例保持讨论具体，不披露专有信号逻辑。
AI.findings: 提出了一个完整的有控贝塔系统性股票组合流程设计方法，包括实施频谱、贝塔预算前沿、参数稳定性、换手率、交易成本意识、流动性控制和监控规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将贝塔从残余暴露重新定义为稀缺预算资源；将回撤从事后统计重新定义为事前构建约束；明确分离信号强度与组合许可两个概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组合经理提供了一套将排序信号转化为可信组合流程的完整框架，涵盖贝塔预算、回撤预算、规模逻辑、暴露控制、换手纪律、成本假设、流动性限制、归因与监控。

title: The Systemic Risk of AI

detail.title: The Systemic Risk of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No case studies or participants were used.
declarations.funderStatement: Self funded.

detail.abstract: Using an analysis of 9 frontier AI labs and over 2,000 firms that depend on their technology, we parameterized the systemic dependence of the AI market. Our empirical simulation found that a 5-day systemic outage or breach of service provision obligations by a single frontier provider could cost $30 to $120 billion, while a simultaneous multi-lab outage or breach could cost up to $270 billion, conservatively estimated. The 2024 CrowdStrike outage, which produced roughly $5.4 billion in realized downstream losses from a single vendor, sits inside this range as an empirical floor and sanity benchmark, if aggressively contained. Gains in technology provision add economic value, but are asymmetric: amounting to as much as $5 billion to the firms that can adopt the new capability, with continued losses to those whose obligations relied on features that are discontinued. In our model, we use a classical general-equilibrium production economy of complete information with no financial frictions, no liquidity constraints, no productivity shocks, sunspots or behavioral assumptions. Systemic risk is caused by latent, non-identifiability in productive inputs — permissible within the classical Arrow-Debreu framework — which experiences a regime shift, of which all participants are aware and must respond to competitively. A frontier outage or innovation gain alters the production technology of every dependent firm at once, propagating as a quantity failure or gain that is economically meaningful, rather than simply a price adjustment. Although parameterized on the AI economy, the model is general and applicable to financial systemic risk as well as counterparty trade risk. Policy implications are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析9家前沿AI实验室及2000多家依赖其技术的企业，发现单一前沿AI供应商系统中断5天可造成300-1200亿美元损失，多实验室同时中断损失高达2700亿美元。研究将AI市场系统性风险建模为古典一般均衡框架下的生产投入非可识别性问题，并讨论了政策含义。
AI.research_question: AI市场的系统性依赖风险有多大？前沿AI供应商的服务中断或技术变更如何影响下游企业，其经济后果如何量化？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术日益集中在前沿实验室手中，整个市场对这些供应商产生了系统性依赖。2024年CrowdStrike事件（单供应商造成约54亿美元损失）表明此类风险现实存在，但AI市场依赖程度更高，需系统量化其潜在损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于古典阿罗-德布鲁（Arrow-Debreu）一般均衡框架，假设完全信息、无金融摩擦、无流动性约束、无生产率冲击、无太阳黑子或行为假设。系统性风险源于生产投入的"潜在不可识别性"（latent non-identifiability），经历制度转换后，所有参与者知晓并须竞争性应对。
AI.method: 对9家前沿AI实验室及2000多家依赖其技术的企业进行实证模拟，参数化AI市场的系统性依赖程度。采用古典一般均衡生产经济模型，将前沿AI供应商的技术变化（中断或创新）建模为影响所有依赖企业生产技术的系统性冲击。
AI.findings: （1）单一前沿供应商系统性中断或违反服务义务5天，保守估计造成300-1200亿美元损失；（2）多实验室同时中断可造成高达2700亿美元损失；（3）2024年CrowdStrike事件的54亿美元损失处于上述区间的下限；（4）技术增益具有不对称性：采用新能力的受益企业获利高达50亿美元，但依赖被终止功能的义务方持续蒙受损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI市场的系统性风险纳入古典一般均衡理论框架，证明在无摩擦、完全信息的阿罗-德布鲁经济中，生产投入的潜在非可识别性即可导致系统性风险（而非依赖金融摩擦或行为假设）。模型具有一般性，可推广至金融系统性风险和对手方交易风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 量化了AI市场系统性依赖的经济风险规模，为监管机构制定AI供应链韧性政策提供依据；揭示了技术变更的不对称效应，提示政策需关注技术升级中的"遗弃风险"；模型可推广至其他领域的系统性风险管理。

reference: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 77
title: Asset Purchase Programmes and the Exchange Rate

detail.title: Asset Purchase Programmes and the Exchange Rate

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 77
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this paper, I evaluate the impact of COVID-era asset purchase programmes (APPs) on the dollar exchange rate in both emerging markets (EMs) and ex-US advanced economies (AEs). In an event study analysis that includes APP announcements for 23 EMs and seven AEs, I find that APPs appreciated the exchange rate in EMs after controlling for the policy actions of the Federal Reserve (Fed), including Fed swap lines, the policy actions of other AEs, and the simultaneous policy actions of the implementing country itself. I interpret the results through the lens of long-run uncovered interest rate parity deviations driven by sovereign credit risk, showing that asset purchase surprises lower the promised yield but do not necessarily decrease the underlying risk-free rate in EMs. These results suggest that APPs might help Ems stabilise exchange rates during episodes of distress without necessarily intervening in the foreign exchange market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了COVID时期资产购买计划对新兴市场和发达经济体美元汇率的影响，发现资产购买计划在控制美联储政策后能使新兴市场货币升值，其机制是通过降低主权信用风险而非无风险利率来实现。
AI.research_question: COVID时期的资产购买计划如何影响新兴市场和发达经济体的美元汇率？
AI.motivation: COVID-19危机期间各国央行大规模实施资产购买计划，但其对汇率的影响尚不明确，特别是在区分美联储政策与其他国家政策效果的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长期无抛补利率平价偏差（由主权信用风险驱动）
AI.method: 事件研究法，涵盖23个新兴市场和7个发达经济体的APP公告，控制美联储政策（包括互换额度）、其他发达经济体政策及实施国自身政策。
AI.findings: 资产购买计划使新兴市场货币升值；资产购买意外降低了承诺收益率，但并未必然降低新兴市场的无风险利率。
AI.theory_contributions: 将资产购买计划的汇率效应与主权信用风险驱动的长期UIP偏差联系起来，揭示了APP通过降低信用风险而非无风险利率来影响汇率的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明资产购买计划可以帮助新兴市场在危机期间稳定汇率，而无需直接干预外汇市场，为政策制定者提供了新的汇率稳定工具。

reference: Liberty Street Economics; https://doi.org/10.59576/lse.20260708
title: More Tariff Pass‑Through Is in the Pipeline
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Federal Reserve Bank of New York - Research Group, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: More Tariff Pass‑Through Is in the Pipeline

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The past year brought dramatic changes to U.S. trade policy, including sweeping new tariffs, as well as a Supreme Court decision that further reshaped the tariff landscape. Many businesses saw their costs increase significantly and faced complex decisions about whether to absorb the tariffs through lower profit margins, raise their prices to recover the higher costs, or some combination of the two. Last year, we found that most businesses had passed on at least some of these higher costs to their customers through higher prices. Now, over a year later, have businesses finished adjusting prices, or do further tariff-induced price increases lie ahead? Our latest regional business surveys reveal that nearly half of firms that have paid tariffs still plan additional price increases to offset these costs, with some expecting to raise prices six months or more in the future.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/07/more-tariff-pass-through-is-in-the-pipeline/

AI.tldr: 本文基于区域商业调查发现，尽管许多企业已将部分关税成本转嫁给消费者，但近半数企业仍计划在未来继续提价以完全吸收关税影响，表明关税导致的物价上涨尚未结束。
AI.research_question: 企业是否已完成关税成本的价格调整？未来是否还会有进一步的关税引致性涨价？
AI.motivation: 2025-2026年美国贸易政策急剧变化（新关税及最高法院裁决）大幅推高企业成本，需了解企业成本转嫁行为的动态进程及未来价格走势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关税传导（tariff pass-through）理论：企业面临关税成本时，会在吸收（压缩利润）与转嫁（提高价格）之间决策，且价格调整可能存在时滞。
AI.method: 区域商业调查（regional business surveys），追踪企业实际关税支付情况及未来定价计划。
AI.findings: 近半数已支付关税的企业仍计划进一步提价以抵消成本，部分企业预计6个月或更久之后才会提价。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实了关税传导的持续性与时滞性：企业价格调整并非一次性完成，而是存在显著的滞后效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和消费者提供预警：关税引发的通胀压力尚未完全释放，未来物价仍有上行风险。

title: Machine Learning Approaches to Socioeconomic Features Dimension of Food Security in Nepal
affiliations: Tribhuvan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tribhuvan University and Tribhuvan University

detail.title: Machine Learning Approaches to Socioeconomic Features Dimension of Food Security in Nepal
detail.abstract: Previous studies seemed to suffer from some gaps—especially, in their predictive accuracy— because they employed traditional statistical methods to predict food security and insecurity in Nepal. To plug this gap, therefore, the present study applied machine learning (ML) algorithms to examine the socioeconomic dimension of food security in Nepal. Using large-scale survey data of Nepal Living Standards Survey IV 2022/23 (NLSS-IV) by the Government of Nepal, this study selected households' socioeconomic attributes, representing 9600 households of Nepal. This study employed supervised ML algorithms to predict food security and insecurity levels, including random forest (RF), decision tree (DT), and logistic regression (LR) learning algorithms that aimed to optimize the predictive capacity of food security in Nepal. The model performance matrix showed that LR and RF performed with a higher accuracy for predicting the likelihood of being a food-secure household, as they exactly fell into this class. The ML algorithms revealed that the social features, rather than economic features, may be crucial in predicting food security outcomes. Based on their effect size, the following are the crucial features for predicting food security in Nepal: household size, caste/ethnicity, geographical location, poverty status, income, residential status (urban or rural), family members, road facility, gender, agricultural land, remittance, marital cooking energy, and marital status. These results thus offer some policy insights to policymakers and stakeholders that it is crucial to intervene in the social differentiation and economic distribution for securing food availability adequately in proper quality in Nepal

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习算法（随机森林、决策树、逻辑回归）分析尼泊尔9600户家庭的社会经济数据，发现社会特征（如家庭规模、种姓/ ethnicity、地理位置）比经济特征更能预测粮食安全状况，其中逻辑回归和随机森林的预测准确率最高。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习算法提高尼泊尔粮食安全预测的准确性？哪些社会经济特征是预测粮食安全的关键因素？
AI.motivation: 以往研究采用传统统计方法预测粮食安全，预测准确性存在不足，亟需更精准的预测方法为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习理论（监督学习算法：随机森林、决策树、逻辑回归）；粮食安全的社会经济维度理论。
AI.method: 使用尼泊尔生活水平调查IV（NLSS-IV）数据（9600户）；采用三种监督式机器学习算法（随机森林RF、决策树DT、逻辑回归LR）进行预测；通过模型性能矩阵评估预测准确率。
AI.findings: 逻辑回归和随机森林在预测粮食安全方面准确率最高；社会特征比经济特征对预测粮食安全更重要；关键预测特征按效应大小排序为：家庭规模、种姓/民族、地理位置、贫困状况、收入、居住状态（城乡）、家庭成员数、道路设施、性别、农业用地、汇款、炊事能源、婚姻状况。
AI.theory_contributions: 将机器学习方法引入粮食安全预测领域，弥补了传统统计方法预测精度不足的理论缺陷；揭示了社会特征在粮食安全预测中的主导性作用，拓展了粮食安全研究的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔政策制定者和利益相关者提供实证依据：必须同时干预社会分化（如种姓、性别、地理位置）和经济分配（如收入、贫困）才能确保粮食安全；明确了优先干预的关键特征变量，有助于精准施策。

title: Gold's Missing Anchor: The Real-Rate Decoupling and the Reserve-Safety Premium
affiliations: Bogazici University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Gold's Missing Anchor: The Real-Rate Decoupling and the Reserve-Safety Premium
detail.abstract: Gold has historically moved inversely with the real interest rate. That relationship broke after 2021: real yields rose to decade highs while gold doubled. On the pre-2022 anchor, by the end of 2025, gold trades at more than four times its real-rate-implied value. The break is in the level, not the mechanics: gold's high-frequency sensitivity to real rates barely moved, so a new, slow-moving demand sits on top. I interpret it as a repricing of reserve safety, with de-dollarization its leading component, and bring four kinds of evidence: a reserve-portfolio model with seizure risk that reproduces the pattern; gold-specificity against the metals complex and the sovereign safe havens; robustness to fiscal, monetary and retail explanations, with gold ETFs net sellers; and a price-based measure that recovers a demand shift the opaque official quantity data miss. A model pricing gold off real rates alone now misses an important component.

AI.tldr: 2021年后黄金与真实利率的传统负相关关系破裂，真实利率升至十年高点而黄金价格翻倍。本文将其解释为储备安全性的重新定价，去美元化是主要驱动因素，并通过四种证据支持这一结论。
AI.research_question: 2021年后黄金与真实利率的传统负相关关系为何破裂？黄金价格偏离真实利率隐含价值的驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 2021年后出现反常现象：真实利率升至十年高点，黄金价格却翻倍，传统定价模型失效，亟需新的解释框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 储备安全性重新定价理论（包含扣押风险的投资组合模型）、去美元化理论
AI.method: 构建包含扣押风险的主权储备资产组合模型；对比黄金与金属大宗商品及主权安全资产的表现差异；排除财政、货币、零售需求的替代解释；构建基于价格的衡量指标以捕捉官方数据遗漏的需求变化。
AI.findings: 黄金与真实利率关系的断裂发生在水平值而非高频机制层面；存在新的缓慢变化的需求叠加在原有关系之上；去美元化是储备安全性重新定价的主要驱动因素；多种替代解释（财政、货币、零售）均不成立，黄金ETF为净卖方。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出储备安全性重新定价理论解释黄金定价的结构性转变；建立了包含扣押风险的储备资产组合模型；将去美元化与黄金需求联系起来，补充了国际货币体系研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒投资者和市场参与者传统基于真实利率的黄金定价模型已不完整，需纳入储备安全性溢价；为各国央行储备管理提供参考；提供了识别官方黄金储备需求变化的间接度量方法。

reference: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 22/2026
title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Real Estate Evaluation in the Italian Market
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Dipartimento di Economia

detail.title: Recurrent Neural Networks for Real Estate Evaluation in the Italian Market

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 22/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Accurate evaluation of real estate prices represents a complex task, that holds significant relevance for the majority of the actors involved in a society, as homebuyers/sellers, investors, and policymakers. Over the last decades, in parallel with technological advancements, scholars and practitioners proposed several models and methodologies, spanning from simple hedonic regression models to sophisticated machine learning algorithms, in the attempt to improve the accuracy of price forecasts. Nonetheless, the interest towards the development of more precise and performing methodologies remains high, not only for static valuation but also, more recently, for dynamic approaches. Focusing on dynamic valuation, we turn the attention towards the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) models: while widely tested for stock prices forecast, RNNs have seen limited to no application in the domain of real estate valuation. In this study, using official data on prices of Italian residential properties, we propose and implement two different architectures for RNN models to perform both price prediction and relevance analysis with respect to the explanatory variables. Differently from other studies, we utilize data for the whole Italian territory, focusing, rather than on individual properties' valuation, on a range of prices for groups of properties identified by house type, geographical position and state of conservation. Specifically, the output variables of our analysis are represented by the minimum and maximum prices that determine this range. The results of our analysis indicate that a Standard Recurrent Neural Network forecasts well the prices in small municipalities (with less than 15 000 inhabitants), while a Double-Input Layer RNN, with an input layer dedicated to static features and a separate input layer for dynamic features, performs better in medium-sized (with a number of inhabitants between 15 000 and 50 000 inhabitants) and large municipalities (with more than 50 000 municipalities).

AI.tldr: 本文利用循环神经网络（RNN）对意大利住宅地产进行动态估值，提出标准RNN和双输入层RNN两种架构，分别适用于不同规模城市的房价区间预测。
AI.research_question: 如何利用循环神经网络模型对房地产价格进行动态预测，并评估不同解释变量的重要性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多采用静态估值方法（如特征价格模型或机器学习算法），而动态估值方法在房地产领域应用有限；RNN在股票预测中表现良好，但在房地产估值中几乎未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环神经网络（RNN）理论，包括标准RNN和双输入层RNN架构，用于时间序列预测和特征重要性分析。
AI.method: 基于意大利全国住宅物业官方数据，构建标准RNN和双输入层RNN两种模型，以房屋类型、地理位置和保存状态分组的房价区间（最低价和最高价）为输出变量，按城市规模（小、中、大）分别评估模型表现。
AI.findings: 标准RNN在小型城市（<15,000人）预测效果更好；双输入层RNN（静态特征与动态特征分别输入）在中等城市（15,000-50,000人）和大型城市（>50,000人）表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 将RNN模型引入房地产动态估值领域，并验证了不同架构在不同城市规模下的适用性差异，拓展了深度学习在房地产定价研究中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房地产投资者、政策制定者和市场参与者提供了一种基于城市规模的动态房价预测方法，有助于提高不同层级市场的估值精度和决策质量。

title: Relationship between Past use and Medicating Intention within the Theory of Planned behavior: A Case of Non-prescription Anthelmintic Medications in Vietnam

detail.title: Relationship between Past use and Medicating Intention within the Theory of Planned behavior: A Case of Non-prescription Anthelmintic Medications in Vietnam
detail.abstract: Past behavior has been suggested as a potential predictor of future behavior in social cognition models but has not been tested in the context of consumer medicating behavior. The purpose of the present study was to examine the relationship between past behavior, operationalized as the frequency of past use, and intention, as defined by the theory of planned behavior. First, based on the theory of planned behavior (TPB), this study tested the predictive utility of an intention of Vietnamese mothers to administer non-prescription anthelmintic medications to their school-age children. Second, it examined the predictive validity of past use on intention. Third, it identified moderating effect of demographic variables on the relationship between past use and intention. A convenient sample of 395 mothers in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, was included in the present study. The original model of TPB explained 32.3% of the variance in the intention to use non-prescription anthelmintics. The addition of past use frequency added 11.7% of the variance in the intention after controlling for the TPB original constructs. Monthly household income of mothers significantly moderated the relationship between past use and intention. Age and educational levels of mothers did not moderate the relationship. Theoretical and managerial implications as well as research limitations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于计划行为理论（TPB），探讨了越南母亲为学龄儿童使用非处方驱虫药的行为意图。研究发现，过去使用频率能显著增加对行为意图的预测力，且家庭月收入显著调节了二者的关系。
AI.research_question: 过去行为（以使用频率衡量）能否超越计划行为理论（TPB）原有构念，显著预测越南母亲为学龄儿童使用非处方驱虫药的意图？人口统计学变量是否调节过去行为与意图之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 过去行为在社认知模型中被认为是未来行为的潜在预测因子，但在消费者用药行为的情境下尚未被检验。本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior, TPB）；过去行为作为额外预测变量。
AI.method: 问卷调查，对越南胡志明市395名母亲进行便利抽样；采用层级回归分析检验TPB模型及过去使用频率的增量预测效度，并检验人口统计学变量的调节效应。
AI.findings: 原TPB模型解释了意图32.3%的方差；加入过去使用频率后，额外解释了11.7%的方差。家庭月收入显著调节过去使用与意图之间的关系，而年龄和教育水平无显著调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了在消费者用药行为情境下，过去行为（使用频率）对意图具有显著增量预测效度，拓展了TPB在健康消费行为领域的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为针对不同收入水平的母亲制定差异化的健康教育和干预策略提供了实证依据。

title: Marketing Mix Modeling: Decomposing Sales Volume Drivers and Optimizing Multi-Channel Media Spend

detail.title: Marketing Mix Modeling: Decomposing Sales Volume Drivers and Optimizing Multi-Channel Media Spend

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests or financial relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used aggregated, anonymized marketing performance data and did not involve human subjects; therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This study presents a comprehensive marketing mix model (MMM) analyzing 104 weeks of consumer packaged goods (CPG) market performance to quantify the contribution of price, television, radio, in-store activations, promotional discounting, and digital campaigns to new volume sales. Using ordinary least squares (OLS) regression with standardized predictors, the model explains 80.3% of weekly sales variance (R² = 0.803). Base price elasticity emerges as the dominant negative driver (standardized β =-1,033 units per standard deviation), confirming that price management is the single most powerful short-run sales lever available to brand managers. In-store activity (β = +352) and television investment (β = +216) are the two strongest positive media contributors, while promotional discounting delivers a statistically significant +6.7% average volume uplift during activation weeks (p < 0.01). Digital campaign channels-Facebook, Twitter, and branded website campaigns-display neutral to negative weekly associations, likely attributable to reverse causality and lag misalignment rather than genuine negative effects. The Stout brand equity index exerts a meaningful negative coefficient (β =-585), suggesting that premium brand positioning may suppress short-run volume in pricesensitive periods. These findings offer directly actionable guidance for marketing budget reallocation, promotional scheduling, and media channel sequencing in the CPG sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过104周的CPG市场数据构建营销组合模型，发现价格弹性是短期销量最大驱动因素（负向），店内活动和电视投资是正向贡献最强的媒体渠道，而数字渠道（Facebook、Twitter、品牌网站）呈现中性至负向关联。品牌资产指数显著负向影响短期销量，表明高端定位可能抑制价格敏感期的销量。
AI.research_question: 在快消品（CPG）行业中，价格、电视、广播、店内活动、促销折扣和数字营销活动对新销量贡献的量化效应如何？
AI.motivation: 品牌经理需要明确不同营销渠道对短期销量的贡献大小，以便进行预算重新分配、促销排期和媒体渠道排序，但目前缺乏基于大规模数据的全面量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 营销组合模型（Marketing Mix Model, MMM）、价格弹性理论、品牌资产理论
AI.method: 使用普通最小二乘（OLS）回归，对104周的CPG市场数据进行分析，以标准化预测变量量化各营销要素对新销量的边际贡献。
AI.findings: (1)模型解释80.3%的周销量变异；(2)基础价格弹性是最大的负向驱动因素（β=-1,033）；(3)店内活动（β=+352）和电视投资（β=+216）是正向贡献最强的媒体渠道；(4)促销折扣在激活周内带来平均+6.7%的销量提升；(5)数字渠道（Facebook、Twitter、品牌网站）呈现中性至负向关联，可能源于反向因果和时滞错配；(6)品牌资产指数显著负向（β=-585），表明高端定位可能抑制价格敏感期的短期销量。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了传统价格弹性理论在CPG行业中的主导作用；揭示了品牌资产与短期销量之间的负向关系，补充了品牌资产理论的边界条件；指出了数字营销渠道的短期贡献可能被高估，需考虑因果关系和时滞问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CPG品牌经理提供了可直接操作的营销预算再分配建议；明确了店内活动和电视投资是短期销量提升的最有效正向渠道；提示在价格敏感时期高端品牌定位可能抑制销量，需谨慎管理定价策略。

title: Issuing Away The Treasury Specialness: Debt Supply, Market Power, and Monetary Policy

detail.title: Issuing Away The Treasury Specialness: Debt Supply, Market Power, and Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: This paper aggregates security-level issuance data from 1999Q1 to 2024Q4 to estimate maturity-specific demand curves for Treasury convenience yields. They are downward sloping, heterogeneous across maturities, and affected by monetary policy through both level and slope effects. These estimates are then embedded in a quantitative debt-management model in which the issuer internalizes maturity-specific demand when choosing the composition of debt issuance. The main finding is that the observed maturity structure generates substantially lower seigniorage revenues than the revenue-maximizing allocation, especially after the GFC. This revenue loss is driven primarily by the post-GFC expansion in debt supply, which compresses convenience yields and reduces Treasury market power. Monetary policy amplifies these fiscal effects by changing the sensitivity of convenience yields to issuance.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1999Q1至2024Q4的证券发行数据，估计了国债便利收益的期限特定需求曲线，发现其向下倾斜、跨期限异质且受货币政策影响。将这些估计嵌入定量债务管理模型后发现，实际发行期限结构产生的铸币税收入显著低于收入最大化配置，尤其在金融危机后，收入损失主要由债务供给扩张压低了便利收益和削弱了国债市场力量所致。
AI.research_question: 如何量化国债发行期限结构对便利收益和铸币税收入的影响？实际发行结构是否偏离收入最大化配置？
AI.motivation: 国债发行期限结构对政府融资成本有重要影响，但以往研究较少从便利收益（convenience yields）的市场需求视角来估计期限特定的需求曲线，并分析其与债务管理政策的互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国债便利收益理论、市场力量（market power）视角下的债务管理模型、期限结构需求曲线估计。
AI.method: 利用1999Q1至2024Q4的证券发行数据，估计不同期限国债的便利收益需求曲线；将估计结果嵌入定量债务管理模型，模拟发行者内生化期限选择时的收入最大化配置。
AI.findings: 便利收益需求曲线向下倾斜且跨期限异质；实际发行结构产生的铸币税收入显著低于收入最大化配置，尤其在金融危机后；收入损失主因是债务供给扩张压低了便利收益、削弱了国债市场力量；货币政策通过改变便利收益对发行的敏感度放大财政效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为国债便利收益的期限异质性提供了新的需求曲线估计证据，揭示了债务管理政策中市场力量的角色，拓展了货币-财政互动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府债务管理当局优化国债发行期限结构、提高铸币税收入提供了定量分析工具和政策启示；提示了货币政策对债务管理的外溢效应。

reference: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 24/iKIET/205; i-KIET Issues & Analysis, No. 205
title: A New China Strategy for South Korea’s Advanced Industries
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: A New China Strategy for South Korea’s Advanced Industries

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 24/iKIET/205
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Advanced manufacturing industries targeted by the Made in China 2025 strategy, such as robots, semiconductors, electric vehicles (EVs, including autonomous driving), and batteries, have grown exponentially since 2015. With the exception of semiconductors, several categories within robots, batteries, and EVs have exceeded the localization targets outlined in the strategy. China now holds an overall value chain advantage over South Korea in these sectors. Across R&D, procurement (supply chain), production, services, and demand markets (both domestic and overseas), China maintains an edge in robots, EVs, batteries, and autonomous vehicles. Korea retains superiority in equipment procurement, sales and maintenance services, and overseas demand for the semiconductor industry, driven by its memory chip competitiveness. Korea also maintains a slight lead in robotics R&D capabilities for product development and design.

While the expanding rivalry poses threats to Korean industries, opportunities exist to differentiate in advanced and niche markets. China’s price competitiveness, its expanding dominance in new AI-based markets, and its internalizing supply chains are common threats. However, leveraging its overall technological prowess and process expertise in materials, components, and equipment, Korea maintains a qualitative advantage in certain categories. Korea must seek to enter global premium markets, such as the US and the EU, emphasizing stability and reliability.

Up to now, Korean industry has pursued an “ultra-gap” strategy, in which firms sought to maintain wide competitive moats against their Chinese competitors. This strategy is no longer viable. Korea urgently needs to shift its policy toward competitive cooperation and strategic utilization and secure a position in the future ecosystems that China aims to dominate, actively utilizing China’s high-tech and technological ecosystems. We must discover new cooperative models that combine China’s technology, production base, and data with Korea’s innovative ideas.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了"中国制造2025"战略下中国在机器人、半导体、电动汽车、电池等先进制造业的发展现状，并与韩国进行了竞争力对比。研究发现中国已在多个领域超越韩国，韩国原有的"超差距"战略已不再可行，亟需转向竞争性合作策略。
AI.research_question: 在"中国制造2025"战略背景下，中国与韩国在先进制造业（机器人、半导体、电动汽车、电池）领域的竞争格局如何？韩国应如何调整战略应对中国崛起？
AI.motivation: "中国制造2025"战略实施以来，中国先进制造业迅猛发展，对韩国传统优势产业构成挑战。韩国原有的"超差距"竞争战略难以为继，亟需重新审视竞争格局并探索新的合作模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值链竞争优势理论、技术竞争与产业追赶理论、竞争性合作战略理论
AI.method: 基于产业竞争力对比分析，对机器人、半导体、电动汽车、电池等领域的研发、采购（供应链）、生产、服务及国内外需求市场进行系统性比较。
AI.findings: 中国在机器人、电动汽车、电池及自动驾驶领域已全面超越韩国；韩国仅在半导体领域的设备采购、销售维护服务和海外需求方面保持优势；韩国在机器人研发的产品开发与设计能力上略占上风。中国在价格竞争、AI新市场拓展和供应链内部化方面构成对韩国的共同威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了新兴经济体在先进制造业领域对传统工业强国实现追赶和超越的动态过程，丰富了后发国家产业升级和技术追赶的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国调整对华产业竞争策略提供了战略建议：从"超差距"竞争转向竞争性合作，利用中国技术、生产基础和数据的优势，探索结合韩国创新理念的新型合作模式，并积极进入美欧等全球高端市场。

title: An Intelligent Scheduling System for Heterogeneous UAV Multi-trip Delivery: A Two-phase Hybrid Metaheuristic for Makespan Minimization
affiliations: UCSI University, UCSI University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: An Intelligent Scheduling System for Heterogeneous UAV Multi-trip Delivery: A Two-phase Hybrid Metaheuristic for Makespan Minimization
detail.abstract: The rapid adoption of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in last-mile logistics creates a pressing need for intelligent scheduling systems that allocate diverse delivery tasks across mixed fleets under tight operational constraints. This paper addresses the Heterogeneous UAV Multi-Trip Delivery Problem (HUAV-MTDP), in which UAVs of differing payload, speed, and endurance perform multiple trips to minimize the fleet makespan, a direct proxy for system throughput and service level. We formulate the problem as a mixed-integer linear programming model that jointly captures task-to-UAV assignment, vehicle-task matching, and multi-trip routing, and we design a two-phase hybrid metaheuristic, ACO-GA-WA, as the decision engine. The first phase applies Ant Colony Optimization for global exploration; the second couples a Genetic Algorithm with a continuous-domain recombination operator and an adaptive information-transfer bridge that tunes evolutionary parameters from the colony's search statistics. Across instances of 20 to 120 tasks, ACO-GA-WA reduces the median makespan by 8.8%, 2.6%, and 4.8% relative to ACO, GA, and a simplified ACO-GA, respectively, while achieving the lowest variance and the fewest spatio-temporal conflicts; its advantage widens as problem scale grows. The framework returns an executable schedule, comprising per-UAV manifests, trip itineraries, and the optimized makespan, providing a practical decision-support tool for heterogeneous UAV delivery operations.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异构无人机多程配送问题（HUAV-MTDP），设计了一种两阶段混合元启发式算法（ACO-GA-WA），在20-120个任务规模下相比基线算法中位makespan降低2.6%-8.8%，且方差更低、时空冲突更少。
AI.research_question: 如何对异构无人机（不同载荷、速度、续航）进行多程任务分配与路径规划，以最小化整个机队的makespan（完工时间）？
AI.motivation: 无人机在最后一公里物流中快速普及，但现有调度系统难以处理异构机队、多程运输（一次起飞执行多个任务）以及紧耦合的运营约束，导致系统吞吐量和服务水平受限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划（MILP）建模；蚁群优化（ACO）用于全局探索；遗传算法（GA）结合连续域重组算子与自适应信息传递桥进行局部优化。
AI.method: 两阶段混合元启发式算法（ACO-GA-WA）：第一阶段用ACO进行全局探索构建初始解；第二阶段用GA耦合连续域重组算子和自适应信息传递桥（从蚁群搜索统计中调优进化参数）进行精细优化。
AI.findings: 在20-120个任务实例上，ACO-GA-WA相比纯ACO、纯GA和简化ACO-GA，中位makespan分别降低8.8%、2.6%和4.8%；方差最小、时空冲突最少；优势随问题规模扩大而扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统定义并建模异构无人机多程配送问题（HUAV-MTDP），并提出ACO与GA的新型混合框架，其中自适应信息传递桥为元启发式算法的参数自调优提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 输出可执行的调度方案（每架无人机的任务清单、行程路线与优化后的makespan），为异构无人机物流运营提供实用的决策支持工具。

AI.research_question: 如何为具有不同载荷、速度和续航能力的异构无人机群设计智能调度系统，在最后一公里物流中分配多样化配送任务并最小化机队完工时间？
AI.motivation: 无人机在最后一公里物流中的快速应用需要智能调度系统，而现有研究对异构无人机多趟配送问题的联合优化（任务分配、车辆匹配和多趟路由）不足，亟需高效的决策引擎。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合整数线性规划模型（MILP）用于形式化问题；两阶段混合元启发式算法（ACO-GA-WA）：第一阶段用蚁群优化进行全局探索，第二阶段用遗传算法结合连续域重组算子和自适应信息传递桥。

AI.findings: ACO-GA-WA相比ACO、GA和简化ACO-GA，中位完工时间分别降低8.8%、2.6%和4.8%；方差最小、时空冲突最少；优势随问题规模扩大而扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模异构无人机多趟配送问题（HUAV-MTDP）的联合优化；提出融合蚁群与遗传算法的两阶段混合框架及自适应参数调节机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可执行的调度方案（每架无人机的任务清单、行程路线和优化后的完工时间），为异构无人机配送运营提供实用的决策支持工具。

title: Permanent but Unequal: A Multilevel Quasi-Experimental Analysis of Online Learning Expansion and Doctoral Completion Trajectories Across U.S. Graduate Education, 2014-2022

detail.title: Permanent but Unequal: A Multilevel Quasi-Experimental Analysis of Online Learning Expansion and Doctoral Completion Trajectories Across U.S. Graduate Education, 2014-2022

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 disruption forced the most comprehensive shift to online delivery in U.S. graduate education history. This study examines whether that change represents a permanent restructuring or a transient adjustment, and how it relates to differential doctoral completion outcomes across fields with different research methodologies. We apply a multilevel quasi-experimental design to two federal census-level datasets: the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS; 18,826 institution-year observations, 2014-2022) and the Survey of Earned Doctorates (SED; 34 subfields, 2012-2022). Each institution serves as its own control in a fixed-effects panel model (institution-level ICC = .702), supplemented by interrupted timeseries and sector-disaggregated analysis. The online enrollment surge was not transient: by 2022, online-engaged enrollment remained about 6% points above pre-pandemic projections, with hybrid delivery accounting for the larger share. Within institutions, the pandemic produced a sharp increase of nearly 13% points, roughly half of which persisted into 2022. Doctoral completion trajectories diverged: co-presence-dependent fields (e.g. history, foreign languages, anthropology) experienced sustained declines, while computationally oriented fields (e.g. computer science, engineering) grew. A trend-adjusted model attributes a 20.6% post-pandemic completion advantage to computationally oriented fields beyond preexisting divergence. The post-pandemic environment is a sustained, stratified system rather than a return to baseline. The design documents fieldlevel trajectories but cannot assign them to individual-level modality exposure. Findings inform online doctoral program design, hybrid modality investment, and accreditation monitoring.

AI.tldr: 新冠疫情导致美国研究生教育大规模转向线上教学。本研究利用2014-2022年联邦人口普查数据，采用多水平准实验设计发现：在线招生增长并非暂时现象，到2022年仍比疫情前预测高约6个百分点；共存型领域（如历史、外语）博士完成率持续下降，而计算导向领域（如计算机科学、工程）则持续增长，趋势调整模型显示计算导向领域拥有20.6%的完成后发优势。后疫情时代呈现的是一个持续的、分层的教育体系，而非回归基线。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情带来的在线教育转变是永久性重组还是暂时性调整？不同研究方法的学科在博士完成率上是否存在差异化的变化轨迹？
AI.motivation: 疫情强制美国研究生教育史上最大规模向在线交付转型，但学界对此次转变的持久性及对不同学科博士培养的影响缺乏系统性的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多水平准实验设计；固定效应面板模型；间断时间序列分析；趋势调整模型。
AI.method: 基于IPEDS（18,826个机构-年观测，2014-2022）和SED（34个子领域，2012-2022）两项联邦人口普查级别数据集，以各机构自身为对照进行固定效应面板建模（机构水平ICC=0.702），辅以间断时间序列和部门分层分析。
AI.findings: （1）在线招生增长非暂时性：2022年在线注册仍比疫情前预测高约6个百分点，混合交付占较大份额；（2）机构内部疫情导致骤增近13个百分点，约一半持续到2022年；（3）依赖共存的领域（历史、外语、人类学）博士完成率持续下降，计算导向领域（计算机科学、工程）持续增长；（4）趋势调整模型显示计算导向领域拥有20.6%的后疫情完成优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了疫情引发的教育模式转型的持久性特征，并首次在同一分析框架内将学科方法论特征（共存导向vs计算导向）与博士完成率差异化轨迹联系起来，为理解技术冲击下高等教育分层演化提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线博士项目设计、混合交付模式投资决策及认证监测提供了实证依据，提示不同学科应差异化布局在线与混合教学资源。

affiliations: University of Southern California and Boston College - Center for Retirement Research

detail.title: Liquidity Risks in Retirement: Incidence, Cost, and Preparedness

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All findings, interpretations, and conclusions of this paper represent the views of the authors and does not represent official views of the above-named institutions. © 2025 Pension Research Council of the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania. All rights reserved.
