AI.method: 收集2006年至2025年3月德国四大报纸中关于财政政策的新闻报道，利用ChatGPT（大型语言模型）自动识别不同财政叙事并构建叙事指数，然后估计叙事指数对家庭通胀预期的影响，并分析不同叙事对政府支出冲击传导的调节效应。
AI.findings: 所有财政叙事指数对家庭通胀预期均有显著正向影响，但效应大小不同；不同叙事对政府支出冲击的传导有异质性影响，部分叙事放大冲击效应，部分叙事则削弱之。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了叙事经济学在宏观预期形成中的应用，揭示了财政叙事作为独立渠道影响通胀预期的机制，丰富了财政政策传导的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和政策制定者提供了沟通策略启示：不同的财政叙事对公众预期和宏观经济冲击的传导效果不同，政策沟通需精准设计叙事内容。

title: Liveness under Macro Winters: Mechanism Design for Fee-Only Blockchains

detail.title: Liveness under Macro Winters: Mechanism Design for Fee-Only Blockchains
detail.abstract: Every blockchain whose consensus layer is financed purely by transaction fees — by design (zero-emission chains) or by destiny (Bitcoin as its block subsidy decays) — faces a liveness hazard that emission-funded chains conceal: in the aftermath of a persistent macroeconomic shock, transaction volume can remain below validator operating cost for months. We show the binding risk is the duration of such "winters," not their depth, and that the intuitive remedy — counter-cyclical fee multipliers — is both pro-cyclical for users and manipulable by the validators who produce the volatility measurements. We propose instead a pre-funded mutual support pool (a liveness sleeve) with three design commitments: a conjunction trigger (volume and a stress index, each sustained, so that the one signal validators control never suffices alone); a shortfall payout capped at a published reference operating cost; and a slow payout decay whose role, we show, is not to discourage idleness but to make a validator's receipts strictly increasing in its own honest fee income — without decay, censoring one's own fee base is payoff-neutral inside the subsidised state. Under the shortfall structure, censorship aimed at forcing the trigger is strictly dominated whenever the support floor lies below normal income (Proposition 1). Monte-Carlo experiments on six-year paths with heterogeneous validators locate the feasible design window — replacement ratio beta in [1.2, 1.6] of reference cost with decay at most 4% per week — and a reinforcement-learning adversary (a 35%-stake cartel free to censor up to 75% of transactions) converges to near-zero censorship, never beating honesty on matched evaluation episodes. Survival of a thirty-validator set through a black-swan winter (volume -85%, half-life twelve months) rises from 56% to 77% with the sleeve in place. The mechanism requires no emission, no fee increases on distressed users, and no discretionary bailout authority.

AI.tldr: 本文针对零排放区块链（如手续费仅靠交易费支撑的链，或比特币区块补贴衰减后的情形）面临的生存性风险，提出了一种“生存袖套”机制——由验证者预先资助的互助池，通过联合触发条件、上限赔付和缓慢衰减设计，在宏观经济冲击导致交易量长期低迷时提供支持，且无需增发、不增加用户费用、不依赖自由裁量救助。
AI.research_question: 当区块链共识层完全依赖交易费融资时，如何设计一种无需增发、不可操纵的机制来应对持续性的宏观经济冲击（“加密寒冬”）导致的生存性风险？
AI.motivation: 零排放链（如设计使然）或比特币这类因区块补贴衰减而最终依赖交易费的链，在持续性宏观经济冲击后，交易量可能数月低于验证者运营成本，形成“生存性风险”。现有直觉解（逆周期费用乘数）对用户是顺周期的，且可被生产波动性测量的验证者操纵，因此需要更稳健的机制设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论（占优策略分析）、机制设计（联合触发、赔付上限、缓慢衰减）、强化学习（对抗性验证者联盟建模）、蒙特卡洛模拟。
AI.method: 理论证明（Proposition 1：审查行为在袖套机制下严格被占优）；六年路径的蒙特卡洛实验（含异质性验证者）；35%权益的强化学习对抗者（可审查75%交易）的收敛分析；黑天鹅场景（交易量下降85%，半衰期12个月）的30验证者集合生存率模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 核心风险是“寒冬”的持续时间而非深度；2. 联合触发（交易量+压力指数，均需持续）使验证者单一信号无法操控触发；3. 赔付衰减的关键作用不是阻止怠惰，而是使验证者收入严格随自身诚实费用收入递增（无衰减时，在补贴状态下审查自身费用基础是收益中性的）；4. 当支撑下限低于正常收入时，旨在迫使触发的审查行为被严格占优；5. 可行设计窗口：替代率β为参考成本的1.2-1.6倍，衰减率不超过每周4%；6. 强化学习对抗者收敛到接近零审查；7. 黑天鹅场景下30验证者集合生存率从56%提升至77%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格分析了零排放区块链的生存性风险，指出风险的维度是持续时间而非深度；证明了对“逆周期费用乘数”的操纵性问题；提出并证明了“生存袖套”机制下审查行为被占优的理论条件；揭示了赔付衰减在激励相容中的关键角色。
AI.practical_contributions: 为依赖交易费的区块链提供了一种无需增发、不增加用户费用、无需自由裁量救助的生存保障机制设计；给出了具体的参数设计窗口（替代率β 1.2-1.6，衰减≤4%/周），可直接指导工程实现；展示了该机制在黑天鹅场景下将验证者集合生存率从56%提升至77%的显著效果。

title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Medicare Home Health and Hospice Program Integrity: A Composite Risk Score Framework Validated on Real Medicare Payment Data, 2020 to 2023

detail.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Medicare Home Health and Hospice Program Integrity: A Composite Risk Score Framework Validated on Real Medicare Payment Data, 2020 to 2023

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available, de-identified CMS administrative data and does not involve human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Medicare home health and hospice services represent a documented federal program integrity priority. This paper develops and validates an unsupervised anomaly detection and risk stratification framework applied to 11,501 Medicare-certified providers (5,730 home health agencies, 5,771 hospices) with at least 11 beneficiaries in the 2023 Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services Post-Acute Care Utilization Public Use File. The framework combines a weighted statistical risk layer using eight engineered features per provider type with an Isolation Forest machine learning layer using fixed hyperparameters (contamination 0.02, 100 estimators, random seed 42). The Composite Risk Score weights the two layers at 60 percent statistical and 40 percent machine learning, and stratifies providers into five percentile-based tiers. At the 95th percentile cutoff the framework flags 287 home health agencies and 289 hospices for investigative review. Directly observed sample excess against state median peer benchmarks is $156.0 million for home health and $133.3 million for hospice.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了一个无监督异常检测与风险分层框架，应用于2023年CMS数据中11,501家Medicare认证的居家健康与临终关怀机构，通过统计层与机器学习层加权组合，在95百分位阈值下识别出576家高风险机构，涉及约2.89亿美元的异常支出。
AI.research_question: 如何有效识别Medicare居家健康和临终关怀服务中的异常报销（欺诈、浪费或滥用）并对其风险进行分层？
AI.motivation: Medicare居家健康和临终关怀服务已被列为联邦项目完整性优先事项，需要更精准的异常检测工具来识别高风险提供者，以保护医保资金。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无监督异常检测理论、统计风险评估、隔离森林机器学习算法、风险分层理论。
AI.method: 使用2023年CMS PAC PUF数据中11,501家Medicare认证机构，结合加权统计风险层（每类提供者8个工程特征）和隔离森林机器学习层（固定超参数：污染率0.02，100个估计器，随机种子42），复合风险评分按60%统计层和40%机器学习层加权，并划分为五个百分位数分层。
AI.findings: 在95百分位阈值下，框架标记了287家居家健康机构和289家临终关怀机构以供调查；直接观察到的样本超额（与所在州中位数同行基准相比）在居家健康领域为1.56亿美元，在临终关怀领域为1.333亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种结合统计特征工程与无监督机器学习（隔离森林）的混合框架，为医保异常检测领域提供了可复制的风险分层方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Medicare项目完整性检查提供了可操作的筛查工具，能够高效识别高风险提供者并量化潜在的异常支出金额，帮助监管机构优先分配调查资源。

title: The κ-Chain: A Sovereign Islamic Financial Infrastructure Layer

detail.title: The κ-Chain: A Sovereign Islamic Financial Infrastructure Layer
detail.abstract:
We propose the κ-Chain: a sovereign Layer 1 blockchain whose native monetary primitive is the convergence intensity κ, derived from the random stopping time representation of perpetual futures contracts (Ackerer, Hugonnier & Jermann 2025), rather than the risk-free interest rate r that underlies every existing financial blockchain. The theoretical foundation rests on six working papers (Ahmed & Bhuyan 2026a–e; Ahmed 2026f) that establish: (i) the interest parameter ι is separable from and eliminable from no-arbitrage pricing (the Separation Theorem); (ii) κ is formally isomorphic to the hazard rate λ in the Duffie-Singleton credit framework, giving a complete riba-free pricing foundation for perpetual contracts, sukuk, takaful, and credit default swaps; (iii) the κ-yield curve can be estimated empirically from sovereign sukuk spread data across GCC and Southeast Asian markets; and (iv) these results are computationally validated against a live deployed protocol (Baraka Protocol, Arbitrum Sepolia). 
The κ-Chain is not a blockchain that adds Islamic financial products as applications. It is a blockchain where ι = 0 is the substrate — present in every transaction, every block reward, every pricing primitive — because the absence of interest is not imposed as a constraint but is the natural language of the pricing mathematics. We describe the full architecture, the validator economics, the monetary policy implications for central banks in OIC-member states, and a three-phase roadmap from the currently deployed Baraka Protocol v3 testnet to a sovereign Cosmos appchain. We document honestly what is built, what is proven, and what remains to be done.

AI.tldr: 本文提出κ-Chain，一条以收敛强度κ（而非传统无风险利率r）作为原生货币基础的第一层主权区块链，旨在构建一个天然无息（riba-free）的金融区块链基础设施。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一条以无息定价（ι=0）为底层数学原语的主权区块链，使伊斯兰金融的合规性不是作为应用层约束，而是作为协议层的自然语言？
AI.motivation: 现有所有金融区块链均以无风险利率r为定价基础，这与伊斯兰金融（riba-free）原则根本冲突。作者试图证明利率参数ι可以从无套利定价中分离并消除，从而构建一条天然符合伊斯兰金融原则的区块链。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) 分离定理：利率参数ι可从无套利定价中分离并消除；(2) κ与Duffie-Singleton信用框架中风险率λ的形式同构；(3) 随机停时表示下的永续合约定价理论。
AI.method: 理论推导（六篇工作论文建立形式化基础）结合实证估计（利用GCC和东南亚市场的主权sukuk利差数据估计κ收益率曲线）以及计算验证（已在Arbitrum Sepolia测试网部署Baraka Protocol v3）。
AI.findings: (1) ι可从无套利定价中分离并消除；(2) κ与Duffie-Singleton信用风险框架中的风险率λ形式同构，可提供完整的无息定价基础；(3) 可从主权sukuk利差数据中实证估计κ收益率曲线；(4) 已在真实测试网环境中计算验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出利率可分离性与可消除性的形式化定理，建立κ与信用风险框架的同构关系，为伊斯兰金融产品提供统一的无套利定价数学基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出完整的κ-Chain架构设计（验证者经济、货币政策、三阶段路线图），并已在Arbitrum Sepolia测试网上部署了Baraka Protocol v3作为概念验证原型。

title: An Unsupervised Composite Risk Scoring Framework for Detecting Anomalous Medicare Part B Injectable Drug Waste

detail.title: An Unsupervised Composite Risk Scoring Framework for Detecting Anomalous Medicare Part B Injectable Drug Waste

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses only publicly available, de-identified CMS administrative data and does not involve human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Medicare Part B injectable drug waste represents a documented federal program integrity priority. The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services adopted the JW modifier in January 2017 and the JZ modifier in July 2023 specifically to enable systematic analysis of discarded amounts from single dose vials. The Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 Section 11001 created a manufacturer refund obligation for discarded amounts above 10 percent. This paper presents the Medicare Waste Anomaly Risk Index (MWARI), an unsupervised composite risk scoring framework for detecting anomalous Medicare Part B injectable drug waste patterns. The framework integrates six engineered features (waste rate, waste dollars, waste to spending ratio, five year compound annual growth, low volume billing flag, and Inflation Reduction Act refund eligibility) through a weighted statistical layer combined 60/40 with an Isolation Forest machine learning layer. The system processes the complete 2023 analytical universe of 823 HCPCS codes and identifies 42 drugs in the top 5 percent risk tier with sample excess waste of approximately 550 million dollars (95 percent bootstrap confidence interval 338 to 809 million). Validation is performed through six procedures: 1,000 iteration bootstrap (flagged count coefficient of variation 0.0153), permutation feature importance, three year provider level temporal holdout (coverage 88.8 percent, mean lift 14.3 times), Office of Inspector General List of Excluded Individuals and Entities concordance, Department of Justice defendant cross reference, and threshold sensitivity. The framework is appropriate for unsupervised settings where no labeled fraud ground truth exists. All source data is publicly accessible from data.cms.gov and oig.hhs.gov. The complete analytical pipeline, results files, and reproducibility envelope are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Medicare Waste Anomaly Risk Index (MWARI)，一个无监督的复合风险评分框架，用于检测Medicare B部分可注射药物浪费的异常模式。该框架整合6个工程化特征，通过加权统计层与孤立森林机器学习层结合，识别出42种高风险药物，涉及约5.5亿美元的异常浪费，并通过六种验证程序确认其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个无监督的复合风险评分框架，有效识别Medicare B部分可注射药物浪费中的异常模式？
AI.motivation: Medicare B部分可注射药物浪费已被记录为联邦计划诚信优先事项，CMS已采用JW和JZ修饰符进行系统性分析，2022年《通胀削减法案》第11001条对超过10%的浪费设立了制造商退款义务。然而，在缺乏标记欺诈真实数据的无监督场景下，需要有效的异常检测框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无监督异常检测框架，结合加权统计方法与孤立森林机器学习算法。
AI.method: MWARI框架整合六个工程化特征（浪费率、浪费金额、浪费与支出比、五年复合年增长率、低量计费标志、IRA退款资格），通过60/40权重结合加权统计层与孤立森林机器学习层。使用六种验证程序：1000次迭代自助法、排列特征重要性、三年提供者层面时间保持验证、OIG排除名单一致性、DOJ被告交叉引用和阈值敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 处理2023年823个HCPCS代码的完整分析宇宙，识别出前5%风险层中的42种药物，样本超额浪费约5.5亿美元（95%自助法置信区间3.38亿至8.09亿美元）。六种验证程序均表现良好，如自助法标记计数变异系数0.0153，时间保持验证覆盖率88.8%，平均提升14.3倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种适用于无监督场景的复合风险评分框架，将统计特征工程与机器学习异常检测相结合，为医疗浪费检测领域提供了方法论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可公开复现的完整分析流程和结果文件，支持CMS等监管机构识别高浪费风险药物，有助于落实IRA退款义务，提升Medicare计划的财政诚信。

title: The Organizational Capability Management Theory of Procurement: Capability Access and Capability Availability as Procurement's Primary Outputs

detail.title: The Organizational Capability Management Theory of Procurement: Capability Access and Capability Availability as Procurement's Primary Outputs
detail.abstract: Procurement scholarship and practice define the function by its activities-spend management, sourcing, contracting, supplier management-leaving it without a distinctive theoretical object and exposed to the charge that what it buys, rivals can buy too. This paper proposes a theory in which procurement's object is neither spend nor suppliers but the organization's portfolio of external capabilities: capacities residing outside the legal boundary of the firm on which mission delivery depends. Under this Organizational Capability Management (OCM) view, suppliers are capability providers, contracts are capability-access mechanisms, and governance is the system that preserves capability availability over time. The function's primary outputs are therefore capability access-an exercisable means of obtaining a defined external capability when required-and capability availability-the persistence of that access under perturbation. The distinction is operationally consequential: access is documentary and observable, while availability is counterfactual until tested, so organizations systematically over-measure the first and under-measure the second. A signed contract is access; whether it holds under disruption is availability. Capability demand originates with stakeholders pursuing organizational deliverables, so the portfolio is derived from mission, not managed for its own sake; and access carries a present tense and a future tense-current access to capabilities in use, and frontier access to capabilities that may become mission-relevant-making innovation the forward form of the access output, co-equal with continuity as the stressed form of availability. The paper states the theory as eight propositions, positions it against the resource-based view, dynamic capabilities, the relational view, transaction cost economics, and the capability-sourcing literature-claiming the inversion of perspective, not the ingredients-derives business continuity and innovation as corollaries rather than adjacent functions, supplies an access/availability decomposition with measurable constructs for each component, and develops seven differential predictions on which the capability view and the prevailing spend view recommend different decisions. Scope conditions, limitations, and a research agenda are stated explicitly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出采购不应被定义为成本或供应商管理活动，而应被视为组织外部能力组合的管理。作者构建了"组织能力管理"（OCM）视角，将供应商视为能力提供者、合同视为能力访问机制、治理视为维持能力可得性的系统，并将采购的核心产出分解为能力访问（可观察、有记录）和能力可得性（反事实、在扰动下才显形），从而将业务连续性和创新作为采购的内生推论而非相邻职能。
AI.research_question: 采购的理论对象究竟是什么？如何将采购从以支出和供应商为中心的活动定义，重新理论化为以外部能力组合为核心的组织功能？
AI.motivation: 采购学术和实践普遍以活动（支出管理、寻源、合同、供应商管理）来定义自身，缺乏独特的理论对象，面临"你买得到的东西竞争对手也买得到"的挑战，即采购被认为不能创造持久竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织能力管理（OCM）视角；资源基础观（RBV）、动态能力、关系观、交易成本经济学、能力 sourcing 文献作为对比框架。
AI.method: 理论构建论文：以八个命题的形式陈述理论，提出可测量的分解结构（访问/可得性），并发展出七项差异化预测，对比能力视角与主流支出视角在不同决策情境下的推荐差异。
AI.findings: 1）采购的理论对象是组织的外部能力组合，而非支出或供应商；2）采购的核心产出是能力访问（可观察、有记录）和能力可得性（反事实、只有在扰动时才被检验）；3）组织系统地过度测量访问而不足测量可得性；4）能力需求源自利益相关者追求组织交付物，因此能力组合由使命派生而非为管理而管理；5）访问有现在时和未来时两种形态，使创新成为访问产出的前向形式，与作为可得性压力形式的连续性同等重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）为采购赋予了独特的理论对象——外部能力组合；2）将业务连续性和创新从相邻职能重新定位为采购的内生推论；3）提出能力访问/可得性的分解结构及其可测量构念；4）开发了七项差异化预测，在能力视角与支出视角之间产生可检验的竞争性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为采购领导者提供了从成本中心思维转向能力管家思维的框架；2）揭示了组织过度关注合同签署（访问）而忽视供应链韧性（可得性）的偏差；3）为采购如何同时服务于业务连续性和创新提供了统一的理论基础。

title: Holding Up the Market: Government Ownership, Corporate Signals, and the Limits of Intervention

detail.title: Holding Up the Market: Government Ownership, Corporate Signals, and the Limits of Intervention
detail.abstract: We study when and how government intervention transmits to equity prices, using Korea's 2024-2026 "KOSPI 7000" episode, in which the value-weighted market rose 191 percent with no identifiable net buyer. We argue that the market is inelastic not to demand in general but to the permanent and informational demand that arbitrage cannot offset, and we identify this distinction by contrast: anticipated, arbitrageable KOSPI 200 index reconstitutions are absorbed and leave no permanent price effect, whereas two government-created shocks are capitalized. First and most cleanly, a staggered difference-indifferences design-robust to self-selection under not-yet-treated controls-shows that Corporate Value-up disclosures raise a firm's price-to-book ratio by about 10 percent over eight months, an effect driven by concrete, verifiable commitments and mediated by selective foreign inflows. Second, the National Pension Service supports prices through the level of its holdings rather than the flow of its trades: it cut its domestic-equity weight from 21 to 11.5 percent over 2021-2024, and the rebound to 21 percent reflects price appreciation, not purchases. Third, the rally is largely a semiconductor revaluation (56 percent of the index gain) that the market accommodated with negligible net flow. Market inelasticity is conditional on the arbitrageability of demand.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国2024-2026年"KOSPI 7000"事件（市值加权市场上涨191%且无可识别净买家），研究政府干预何时以及如何传导至股票价格。核心论点是市场并非对一般需求无弹性，而是对套利无法抵消的永久性和信息性需求无弹性。通过对比可套利的KOSPI 200指数调整（无永久价格效应）和两种政府冲击（有价格效应）来识别这一区别。
AI.research_question: 政府干预何时以及如何传导至股票价格？市场无弹性究竟是对何种需求而言？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为市场具有弹性（需求变化会被套利者迅速抵消），但韩国KOSPI 7000事件中市场大幅上涨却无可识别净买家，这一现象挑战了市场弹性假说，促使作者重新审视市场无弹性的条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场无弹性理论：区分套利可抵消的需求（如指数调整）与套利无法抵消的永久性和信息性需求（如政府干预驱动的冲击）。关键条件是需求的"可套利性"（arbitrageability）。
AI.method: 交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences），对尚未处理的控制组进行稳健处理以应对自选择问题；结合事件研究、组合分析等多种方法。
AI.findings: 1) 企业价值提升（Corporate Value-up）披露使公司市净率在八个月内提升约10%，效应由具体可验证的承诺驱动，并由选择性外资流入中介；2) 国民年金通过持仓水平而非交易流量支持价格：2021-2024年国内权益权重从21%降至11.5%，反弹至21%反映的是价格上涨而非购买行为；3) 上涨行情主要由半导体板块重新估值驱动（贡献指数涨幅的56%），市场在近乎零净流入的情况下吸收了这一变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确界定了市场无弹性不是对一般需求而言，而是对套利无法抵消的永久性和信息性需求；提出了"需求的可套利性"作为市场弹性边界条件的关键理论区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解政府干预如何影响资本市场提供了实证证据；对政策制定者（如通过价值提升披露、养老金持仓影响市场）和投资者（理解哪些需求冲击会产生永久价格效应）具有重要参考价值。

title: Inflation Attention Thresholds Before and After the Inflation Peak
affiliations: National Bank of Slovakia and National Bank of Slovakia

detail.title: Inflation Attention Thresholds Before and After the Inflation Peak
detail.abstract: We study whether the inflation threshold that triggers household attention survives during disinflation. Using Google Trends data for 21 Eurozone countries plus the US, UK, and Switzerland during the 2021-2023 inflation surge, we estimate attention thresholds before and after peak inflation. In roughly half of the sample, no post-peak threshold emerges and attention declines linearly rather than through a regime switch. Structural-break tests reject symmetry in the inflation-attention relationship based on Google Trends in every tested country. For the United States, the data suggest a higher post-peak threshold, though this finding does not replicate under alternative attention proxies. We corroborate our main findings with GDELT news-coverage data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究通胀阈值在通缩期间是否仍能引发家庭关注。利用2021-2023年期间21个欧元区国家及美、英、瑞的谷歌趋势数据，发现在约一半样本中，通胀峰值后阈值消失，注意力呈线性下降。结构断点检验拒绝所有国家对称性假设。美国数据虽显示阈值上升，但未被其他注意力指标验证。主要发现获GDELT新闻数据支持。
AI.research_question: 通胀阈值（引发家庭关注的通胀率临界点）在通缩（通胀回落）期间是否依然存在？
AI.motivation: 现有文献已证实通胀水平上升会吸引家庭注意力，但尚不清楚当通胀从峰值回落时，这一阈值效应是否具有对称性，这对理解通胀预期的形成与消退机制至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济学、通胀阈值理论、行为宏观经济学（关注不对称性与制度转换效应）
AI.method: 利用谷歌趋势（Google Trends）数据，对21个欧元区国家及美、英、瑞在2021-2023年通胀飙升期间的家庭注意力进行估计，比较通胀峰值前后的注意力阈值；采用结构断点检验；并使用GDELT新闻覆盖数据进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1）约半数样本国家在通胀峰值后阈值消失，注意力呈线性下降而非制度转换；2）所有国家的结构性断点检验均拒绝通胀-注意力关系的对称性假设；3）美国数据显示峰值后阈值更高，但这一结果未能在其他注意力指标下复现。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统检验通胀阈值在通缩阶段的非对称性，揭示通胀注意力机制并非左右对称，丰富了行为宏观经济学中关于注意力分配与通胀动态关系的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行沟通策略与通胀预期管理具有重要启示：降低通胀时公众注意力的消退路径与上升阶段不同，政策制定者需关注这种非对称性对预期锚定的影响。

title: The Right-Skew Puzzle in Chinese Equities
affiliations: Zhejiang University, Zhejiang University and New York University

detail.title: The Right-Skew Puzzle in Chinese Equities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The standardized innovations of daily Chinese A-share returns are predominantly right-skewed — a shape that risk models consume directly, yet one without an established explanation. On 538 CSI 800 constituents (2016–2026), the fitted Hansen skewness is positive for 99.3% of stocks (median +0.095), is robust to asymmetric-volatility filters, survives the exclusion of all price-limit days, and has a Bowley quantile measure of approximately zero: the asymmetry lives purely in the right tail. Two quasi-experiments dissect its causes. The 2020 ChiNext reform doubled daily price limits and sharply cut limit hits (first stage t = -4.4), yet innovation skewness did not move (minimum detectable effect 0.21, or 0.28 standard deviations): price limits are not the cause. Gaining shortability lowers tail skewness in the dominant 2019 margin-list expansion (-0.22, p = 0.02); the pooled estimate across batches is not significant, so we label this evidence suggestive. In the cross-section, right skew concentrates not in classic lottery stocks but in large, ordinarily quiet names with intermittent upside jumps. The bill is paid on the short side: a symmetric t understates 99% short-position Expected Shortfall in every skewness tercile, and the skew-t repair is monotone in the fitted skewness.

AI.tldr: 中国A股日收益率标准化创新呈现显著右偏（99.3%个股正偏，中位数+0.095），该偏度集中于右尾、非价格涨跌停所致，但卖空限制可能是成因之一；右偏集中在大型、平时安静的股票中，且会加剧空头极端损失。
AI.research_question: 中国A股日收益率标准化创新（标准化残差）为何呈现右偏？其成因及经济后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 风险模型通常假设收益率分布对称，但实际A股标准化创新高度右偏，这一现象缺乏理论解释。理解其来源对风险管理（尤其是空头风险）具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: Hansen偏度（有偏t分布）、Bowley分位数偏度；准实验方法（双重差分/工具变量）检验价格限制与卖空限制的因果效应。
AI.method: 基于538只CSI 800成分股（2016-2026）日度数据，拟合Hansen偏度；通过2020年创业板改革（放宽涨跌幅）和2019年融资融券扩容两个准实验进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1) 99.3%个股右偏，中位数偏度+0.095，偏度仅存在于右尾（Bowley偏度≈0）；2) 2020年创业板涨跌幅翻倍后，偏度无显著变化（最小可检测效应0.21）；3) 2019年卖空扩容使可卖空股票偏度下降0.22（p=0.02）；4) 右偏集中于大型、平时安静的股票（非彩票型股票）；5) 对称t分布会低估99%空头期望损失，且低估程度随偏度单调递增。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统解释中国A股标准化收益率右偏现象；区分了价格限制与卖空限制的不同作用；揭示了右偏集中在大型股票而非彩票型股票这一反直觉特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理实践提供指导：对称分布假设会系统性低估空头极端损失，应使用有偏t分布进行尾部风险度量；为监管层理解交易制度（涨跌停、卖空）对收益率分布的影响提供实证依据。

title: NBFI and Government Debt in Asia: Legal and Policy Implications

detail.title: NBFI and Government Debt in Asia: Legal and Policy Implications
detail.abstract:
This paper examines the evolving role of non-bank financial institution (NBFI) in Asian government debt markets and the associated regulatory and systemic challenges. It begins by defining and classifying NBFI, highlighting their growing importance in debt intermediation and providing an overview of government debt markets across key Asian economies, including China (Mainland), Japan, India, Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (Hereinafter SAR), and Singapore. Asia provides an early-warning environment where sovereign–NBFI linkages are growing before crisis-scale amplification seen in advanced economies. The study then analyzes the legal and regulatory landscape, comparing international standards on market access, capital adequacy and prudential oversight with regional practices.

A central focus is on the policy challenges arising from NBFI activities. This thesis began by analyzing the debate to regulate NBFI which includes information asymmetry and the gap of access to central banks between banks and NBFI. Then it’s followed by the discussion on the market trend given the growing reliance on NBFI in the government debt market. Consequently, the paper identifies issues as a result of such a shift.

Based on these findings, the study offers policy recommendations from three perspectives: ex ante mechanisms, ex post mechanisms and continuing regulatory monitoring mechanism to strengthen oversight of NBFI and safeguard financial stability. By integrating lessons from international frameworks and regional experiences, the paper provides a comprehensive perspective on managing NBFI-related risks in government debt markets while maintaining efficient capital allocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非银行金融机构（NBFI）在亚洲政府债务市场中日益重要的角色及其带来的监管和系统性挑战，分析了法律监管环境、政策难题，并从事前、事后和持续性监管三个维度提出了政策建议。
AI.research_question: 非银行金融机构在亚洲政府债务市场中的角色演变带来了哪些监管和系统性挑战？如何构建有效的监管框架来应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 亚洲经济体（如中国、日本、印度、香港、新加坡）中主权与NBFI之间的关联性正在增长，可能成为危机预警环境。在发达经济体出现危机级放大效应之前，研究亚洲NBFI风险具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、银行与非银行金融机构之间的央行准入差异理论、金融系统性风险理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对比国际标准（市场准入、资本充足率、审慎监管）与区域实践；政策分析与案例研究。
AI.findings: 1. NBFI在亚洲政府债务市场中的中介作用日益增强；2. 存在信息不对称和央行准入差异等政策挑战；3. 市场对NBFI依赖度上升带来了系统性风险问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将NBFI监管问题纳入亚洲新兴市场经济体的具体情境，揭示了主权-NBFI关联性在危机放大之前的前瞻性预警特征，丰富了金融中介与系统性风险领域的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三层次政策建议框架：事前机制（预防性监管）、事后机制（危机应对）和持续性监管监控机制，为亚洲经济体管理政府债务市场中NBFI相关风险提供了可操作的政策参考。

title: Whether The Environmental Clearance in India is a Progressive Step towards the Protection of the Environment, or a Disguise in Reality?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Whether The Environmental Clearance in India is a Progressive Step towards the Protection of the Environment, or a Disguise in Reality?
detail.abstract:
One of the most essential instruments of environmental governance in India is the Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), which is intended to make sure that a project's environmental effects are assessed prior to implementation. This preventive approach is reflected in the EIA Notification, 2006, which requires prior environmental clearance for certain projects. However, there are now major concerns about the performance of the environmental regulatory framework due to the increasing practice of ex post facto environmental clearances.

This paper examines the legal and constitutional validity of retrospective environmental clearances in India. It tracks the development of the EIA framework, examines how executive notifications gave rise to the ex post facto clearance regime, and analyses the judicial reactions in important rulings including Alembic Pharmaceuticals, Common Cause, Vanashakti, and CREDAI. The research argues that retroactive clearances violate the goals envisaged by the Environment (Protection) Act of 1986, diminish environmental accountability, and weaken the precautionary principle.

The paper further argues that ex post facto environmental clearances shift environmental assessment from a preventive precaution to a mechanism for regularizing infractions by analysing concepts of delegated legislation, natural justice, legitimate expectation, and the rule of law. It finds that earlier environmental clearance must be viewed as a substantive legal necessity rather than a procedural formality that may be validated retroactively in order for environmental governance to continue to be successful.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度环境治理中事后环境许可（追溯性环评）的法律与合宪性问题，认为这种做法违反了1986年《环境保护法》的立法宗旨，削弱了预防原则和环境问责制，并指出环评应被视为实质性法律要求而非可事后追认的程序性形式。
AI.research_question: 印度追溯性（事后）环境许可的法律与合宪性是否有效？
AI.motivation: 印度环境治理中事后环评的实践日益增多，引发了对其有效性和合法性的重大关切，需要对此进行法律分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 授权立法理论、自然正义原则、合法期待原则、法治原则、预防原则
AI.method: 法律文本分析与案例研究，追踪EIA框架发展历程，分析Alembic Pharmaceuticals、Common Cause、Vanashakti和CREDAI等重要司法判例。
AI.findings: 追溯性环评违反1986年《环境保护法》的立法目标，削弱环境问责制和预防原则；它将环评从预防性措施转变为违规行为合法化的机制；环评应被视为实质性法律要求而非可事后追认的程序性形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 从授权立法、自然正义、合法期待和法治原则等多个法律理论维度，系统论证了追溯性环评的违法性，丰富了环境法领域关于预防原则不可逆性的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度乃至其他发展中国家的环境监管实践提供法律指引，明确事后许可制度的法律缺陷，推动环境治理回归预防性本质。

title: Fundamentals in Management Causal Discussions
affiliations: Australian National University, RSFAS and Australian National University (ANU) - Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Applied Statistics

detail.title: Fundamentals in Management Causal Discussions
detail.abstract: We propose a novel framework of extracting fundamental characteristics from textual data based on causal sentence structures. Preserving the causal relationship by separately extracting topics from cause and effect parts of sentences result in improved information processing compared to simple topic analyses. Peer firms identified from this causality-based topic analysis show strong return comovement both at the monthly level and around earnings announcements. Returns of smaller firms, more central firms, firms with higher market beta and idiosyncratic volatility can be predicted by their peers' returns. Fundamental news seems to travel more from bigger firms to their smaller, less transparent peers with simpler operations, and from earlier announcers to their later announcing peers. Evidence supports the efficacy of considering causal sentence structures in extracting information.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于因果句结构从文本中提取企业特征的新方法，通过分别提取句子中原因和结果部分的主题，识别出同侪企业。研究发现，这些同侪企业的月度和盈余公告期间收益率存在显著联动，且信息从大企业流向小企业、从早公告者流向晚公告者。
AI.research_question: 如何利用文本中的因果句结构更有效地提取企业特征并识别同侪企业？
AI.motivation: 传统主题分析忽略句子中的因果关系，导致信息提取效率有限。作者试图通过保留因果结构来改进文本信息提取，并检验其在金融领域的应用价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果句结构分析、文本主题建模、同侪企业识别、收益率联动（return comovement）
AI.method: 从文本中提取因果句结构，分别对原因部分和结果部分进行主题建模；基于因果主题相似性识别同侪企业；通过月度收益率、盈余公告事件进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）因果主题识别的同侪企业存在显著的月度收益联动和盈余公告联动；（2）小型企业、中心度高的企业、高市场beta和高特质波动企业的收益率可被同侪预测；（3）信息从大企业流向更小、透明度更低、运营更简单的同侪；（4）信息从早公告者流向晚公告者。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将因果句结构引入文本分析和企业特征提取，证明因果主题分析优于传统主题分析，丰富了文本挖掘在金融中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业同侪识别提供更精确的文本方法；帮助投资者通过同侪收益率预测特定企业（特别是小企业和高波动企业）的收益；揭示信息传递机制，有助于监管和市场效率研究。

title: NetZeroNomy: A Unified Net-Growth Formula Integrating Four-Component Capital, Governance Efficiency, and Mandatory Depletion Accounting
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: NetZeroNomy: A Unified Net-Growth Formula Integrating Four-Component Capital, Governance Efficiency, and Mandatory Depletion Accounting
detail.abstract:
Background: Gross Domestic Product (GDP), the dominant economic measure since Kuznets (1934), systematically excludes natural capital depletion, governance quality, and the multiplicative dynamics of sectoral integration. Despite decades of critique and alternatives including the Inclusive Wealth Index (UNEP, 2023), the Genuine Progress Indicator, and Doughnut Economics (Raworth, 2017), no prior framework has proposed a single mathematically unified formula capturing all four deficiencies simultaneously.
Methods: We derive NetZeroNomy v3.1, a formula for Net Economic Energy (Enet) that integrates: (i) a four-component capital base Capt = Captn + Capth + Captm + Capts, calibrated against SEEA (UN et al., 2021) and IWI (UNEP, 2023); (ii) a governance confidence gate G(p) ∈ [0,1] as a structural multiplicative operator; (iii) a four-vector sectoral synthesis term Vⁿ with integration depth n = Σᵢωᵢ; and (iv) a mandatory depletion penalty ΔCapt(−) = Σᵢ max(0, Captᵢ(t−1) − Captᵢ(t)). A formal sustainability constraint S(t) ⊇ S(t−1) is derived from the Brundtland definition (WCED, 1987).
Results: The formula satisfies three scientific consistency conditions: precision (each symbol has exactly one referent), consistency (no double-counting across terms), and completeness (no hidden assumptions). Applied to the Ho Chi Minh City – Binh Duong – Vung Tau mega-region, the framework predicts that raising G(p) from 0.32 to 0.68 and increasing integration depth n from 1.1 to 2.8 would produce Enet growth exceeding 11–13% per annum without additional capital investment.
Conclusions: NetZeroNomy offers the first growth theory in which sustainability and economic expansion are structurally inseparable rather than traded off. The framework is empirically tractable, policy-actionable, and positions ΔCapt (−) as the critical unmeasured variable in current national accounts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了NetZeroNomy v3.1公式，通过整合四类资本、治理置信度门控、部门合成向量和强制性耗减惩罚，构建了一个将可持续性与经济增长在结构上不可分割的统一经济测度框架，并在胡志明市-平阳-头顿大都市区进行了应用模拟。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能同时弥补传统GDP在自然资本耗减、治理质量、部门整合乘数动态及可持续性约束四方面缺陷的统一数学公式？
AI.motivation: 自Kuznets（1934）以来的GDP指标系统性地排除了自然资本耗减、治理质量和部门整合的乘数动态；尽管已有多种替代指标，但尚无一个单一数学统一公式能同时解决这四方面缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: NetZeroNomy v3.1框架，整合了四类资本基础（自然、人力、人造、社会）、治理置信度门控G(p)∈[0,1]作为结构性乘数算子、四向量部门合成项Vⁿ以及强制性耗减惩罚ΔCapt(−)，并基于布伦特兰定义推导了形式可持续性约束。
AI.method: 理论推导与公式构建：提出Net Economic Energy (Enet)公式，包含四类资本、治理门控、部门整合及耗减惩罚四项子项，并验证了精确性、一致性和完备性三个科学一致性条件。最后在胡志明市-平阳-头顿大都市区进行了应用模拟。
AI.findings: 公式满足精确性、一致性和完备性条件。在胡志明市-平阳-头顿大都市区的模拟显示，将治理置信度从0.32提升至0.68、整合深度从1.1提升至2.8，可在不增加资本投入的情况下实现年增长率超过11-13%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出可持续性与经济增长在结构上不可分割而非权衡取舍的增长理论；将耗减惩罚ΔCapt(−)定位为当前国民账户中关键却未测量的变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 框架具有经验可操作性和政策可实施性；为大都市区发展提供了提升治理质量和部门整合深度以驱动可持续增长的具体政策路径。

title:
From Pay-per-Call to Flat Rate:
Two-part Tariffs, Deadweight Loss, and Surplus Distribution in Indian Telecom
affiliations: Indian institute of technology delhi

detail.title:
From Pay-per-Call to Flat Rate:
Two-part Tariffs, Deadweight Loss, and Surplus Distribution in Indian Telecom
detail.abstract: India's telecom sector underwent a structural transformation after Reliance Jio's entry in September 2016, shifting the industry from per-minute and per-megabyte pricing to bundled flat-rate plans. This paper uses the theory of two-part tariffs to examine whether Indian telecom pricing, before and after Jio's disruption, can be read through the lens of surplus extraction, deadweight loss, and market power. The central argument is that the pre-Jio pricing regime, characterized by high per-unit charges and negligible fixed fees, was consistent with a monopolist operating well above marginal cost and generating substantial deadweight loss. Jio's entry forced prices toward marginal cost and restructured the industry's tariff design into something much closer to the two-part ideal: a fixed monthly subscription paired with effectively zero per-unit charges on voice and data. This shift reduced deadweight loss and reallocated surplus from incumbent firms to consumers, though at the cost of severe revenue compression across the industry. The postconsolidation period after 2021, as a reduced set of three private operators has steadily raised fixed fees, represents a partial reversal of these gains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用两部收费制理论，分析印度电信业在Reliance Jio进入前后（2016年）的定价结构变化。Jio的进入将行业从高单位费、低月费的垄断定价模式，转变为低单位费、高月费的两部收费模式，减少了无谓损失并将剩余从企业重新分配给消费者，但2021年后的市场整合导致固定费用上升，部分逆转了这些收益。
AI.research_question: 印度电信业在Reliance Jio进入前后，其定价结构如何通过两部收费制的理论框架（剩余榨取、无谓损失、市场势力）进行解读？
AI.motivation: 印度电信业在Jio进入后经历了结构性变革，但缺乏从两部收费制理论视角系统分析定价模式转变及其福利效应的研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两部收费制（Two-Part Tariff）理论，包括剩余榨取（surplus extraction）、无谓损失（deadweight loss）和市场势力（market power）等核心概念。
AI.method: 理论分析结合行业案例研究，运用两部收费制理论框架对印度电信业Jio进入前后的定价模式进行对比分析。
AI.findings: 1. Jio进入前：高单位费+低月费，符合垄断者高边际成本定价，产生大量无谓损失；2. Jio进入后：低单位费+固定月费，接近两部收费制理想模式，减少无谓损失，消费者剩余增加；3. 2021年后市场整合，三大运营商提高固定费用，部分逆转了福利改善。
AI.theory_contributions: 将两部收费制理论应用于新兴市场电信行业的结构变革分析，展示了理论在现实产业组织转型中的解释力，并揭示了竞争进入如何推动定价从垄断定价向两部收费制收敛。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信监管机构提供了定价结构影响消费者福利的分析框架；揭示了市场竞争如何通过定价模式创新减少无谓损失；警示市场集中度回升可能导致消费者福利的逆向变化。

reference: HRC Journal of Economics and Finance, Volume 2, Issue 1 (Jan-March, 2024) ISSN: 2583-8814 (Online)
title: Is a Land Restoration Boom Required in India?
affiliations: IIM Jammu and University of Delhi

detail.title: Is a Land Restoration Boom Required in India?

publicationDetails.detailsText: HRC Journal of Economics and Finance, Volume 2, Issue 1 (Jan-March, 2024) ISSN: 2583-8814 (Online)

detail.abstract: India's forest policy aims to achieve a 33% tree cover nationwide, yet the current tree cover stands at 24.56% as reported in the ISFR 2021 report. As per official sources, a major focus for achieving this target has been put on the Trees outside forest (TOF) regions. Despite witnessing extensive tree planting within short durations, concerns about their sustainability persist. Research has highlighted the dismal failure of such initiatives due to factors such as inadequate maintenance, low survival rates, insufficient study on suitable saplings, and the absence of post-evaluation reports. This paper thereby proposes land restoration companies as a potential solution to assist India in realizing its ambitious targets. Their maintenance ethic is what differentiates them and gives them a comparatively higher success rate. Further, by breaking down the economics behind these companies, the paper tries to prove how they are more cost-effective than initiatives taken up by the government in the long run. Lastly, the research delves into the challenges encountered by such companies, specifically examining funding and land-related issues. The study culminates by proposing measures necessary to bolster a restoration boom in India.

AI.tldr: 印度森林覆盖率目标为33%，目前仅24.56%。论文提出以土地修复公司替代政府主导的植树计划，因其维护机制更好、长期成本效益更高，并分析了资金和土地等挑战及应对措施。
AI.research_question: 土地修复公司能否作为有效解决方案，帮助印度实现33%森林覆盖率目标？
AI.motivation: 印度政府大规模植树计划因缺乏维护、存活率低等问题屡屡失败，而官方将希望寄托于"林地以外的树木"（TOF）区域，亟需更可持续的替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于成本效益分析、维护伦理与组织激励机制，比较政府主导与市场化土地修复公司的长期绩效差异。
AI.method: 通过经济学分析拆解土地修复公司的运营成本与收益，并与政府项目进行对比；同时定性分析资金、土地等现实挑战。
AI.findings: 土地修复公司的维护伦理使其成活率显著高于政府项目；长期来看，这些公司比政府主导的植树计划更具成本效益；但面临资金不足和土地利用等关键障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 将市场化组织（土地修复公司）引入森林恢复领域，拓展了环境治理与公共品供给的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家提供可操作的政策建议：通过扶持土地修复公司、解决资金与土地问题，推动森林恢复热潮。

title: Personnel Professionalization and Judge Performance: Evidence from China's Judge Quota Reform
affiliations: , School of Economics, Jinan University and

detail.title: Personnel Professionalization and Judge Performance: Evidence from China's Judge Quota Reform
detail.abstract: Do personnel professionalization reforms that remove lower-ability bureaucrats enhance or reduce performance? In a tournament-theoretic model, these reforms seek to improve performance through selection of higher-ability agents. However, they also alter incentives for remaining incumbents: peer pressure increases effort, while reduced competition decreases it, leading to an ambiguous net effect. We investigate this question by exploiting China's 2014 Judge Quota Reform, a largescale professionalization that eliminated approximately 40% of judges. Using a novel dataset of over sixteen million first-instance judgements from about 2,700 courts, we find that a one-percentage-point increase in the judge elimination rate improves performance (proxied by lower textual similarity between judgements) by 0.05 percentage points. A magnitude accounting reveals that the positive selection effect dominates the net negative influence from altered effort incentives. Our results manifest a critical trade-off in state capacity building: the lasting benefit of a higher-ability workforce incurs a persistent cost by weakening effort incentives, underscoring the necessity of complementary incentive structures in reform designs.

AI.tldr: 利用中国2014年法官配额改革（淘汰约40%法官）的自然实验，基于2700家法院1600万份一审判决数据，发现法官淘汰率每提升1个百分点，判决质量（以文本相似度降低衡量）提升0.05个百分点。正向筛选效应主导了激励变化带来的净负效应，揭示了国家能力建设中高素质劳动力与弱化努力激励之间的持久权衡。
AI.research_question: 人事专业化改革中淘汰低能力官僚，究竟是提升还是降低了组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 锦标赛理论下，淘汰低能力官员可通过筛选高能力代理人提升绩效，但同时会改变留任者的激励：同伴压力增加努力，而竞争减少则降低努力，净效应不明确。现有研究缺乏对这两种机制分离的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锦标赛理论（Tournament Theory）：分析筛选效应（selection effect）与激励效应（incentive effect）的权衡。筛选效应指淘汰低能力者后高能力者的正向绩效贡献；激励效应包括同伴压力（peer pressure）的正向影响和竞争减少（reduced competition）的负向影响。
AI.method: 利用中国2014年法官配额改革作为准自然实验，采用工具变量法（Instrumental Variable），基于约2700家法院1600万份一审判决书的文本相似度作为绩效代理变量，进行因果推断和量级分解。
AI.findings: 法官淘汰率每增加1个百分点，判决文本相似度降低0.05个百分点（即绩效提升）；正向筛选效应主导了激励变化带来的净负向影响；改革带来持久的高能力劳动力红利，但同时也因弱化努力激励而产生持续成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在人事专业化改革背景下分离并量化了筛选效应与激励效应；补充了锦标赛理论中关于竞争者减少如何影响留任者努力的争论；揭示了国家能力建设中"能力-激励"权衡的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国司法改革（尤其是法官配额制）提供了量化评估证据；为其他国家或组织的官僚专业化改革设计提供了启示：单纯依靠人员筛选可能不够，需要配套的激励结构设计以抵消竞争减弱带来的努力下降。

title: Common Vendors and Systemic Cyber Risk in Banking
affiliations: Aalto University School of Business and

detail.title: Common Vendors and Systemic Cyber Risk in Banking
detail.abstract: Banks increasingly rely on common technology vendors, trading scale economies for shared exposure. Because a widely used vendor is a more valuable target for a strategic attacker, outsourcing raises systemic risk through a single point of failure. Two distortions follow. Banks and vendors internalize their own losses but ignore those borne by depositors and customers, so the market over-concentrates. Deposit insurance prevents runs but weakens the private discipline that vendor pricing would otherwise provide. Correcting both requires pricing concentration at its marginal external cost-through capital, vendor charges, or vendor liability-a prescription that extends to other shared financial infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 银行依赖共同技术供应商虽然获得规模经济，但也带来共享风险敞口。由于广泛使用的供应商对战略攻击者更具价值，外包通过单点故障提高了系统性风险，导致市场过度集中，而存款保险进一步削弱了私人约束机制。
AI.research_question: 银行对外包共同技术供应商的依赖如何影响系统性风险，以及如何纠正市场失灵？
AI.motivation: 银行越来越多地依赖共同技术供应商，在获得规模经济的同时也面临共享风险敞口，这种集中化外包可能产生系统性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单点故障理论；系统性风险；市场失灵与外部性理论；存款保险的道德风险理论。
AI.method: 理论分析模型，基于博弈论或微观经济学的推理分析。
AI.findings: 1）市场过度集中于少数技术供应商；2）存款保险削弱了供应商定价本应提供的私人约束；3）需要通过资本要求、供应商收费或供应商责任来按边际外部成本对集中度定价。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术外包的单点故障风险纳入系统性风险分析框架，揭示了外包集中化导致市场失灵的双重扭曲机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了纠正银行外包集中度问题的政策工具（资本要求、供应商收费或供应商责任），可推广至其他共享金融基础设施。

title: Spatiotemporal Simulation of Multi-Operator Regional Transit Using GTFS Data: An R Pipeline for Public Participation in Transportation Policy
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Spatiotemporal Simulation of Multi-Operator Regional Transit Using GTFS Data: An R Pipeline for Public Participation in Transportation Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The accurate visualization of regional public transit is essential for sustainable urban planning and evidence-based policymaking. Many municipalities still face "data deserts" where official General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) data is unestablished or its publication has been discontinued, while existing dynamic simulation tools often rely on complex, server-side infrastructure that presents high barriers to entry. This study presents a lightweight, infrastructure-free R-based pipeline that automatically converts static GTFS data into dynamic GeoJSON formats, enabling flicker-free spatiotemporal transit visualization. The pipeline's efficacy is demonstrated by constructing an integrated, multi-operator regional transit simulator for Chita City, Higashiura Town, Obu City, and commercial Chita Bus lines. Additionally, an ongoing, experimental pilot model for Agui Town—where official GTFS distribution has been discontinued—is briefly presented to illustrate the technical boundaries and challenges of third-party data reconstruction from public documents. The pipeline affords a reproducible baseline platform for the evaluation of cross-boundary transit connectivity and collaborative consensus-building.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个轻量级、无基础设施依赖的R语言管道，能将静态GTFS数据自动转换为动态GeoJSON格式，实现无闪烁的时空交通可视化。以知多地区多城市为案例验证了其有效性，并探讨了在GTFS数据中断区域的第三方数据重建挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个轻量级、无需服务器端基础设施的管道，将静态GTFS数据转换为动态GeoJSON格式，以实现区域公共交通的准确可视化？
AI.motivation: 许多城市面临"数据荒漠"问题（官方GTFS数据未建立或已停止发布），而现有动态模拟工具依赖复杂的服务器端基础设施，准入门槛高。
AI.theoretical_framework: 静态GTFS数据动态化转换理论、时空交通可视化方法、开放数据重建方法论
AI.method: 开发基于R语言的轻量级管道，将静态GTFS数据自动转换为动态GeoJSON格式；以日本知多市、东浦町、大府市及商业知多巴士线路为案例进行实证；并对GTFS已中断的阿久比町进行实验性第三方数据重建试点。
AI.findings: 成功构建了多运营商区域交通模拟器，实现了无闪烁的时空可视化；在GTFS数据中断区域，第三方数据重建面临技术边界和挑战，但仍可作为跨边界交通连通性评估的可复现基线平台。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了轻量级、可复现的静态GTFS数据动态化转换方法论，拓展了数据荒漠情境下的交通可视化理论实践边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为缺乏GTFS数据的城市提供了低门槛的动态交通可视化工具，支持可持续城市规划、循证决策及跨区域交通连通性评估与共识构建。

title: Commonwealth and War: Body, Bond, and the Default of Plural Sovereignty

detail.title: Commonwealth and War: Body, Bond, and the Default of Plural Sovereignty
detail.abstract: The idea of the commonwealth has named two different things. It has named a body: a multitude united under a common power for a common good, from Cicero's res publica to Hobbes's civitas. And it has named a bond: an association of sovereigns who share a good without sharing a power, from the Achaean koinon to the Commonwealth of Nations and the Commonwealth of Independent States. This paper tests both forms against the problem each was meant to solve, the problem of war. Drawing on bargaining theory, I show that a definable class of goods whose value derives from being taken without consent cannot enter any bargain; that coercion consumes the room for agreement to a finite point of no return; and that war is therefore the default output of any plurality of armed sovereignties, however thickly bonded. The two modern commonwealths of states supply the natural experiment, and war between members recurred in both. The body fares no better at the global scale, since a single world commonwealth would maximise the organisational capture that manufactures war from within. The concept's own history then does what neither form can do alone: the commonwealths of Cicero, of Hobbes, and of Kant's warning name three distinct types of the world body, and the type, not the bare existence, determines what its violence becomes. The commonwealth, I conclude, is best understood not as an answer but as the standing question of how to hold plurality to a common good.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"共同体"的两种形式（作为统一体的共同体和作为联合体的共同体），通过讨价还价理论论证两者均无法解决战争问题，最终指出共同体不是答案，而是如何将多元性维系于共同善的永恒问题。
AI.research_question: "共同体"的两种形式（统一体与联合体）能否解决战争问题？
AI.motivation: "共同体"概念在历史上指代两种不同事物（统一体与联合体），但两者在面对战争问题时均存在根本性缺陷，需要系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 讨价还价理论（bargaining theory）
AI.method: 概念史分析结合讨价还价理论论证，辅以现代国家共同体的自然实验（英联邦、独联体内部战争案例）。
AI.findings: 1. 有一类价值来源于"未经同意而获取"的善无法进入任何讨价还价；2. 强制将协议空间压缩至有限的不归点；3. 战争是多元武装主权体的默认输出；4. 单一世界共同体将最大化组织性俘获，从内部制造战争；5. 共同体类型（而非存在本身）决定其暴力形态。
AI.theory_contributions: 将讨价还价理论引入国际关系与政治哲学，揭示了战争作为多元主权体默认输出的结构性根源；区分了共同体的三种类型（西塞罗式、霍布斯式、康德式警告）。
AI.practical_contributions: 对英联邦、独联体等国家间共同体的内部战争持续性提供了结构性解释；对全球治理中的世界政府构想提出警示。

title: One Person Companies in India: A Decadal Assessment 2014-2024
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad

detail.title: One Person Companies in India: A Decadal Assessment 2014-2024
detail.abstract: One Person Company (OPC) was introduced in India under the Companies Act, 2013, and registrations began in 2014 with the first official data release in 2015. An OPC is defined as a company that has a single shareholder. By design, OPCs are meant to offer sole proprietors the benefits of a corporate structure, including a separate legal identity, limited liability, the ability to convert into other types of companies, along with minimal administrative burdens and compliance requirements. OPCs, have been in existence for over a decade, and amendments to the law are now being contemplated. This study outlines the legal framework governing OPCs and undertakes an empirical analysis of key performance parameters over the ten-year period from 2014 to 2024.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度2014-2024年“一人公司”（OPC）的法律框架与绩效表现，为即将到来的法律修订提供实证依据。
AI.research_question: 印度一人公司（OPC）在法律框架下的十年绩效表现如何？
AI.motivation: OPC已在印度运行超过十年，法律修订正在进行中，但缺乏对其绩效的系统性实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一人公司理论、公司治理理论、有限责任与法人独立人格理论
AI.method: 法律框架梳理与2014-2024年关键绩效指标的实证分析
AI.findings: OPC为独资经营者提供了独立法人身份、有限责任等公司结构优势，且行政负担较轻；研究呈现了十年间的关键绩效参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了新兴经济体一人公司长期绩效的理论证据，丰富了公司法律形式选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度OPC法律修订提供实证依据，为政策制定者和创业者提供决策参考。

title: The Consumer Value of Ad Personalization: Evidence from Meta
affiliations: Meta Platforms Inc, Northwestern University and Northwestern University

detail.title: The Consumer Value of Ad Personalization: Evidence from Meta

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Deisenroth and Manjeer are employees of Meta and own stock in that company. Wernerfelt is a part-time contractor for data access; his salary is donated to charity.

detail.abstract: An apparent tension that has emerged in regulating digital advertising centers on the use of detailed consumer data. If advertisers can use more data in their ad delivery, there is evidence ad effectiveness will increase; in contrast, some believe the use of such data may pose potential privacy risks or other harms to consumers. These privacy concerns have motivated a large share of regulation around the world, yet there is little evidence on how consumers actually value being served ads based on more versus less data. In this paper, we conduct a large-scale field experiment with 12 million Facebook users where some were randomly assigned to receive less personalized ads. Our treatment condition leverages the 'less personalized ads' experience that Meta created in response to demands from the European Commission. Combining both log data and custom surveys, we estimate effects on more than 40 outcome variables to paint a holistic picture of the consumer experience. We have two main findings. First, under decreased ad personalization, not only do the average levels of ad engagement fall substantially, but users report both less satisfaction with their ads experience and a decreased user valuation for the platform overall. Second, leveraging detailed user demographics from Meta, we conduct a heterogeneity analysis to study if any sizable subgroups exist that appear to increase their engagement meaningfully under decreased ad personalization. We find no evidence of such groups. Net, our results are consistent with ad personalization in this context conveying benefits, not costs, to consumers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对1200万Facebook用户进行大规模田野实验，发现减少广告个性化不仅显著降低了广告参与度，还使用户对广告体验和平台整体评价下降，且未发现任何用户子群从中受益，表明广告个性化对消费者而言利大于弊。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何看待基于更多数据与更少数据的定向广告？减少广告个性化对消费者福利（满意度、平台估值等）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 全球监管机构因隐私担忧限制数字广告中的数据使用，但缺乏证据表明消费者实际如何评价基于更多数据与更少数据的广告体验，存在监管与消费者真实偏好之间的潜在张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广告个性化与消费者福利理论、隐私悖论理论
AI.method: 大规模田野实验：1200万Facebook用户随机分组，实验组接收Meta为回应欧盟要求而设计的“较少个性化广告”体验；结合日志数据与定制调查，测量40多个结果变量，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）减少广告个性化导致广告参与度显著下降，用户对广告体验满意度降低，对平台整体估值下降；（2）异质性分析未发现任何用户子群在减少个性化后参与度显著提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过大规模随机实验直接检验消费者对广告个性化的真实偏好，挑战了“隐私担忧必然意味着消费者偏好更少个性化广告”的默认假设，为广告个性化与消费者福利的关系提供了因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球数字广告监管政策（尤其是欧盟相关法规）提供实证依据，提示监管者在制定数据使用限制时需权衡其对消费者体验和平台价值的潜在负面影响。

title: When is a Composite Response a Structural Primitive?

detail.title: When is a Composite Response a Structural Primitive?
detail.abstract: A local response is often used as if it were a structural primitive: observe how behavior moves under one incentive, then ask what would happen under another. This paper asks when that step is valid. The di!culty is that an observed response is a composite of productivity, cost, measurement, and capacity primitives. It remains a faithful object only on domains where those primitives move together. At a frontier-a capacity limit, an eligibility threshold, or a notch-the response can fan out into distinct components and stop supporting the counterfactual. I characterize the response's validity domain, the counterfactuals that survive after fan-out, and the minimal regime information that restores a point answer. The framework is a triage step between the general Lucas warning and bespoke structural modeling: a pre-structural diagnostic for fan-out, a specification-free identified set for what survives, and the least extra object that repairs the counterfactual. A public-data diagnostic at the conforming-loan limit, where a documented response is known to be composite, illustrates how the object is visible in administrative data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究何时可以将局部响应（local response）视为结构性变量用于反事实推断，指出在边界（容量限制、资格门槛、断点）处响应会分解为不同成分，不再支持反事实分析。作者提出了响应的有效性域、分解后的识别集，以及修复反事实所需的最小额外信息。
AI.research_question: 局部响应在什么条件下可以作为结构性变量用于反事实推断？当响应在边界处分解时，哪些反事实仍然有效？如何修复失效的反事实推断？
AI.motivation: 经济学研究中常将局部响应视为结构性变量进行反事实分析，但该做法是否成立缺乏严格检验。作者希望提供一个介于Lucas批判（完全质疑）和定制化结构模型（高成本）之间的"预结构诊断"工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 响应分解理论：局部响应是生产率、成本、测量和容量等原始成分的复合体；边界（frontier）处响应会"扇出"（fan out）为不同成分；有效性域（validity domain）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：定义响应的有效性域，刻画扇出后的反事实识别集，提出最小修复条件。实证应用：使用合规贷款限额（conforming-loan limit）的公共数据诊断响应分解现象。
AI.findings: 在边界处（容量限制、资格门槛、断点），局部响应会扇出为不同原始成分，不再忠实反映结构性关系；部分反事实在扇出后仍然有效；通过增加最小额外信息（如边界处的行为变化）可以修复反事实推断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"预结构诊断"框架，填补了Lucas批判与全结构模型之间的方法论空白；系统刻画了局部响应失效的条件及修复路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了一个实用的诊断工具，帮助判断在何种情况下可以利用已有响应进行反事实推断，以及在响应分解后如何获取有效识别集或修复反事实。

title:
Evaluating the Adoption Rate of Climate-resilient Farming Practices in Rural Maharashtra: 
A Case Study of RRI Skill and Knowledge foundation Interventions

detail.title:
Evaluating the Adoption Rate of Climate-resilient Farming Practices in Rural Maharashtra: 
A Case Study of RRI Skill and Knowledge foundation Interventions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they are affiliated with the RRI Skill and Knowledge Foundation, the institution responsible for the agricultural training interventions evaluated in this study. This research was conducted to evaluate program efficacy, and the authors declare no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have inappropriately influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: For this case study, verbal and written informed consent was obtained from all participating farmers prior to data collection. Field metrics and household performance parameters have been strictly anonymized to protect participant privacy.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported and funded through the internal institutional resources and program budgets of the RRI Skill and Knowledge Foundation.

detail.abstract:
Smallholder farmers in the semi-arid West Maharashtra region face severe and accelerating climate vulnerabilities, compounded by extreme structural dependencies on volatile chemical-input cash crop systems. This paper presents an empirical impact evaluation of a targeted, multi-tiered behavioral and technical training intervention deployed by the RRI Skill and Knowledge Foundation across a sample of N = 240 agrarian households (consisting of 120 treatment and 120 control farmers). Utilizing a robust Difference-inDifferences (DiD) estimation framework, we analyze multiseason variations in agronomic productivity, total operational expenditures (OpEx), and net household profitability across three regional anchor crops: Cotton (Kapas), Soybean, and Pigeon Pea (Tur). 

Our behavioral framework evaluates the efficacy of community-embedded Vikas Mitras (peer agricultural leads) and seasonally aligned micro-learning modules engineered to systematically reduce the acute risk premiums and loss aversion that typically stymie organic transition processes. The empirical results reveal an elegant economic paradox: while initial transition phases experience a planned stabilization or marginal compression in absolute crop yields (ranging from 4.17% to 9.33%), the complete eradication of commercial synthetic inputs yields a profound, systemic reduction in out-of-pocket operational expenditures (ranging from 45.24% to 53.16%). Consequently, net farm profitability increases immediately and significantly across all three crop portfolios. Furthermore, the localized decentralization of bio-input formulation effectively insulates smallholders from exploitative informal credit channels, providing a highly scalable, financially autonomous operational blueprint for regional climate adaptation policies across semi-arid developing economies.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了印度西马哈拉施特拉邦半干旱地区小农户接受的多层次行为与技术培训干预效果。利用240户农户（120处理组 vs 120对照组）的双重差分分析发现：尽管转型初期作物产量小幅下降（4.17%-9.33%），但完全淘汰化学合成投入使运营支出大幅降低（45.24%-53.16%），农业净盈利立即显著提升。社区嵌入式同伴推广制（Vikas Mitras）和季节微学习模块有效降低了农户损失厌恶等行为障碍，推动有机转型。
AI.research_question: 针对半干旱地区小农户，多层次行为与技术培训干预能否在降低化学投入依赖的同时提升农业净盈利？农户损失厌恶和风险溢价等行为障碍如何被干预机制克服？
AI.motivation: 半干旱地区小农户面临严重的气候脆弱性和对化学投入现金作物的结构性依赖，亟需可规模化、经济自主的气候适应方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的损失厌恶与风险溢价理论；有机转型的过渡经济学（短期产量下降 vs 长期成本节约与盈利提升）。
AI.method: 双重差分（Difference-in-Differences, DiD）估计框架；样本量N=240（120处理组+120对照组）；分析多季节数据，覆盖棉花、大豆、木豆三种作物。
AI.findings: 1) 转型初期产量小幅下降4.17%-9.33%；2) 运营支出大幅降低45.24%-53.16%；3) 净盈利立即显著提升；4) 生物投入本地化生产切断了对高利贷等非正规信贷渠道的依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"产量小幅下降→成本大幅降低→净盈利立即提升"的经济悖论，证实了行为干预（社区同伴推广+微学习）在克服有机转型行为障碍中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为半干旱发展中国家提供了可规模化、财务自主的气候适应操作蓝图，验证了Vikas Mitras同伴推广模式与生物投入本地化生产的实践可行性。

title: Price Dispersion and Inflation: New Cross-sectoral and International Evidence

detail.title: Price Dispersion and Inflation: New Cross-sectoral and International Evidence
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between price dispersion and inflation, shedding light on one major source of the cost of high inflation. By analyzing novel product-level web-scraped data from over 60,000 restaurants and supermarkets across 18 countries facing high and low inflation periods, I uncover new evidence of a significant positive correlation between inflation and price dispersion. My findings reveal that the average annualized inflation, ranging between zero and 20 percentage points across countries within a condensed time frame, is significantly associated with higher price dispersion in both the restaurant and supermarket sectors. The estimates indicate that the marginal effect of suboptimal inflation on product-level distortions is positive, economically significant in all inflation environments and heterogeneous across sectors. Cross-sectionally, I find that an increase of annualized inflation from zero to 10 percent increases inefficient price dispersion for supermarkets by 46% and for restaurants by 73%. Finally, the relationship between inflation and price dispersion does not flatten much at higher inflation, so that the marginal cost of additional inflation does not vanish as inflation rises -- a pattern standard menu-cost models do not generate. This indicates a sustained impact of inflation on price dispersion, implying that accommodating higher inflation levels incurs substantial welfare costs.

AI.tldr: 本文利用来自18个国家6万多家餐厅和超市的产品级网页抓取数据，发现通胀与价格离散之间存在显著正相关关系，且这种关系在高通胀环境下并未减弱，表明高通胀会带来持续的福利成本。
AI.research_question: 通胀与价格离散之间的关系是什么？这种关系在高通胀环境下是否会减弱？
AI.motivation: 揭示高通胀成本的一个重要来源——价格离散，为标准菜单成本模型无法解释的现象提供实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格离散理论、菜单成本模型、通胀福利成本理论
AI.method: 利用来自18个国家60,000多家餐厅和超市的产品级网页抓取数据，进行跨国跨部门的面板数据分析，估计通胀对价格离散的边际效应。
AI.findings: （1）通胀与价格离散显著正相关；（2）年化通胀从0%升至10%时，超市和餐厅的低效价格离散分别增加46%和73%；（3）通胀与价格离散的关系在高通胀环境下并未减弱，这与标准菜单成本模型的预测不符。
AI.theory_contributions: 发现通胀与价格离散的关系在高通胀下并未减弱，挑战了标准菜单成本模型的预测，表明通胀的边际福利成本不会随通胀上升而消失。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：容忍更高通胀水平会带来持续的福利成本，应谨慎对待通胀目标的上调。

title: Ostrovskii's Arithmetic of Probability Laws
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Ostrovskii's Arithmetic of Probability Laws
detail.abstract: The arithmetic of probability laws studies factorization of measures under convolution. The analogy with integer arithmetic is real but breaks in three ways: factorization is not unique, indecomposable laws are abundant, and the whole theory is analytic, because factoring a law means factoring its characteristic function. We give a proof-oriented account from Cramér (1936) through Khinchin, Linnik and Marcinkiewicz, then survey I.V. Ostrovskii's program (1960s-1990s): the class I 0 of laws without indecomposable components, ridgefunction generalizations of Marcinkiewicz's theorem, the resolution of Linnik's conjectures on the class L, the multidimensional theory, the class I α 0 , the zero sets of entire characteristic functions, and Kingman's semigroup. Throughout we supply the analytic background-Hadamard factorization, the strip of analyticity, Phragmén-Lindelöf indicators, Nevanlinna deficiency-needed to read the statements. We close with the links to the Laguerre-Pólya class and the Riemann Ξ-function, to Pólya frequency functions and total positivity, to generalized gamma convolutions and Thorin measures, and to arithmetic on abelian groups.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了概率测度算术理论（卷积分解）的发展脉络，从Cramér（1936）到Ostrovskii的研究计划，涵盖Linnik猜想、多维理论、整特征函数零点集等主题，并建立了与Laguerre-Pólya类、Riemann Ξ函数、Pólya频率函数、广义伽马卷积及阿贝尔群算术的联系。
AI.research_question: 概率测度在卷积运算下的分解算术定律是什么？整数算术类比在哪些方面失效？如何从解析角度（特征函数因式分解）建立完整理论？
AI.motivation: 概率测度卷积分解与整数算术存在深刻类比，但面临分解唯一性缺失、不可分解测度大量存在、需解析工具处理三大挑战，因此需要一个完整、以证明为导向的理论综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 卷积分解算术理论、Cramér定理、Khinchin-Linnik-Marcinkiewicz理论、Ostrovskii的I₀类、脊函数（ridge function）推广、Linnik关于L类的猜想、多维概率测度理论、整函数Hadamard因式分解、解析带（strip of analyticity）、Phragmén-Lindelöf指标、Nevanlinna亏值理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与历史分析，以证明为导向的系统梳理，融合概率论、复分析和调和分析的数学工具。
AI.findings: 概率测度算术与整数算术的类比在三个方面失效：分解不唯一、不可分解成分丰富、理论本质是解析的（需处理特征函数因式分解）。Ostrovskii的I₀类（无不分解成分的测度族）及其推广I⁰_α、Marcinkiewicz定理的脊函数推广、Linnik关于L类猜想的分辨、多维测度算术理论、整特征函数零点集的研究、Kingman半群等构成了该领域的核心成果。这些理论还连接了Laguerre-Pólya类、Riemann Ξ函数、Pólya频率函数、广义伽马卷积（Thorin测度）以及阿贝尔群上的算术。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合概率测度卷积分解理论，明确整数算术类比的三重失效机制，统一呈现Ostrovskii研究计划的完整图景，建立概率测度算术与解析函数论（整函数、指标理论）之间的深层联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为概率论学者提供该领域的完整阅读指南和证明导向的参考文献；为应用数学（如总正性理论、广义伽马卷积在金融和物理学中的应用）提供理论基础。

title: Stablecoin Depegging, Financial Intermediary Balance Sheet Constraints, and Liquidity in the U.S. Traditional Money Market
affiliations: East China Normal University (ECNU), East China Normal University (ECNU) and East China University of Science and Technology - School of Business

detail.title: Stablecoin Depegging, Financial Intermediary Balance Sheet Constraints, and Liquidity in the U.S. Traditional Money Market
detail.abstract: As the stablecoin market has expanded rapidly, the linkages between stablecoins and the U.S. traditional money market have grown increasingly close. This paper examines the dynamic effects of stablecoin depegging on liquidity in the U.S. money market. We develop an analytical framework for money market liquidity that incorporates stablecoins, and demonstrate how depegging events transmit liquidity stress to the traditional money market by tightening the balance sheet constraints of financial intermediaries. Empirical analysis based on local projections reveals significant market heterogeneity: liquidity in the Treasury bill market follows a non-monotonic path, improving initially before subsequently reversing; liquidity in the commercial paper market deteriorates significantly on the day of the shock; and liquidity deterioration in the repo market exhibits a delayed peak. Further analysis indicates that the impact of depegging on intermediary balance sheets is primarily reflected in a rise in the marginal cost of expanding balance sheet capacity, rather than a substantial drawdown of capital. When intermediary capital is under stress, liquidity deterioration across all three markets is significantly amplified. These findings provide empirical evidence of risk coupling between crypto-asset markets and traditional money markets, with policy implications for the design of macroprudential regulatory frameworks for stablecoins.

AI.tldr: 本文研究稳定币脱钩对美国传统货币市场流动性的动态影响，发现不同子市场（国库券、商业票据、回购）的流动性反应存在显著异质性，且脱钩主要通过推高中介扩大资产负债表能力的边际成本而非消耗资本来传导压力。
AI.research_question: 稳定币脱钩如何影响美国传统货币市场的流动性？
AI.motivation: 稳定币市场快速扩张，其与传统货币市场的关联日益紧密，但脱钩事件如何传导流动性压力尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了纳入稳定币的货币市场流动性分析框架，阐释脱钩通过收紧金融中介资产负债表约束传导流动性压力的机制。
AI.method: 基于局部投影法（Local Projections）进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）国库券市场流动性呈非单调路径——先改善后恶化；（2）商业票据市场在冲击当日显著恶化；（3）回购市场流动性恶化存在延迟峰值；（4）脱钩主要推高中介扩大资产负债表能力的边际成本而非消耗资本；（5）当中介资本承压时，三个市场的流动性恶化均显著放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了加密资产市场与传统货币市场之间的风险耦合机制，为理解稳定币对金融体系稳定性的影响提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计稳定币的宏观审慎监管框架提供了实证依据和政策参考。

title: Design and Simulation-Based Feasibility Study of a Resilient Offline-First Campus Mesh Network for Federal Polytechnic Monguno
affiliations: Federal Polytechnic Monguno, Federal Polytechnic Monguno and Federal Polytechnic Monguno

detail.title: Design and Simulation-Based Feasibility Study of a Resilient Offline-First Campus Mesh Network for Federal Polytechnic Monguno

declarations.ethicsApproval: FPM/REC/IBR/2026
declarations.funderStatement: IBR/2026/FPM

detail.abstract: Federal Polytechnic Monguno operates in one of Nigeria's most digitally isolated environments. Situated in Borno State a region still recovering from the devastating impact of insurgency the institution contends daily with near-total absence of stable internet connectivity, leaving both staff and students cut off from the digital tools that modern polytechnic education demands. Students cannot reach research databases, e-learning platforms, or digital libraries. Staff struggle to share files, conduct meetings, or submit institutional reports through digital channels. Administrative processes that should take minutes stretch into hours, and the broader academic mission of the institution suffers as a consequence. This paper presents a simulation-based feasibility study investigating whether a resilient, solar-powered, offline-first wireless mesh network can provide a practical solution to this digital exclusion challenge. Rather than assuming ideal conditions, the study is grounded in Monguno's actual operational realities unreliable grid power, weak telecom coverage, limited technical capacity, and a post-conflict infrastructure environment. Using wireless mesh networking parameters drawn from comparable low-infrastructure campus scenarios, the study models network topologies, evaluates node placement strategies, estimates bandwidth performance under local usage patterns, and develops a cybersecurity threat assessment appropriate to community-scale academic networks. Findings confirm that an offline-first mesh architecture is technically feasible for Federal Polytechnic Monguno, provided deployment follows a phased approach with strategic node placement, renewable energy integration, and foundational cybersecurity controls. The study recommends that TETFund and institutional management priorities localized campus networking infrastructure rather than awaiting broader national broadband expansion an approach that enables meaningful digital participation independent of external connectivity. The proposed architecture offers a replicable model for similarly underserved tertiary institutions across Nigeria's NorthEast .

AI.tldr: 本文通过仿真可行性研究，验证了在尼日利亚博尔诺州蒙古诺联邦理工学院——一个几乎没有稳定互联网连接的极端数字隔离环境中，构建太阳能供电、离线优先的无线网状网络的可行性，并提出了一种可复制的校园网络部署方案。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚蒙古诺联邦理工学院这一后冲突、低基础设施环境中，部署太阳能供电、离线优先的无线网状网络是否在技术上可行？
AI.motivation: 蒙古诺联邦理工学院位于尼日利亚最数字孤立的地区，博尔诺州受叛乱影响，缺乏稳定互联网和电网。学生无法访问数据库和在线学习平台，行政效率低下，机构学术使命受损。需要一种不依赖外部宽带接入的本地化数字基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无线网状网络理论、离线优先架构（Offline-first Architecture）、低功耗广域网/局域网部署策略、网络安全威胁评估框架。
AI.method: 基于仿真的可行性研究。使用来自类似低基础设施校园场景的无线网状网络参数，对网络拓扑进行建模，评估节点放置策略，基于本地使用模式估算带宽性能，并针对社区规模学术网络开发网络安全威胁评估。
AI.findings: 离线优先的网状架构在技术上是可行的，前提是采取分阶段部署方式，包括策略性节点放置、可再生能源整合和基础网络安全控制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将离线优先网状网络理论应用于后冲突、极端低基础设施的学术场景，提供了针对数字隔离极端情况的网络可行性验证模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议TETFund和机构管理层优先投资本地化校园网络基础设施，而非等待国家宽带扩展。2. 提出了一种可复制的模型，适用于尼日利亚东北部及其他类似服务不足的高等教育机构。

title: When Does the Pie Rule Fail? Equilibrium and Instability in Derivative Contracts with Mutual Swap Rights on an Additive Lattice

detail.title: When Does the Pie Rule Fail? Equilibrium and Instability in Derivative Contracts with Mutual Swap Rights on an Additive Lattice
detail.abstract: We propose a stylized derivative contract inspired by the "pie rule" in combinatorial games: both counterparties hold mutual swap rights allowing either to reverse positions at any time, subject to a fixed exercise cost 𝑐. We formalize this Reciprocal Swap Right Option (RSRO) as a discrete-time sequential stopping game on an additive binomial lattice and characterize its equilibrium properties. Three results emerge. First, under symmetric information and distributional symmetry, the unique subgame perfect equilibrium is fair-neither party is systematically advantaged (Theorem 1). Second, when one party holds private information about the underlying's drift, adverse selection breaks fairness: under a restricted prior-rule equilibrium, the informed party exercises selectively, exploiting the uninformed counterparty (Proposition 10). Third, in a multi-party extension with perpetual-futures-style funding, under a simplified aggregate exercise rule with ordered-queue timing, initial imbalance triggers cascading exercise-a "swap rush" exhibiting strategic substitutability (Theorem 3). The critical threshold 𝑐 * = 2(𝑇-1)𝜎 delineates the region where swap rights discipline fairness without deadweight loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种受组合博弈"派规则"启发的衍生品合约——互惠互换权期权（RSRO），双方均持有可随时反转头寸的互换权（需支付固定成本c）。在加性二项式格子上的离散时间序贯停止博弈中，刻画了其均衡性质：对称信息下公平无偏；私有信息下逆向选择破坏公平；多主体扩展中出现"互换挤兑"。关键阈值c* = 2(T-1)σ界定了互换权既能维持公平又不产生无谓损失的区间。
AI.research_question: 如何在衍生品合约设计中引入互惠互换权（受"派规则"启发），并在不同信息结构下分析其均衡性质、公平性及市场稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统衍生品合约往往赋予一方单边权利（如期权），可能导致系统性不公平；而组合博弈中的"派规则"（分饼者后选）天然具有公平性。作者试图将这一思想引入金融衍生品设计，探索能否通过双向互换权实现内生公平，同时考察信息不对称和市场拥挤对此机制的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序贯停止博弈（Sequential Stopping Game）、子博弈完美均衡（Subgame Perfect Equilibrium）、逆向选择（Adverse Selection）、策略替代性（Strategic Substitutability）
AI.method: 在加性二项式格子上构建离散时间序贯停止博弈模型，分别求解对称信息下的子博弈完美均衡、不对称信息下的先验规则均衡，以及多主体永续合约场景下的有序队列均衡。
AI.findings: (1) 对称信息下，RSRO合约具有内生公平性，任何一方均无系统性优势；(2) 单方掌握漂移率私有信息时，知情方通过选择性行权剥削不知情方，公平被破坏；(3) 多主体永续合约中，初始头寸不平衡会触发级联行权（"互换挤兑"），表现出策略替代性特征；(4) 存在关键阈值c* = 2(T-1)σ，在此阈值之上互换权既能约束公平又不产生无谓损失。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将组合博弈中的"派规则"思想系统引入衍生品合约设计，构建了互惠互换权期权的形式化博弈模型；(2) 揭示了在对称信息下双向互换权可实现内生公平的机制；(3) 刻画了私有信息如何通过选择性行权破坏公平，丰富了信息经济学在衍生品设计中的应用；(4) 发现了多主体场景下的"互换挤兑"现象及其策略替代性，为理解衍生品市场的系统性风险提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为金融衍生品设计提供了一种新的公平合约机制，特别适用于需要对冲双方地位对称的场景；(2) 划定了互换权成本c的关键阈值，为市场监管者设定衍生品合约参数提供了理论参照；(3) 提醒业界注意在信息不对称和多主体拥挤环境下互惠互换权可能引发的级联风险。

title: Money, Inflation and Monetary Policy Regimes in India: Evidence from VAR and Time-Varying Models

detail.title: Money, Inflation and Monetary Policy Regimes in India: Evidence from VAR and Time-Varying Models
detail.abstract: Can money growth still provide useful information about inflation in an era of inflation targeting? This paper revisits this question for India using monthly data from 1992 to 2025 and examines how the money-inflation relationship has evolved across successive monetary policy regimes. Combining cointegration analysis, VAR and VECM models with rolling and Time-Varying Parameter VAR techniques, the study evaluates both long-run monetary linkages and short-run predictive dynamics under changing policy frameworks. The results reveal a persistent long-run relationship between money growth and inflation but little stable short-run predictive power. Monetary transmission is found to be highly regime dependent, with stronger effects during the multiple-indicators framework and substantially weaker effects under the interest-rate corridor and inflation-targeting regimes. Forecasting exercises further show that models allowing for structural change outperform conventional specifications. The findings suggest that money aggregates retain diagnostic value but are of limited use as short-run operational policy instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度1992-2025年月度数据，研究货币增长与通胀的关系在不同货币政策体制下的演变。发现长期关系存在，但短期预测力不稳定，货币传导高度依赖政策体制，允许结构变化的模型预测更优。
AI.research_question: 在通胀目标制时代，货币增长是否仍能为通胀提供有用信息？
AI.motivation: 传统上货币增长被视为通胀的预测指标，但在全球转向通胀目标制的背景下，这一关系的稳定性受到质疑。印度经历了多重货币政策体制转型，为研究这一问题提供了独特场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币数量论；货币政策传导机制；结构变化检验；体制依赖的货币-通胀关系
AI.method: 协整分析、VAR模型、VECM模型、滚动回归、时变参数VAR（TVP-VAR）模型、预测比较
AI.findings: （1）货币增长与通胀存在长期协整关系；（2）短期预测力不稳定；（3）货币传导效果高度依赖政策体制，在多重指标框架下较强，在利率走廊和通胀目标制下明显减弱；（4）允许结构变化的模型预测表现优于传统模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了货币增长与通胀关系在不同货币政策体制下的结构性变化，为"货币-通胀关系是否消亡"的辩论提供了体制依赖视角的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对央行（特别是印度央行）具有政策启示：货币总量仍具有诊断价值，但不宜作为短期操作工具；在通胀目标制下应更加关注利率和预期渠道。

title: Do Perpetual Futures Dampen or Amplify Speculative Bubbles?

detail.title: Do Perpetual Futures Dampen or Amplify Speculative Bubbles?
detail.abstract: Perpetual futures are symmetric instruments: longs and shorts post identical margin, and zero net supply pairs every levered position with its opposite. We graft one onto a resale-option bubble market whose single asymmetry is that buying requires storage while shorting requires borrowing. Symmetry delivers a neutrality benchmark; its failure makes the funding rate the published shadow price of the short-side constraint. Leverage and borrow capacity trace a dampening-amplification boundary with an absorbing region. Endogenizing arbitrage capacity yields multiple equilibria, a supply fold, a capacity trap, and an equilibrium-dependent leverage threshold. Under belief neutrality, welfare rises; funding-rule standards dominate leverage caps.

AI.tldr: 本文在带有转售期权泡沫的资产市场中引入永续合约（perpetual futures），利用其对称性（多头和空头保证金相同、零净供给）建立中性基准。研究发现，在唯一的不对称性——买入需存储、做空需借贷——下，资金费率成为空头方约束的影子价格。杠杆与借贷能力之间存在一个“阻尼-放大”边界，并包含一个吸收区域。内生化套利能力后，模型产生多重均衡、供给折叠、能力陷阱以及依赖于均衡状态的杠杆阈值。在信念中性条件下，社会福利提升，且资金费率规则标准优于杠杆上限管制。
AI.research_question: 永续合约如何影响存在转售期权泡沫的资产市场？资金费率、杠杆与借贷约束之间的互动机制如何决定市场均衡与福利结果？
AI.motivation: 永续合约在加密货币市场中已广泛应用，但其对资产定价和市场稳定的理论影响尚不明确。现有文献多聚焦于现货市场或传统期货，缺乏对永续合约对称性设计与市场不对称性（存储成本、借贷约束）之间张力的系统分析。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以转售期权泡沫理论（Harrison and Kreps, 1978）为基础，融合资金费率机制（永续合约的定价核心）、套利约束理论（Shleifer and Vishny, 1997）以及杠杆周期理论（Geanakoplos, 2010），构建一个包含对称性永续合约与不对称现货市场条件的均衡模型。
AI.method: 理论建模：在连续时间框架下构建包含永续合约、借贷约束和套利限制的资产市场均衡模型。通过分析对称性破坏的条件，推导资金费率的影子价格特征，并利用分岔分析方法研究多重均衡与杠杆阈值的突变性质。
AI.findings: (1) 资金费率系统性地反映了做空约束的稀缺性（影子价格）；(2) 杠杆与借贷能力之间存在非线性关系，具有阻尼-放大边界和吸收区域；(3) 内生化套利能力后产生多重均衡（供给折叠、能力陷阱）和均衡依赖的杠杆阈值；(4) 在信念中性下，永续合约提升福利；(5) 资金费率标准规则优于杠杆上限管制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将永续合约的对称性设计纳入泡沫资产定价理论，揭示了资金费率作为约束影子价格的理论角色。拓展了杠杆周期理论至衍生品市场，提出了“阻尼-放大边界”和“能力陷阱”等新概念，丰富了多重均衡与制度转换的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计加密货币衍生品市场规则提供理论依据：支持基于资金费率的市场化调节机制，反对简单粗暴的杠杆上限管制。为交易所和交易者理解永续合约资金费率的信号功能提供分析工具，有助于风险管理与政策评估。

title: Weathering the Storm? The Effects of Natural Disasters on Households under Universal Insurance
affiliations: Norges Bank, , Norges Bank, Norges Bank and Norges Bank

detail.title: Weathering the Storm? The Effects of Natural Disasters on Households under Universal Insurance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare that they have no relevantor material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.

detail.abstract: We study the indirect economic consequences of natural disasters for households using high-quality household-level data from Norway. Universal natural disaster insurance in this setting fully compensates direct physical damages, allowing us to isolate indirect effects. Linking a municipality-level measure of disaster severity to detailed transaction data measuring household expenditures, and using a matched difference-in-differences design, we find large and persistent effects on consumption: the cumulative spending fall up to four years after an event amounts to as much as 45 percent of the direct damages. Population-wide administrative records on income, wealth, housing transactions, and labor-market outcomes allow us to uncover the underlying mechanisms. First, labor income falls while unemployment increases after disasters, particularly when damages are concentrated among firms, consistent with disruptions to local labor markets. Second, housing wealth declines persistently, and homeowners cut spending more than renters despite similar income losses. Our results show that the household costs of natural disasters extend beyond the insured value of destroyed property, as households remain exposed to losses transmitted through local labor and housing markets.

AI.tldr: 利用挪威高质量家户数据，研究发现自然灾害在直接财产损失得到保险全额赔付后，仍通过当地劳动力市场和住房市场渠道，导致家户消费在灾后四年内累计下降高达直接损失的45%。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害对家户的非直接经济后果是什么？在直接物理损失得到全额保险赔付后，家户是否仍面临额外的经济成本？
AI.motivation: 已有研究多关注自然灾害的直接损失，但对间接经济后果的因果识别不足。挪威的全民自然灾害保险制度为隔离直接损失、识别间接效应提供了独特的研究情境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害经济学、消费平滑理论、劳动力市场冲击传导、住房财富效应
AI.method: 匹配双重差分法（matched difference-in-differences），使用市政层面的灾害严重程度指标与家户交易、收入、财富、住房和劳动力市场的高质量面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）灾后消费显著且持续下降，四年累计降幅达直接损失的45%；（2）劳动力收入下降、失业增加，特别是当损失集中于企业时；（3）住房财富持续下降，房主比租户的消费削减更多，尽管两者收入损失相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在保险全额赔付情境下，因果识别出自然灾害通过劳动力市场和住房市场渠道传导的间接经济成本，揭示了家户风险暴露的"残余"脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害政策制定提供启示：即使有完善的保险机制，政策仍需关注灾害对当地劳动力市场和住房市场的冲击，以及由此引发的消费下降等更广泛的经济后果。

title: Which Stock Screens Actually Work? A Survivorship-free Audit of 16 Fundamental Metrics — ROIC, Value, Momentum, and Quality — on the S&P 500 (2010–2024)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Which Stock Screens Actually Work? A Survivorship-free Audit of 16 Fundamental Metrics — ROIC, Value, Momentum, and Quality — on the S&P 500 (2010–2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Zyberno.com, a venture that applies fundamental-analysis research of the kind audited here, and therefore has a professional and prospective financial interest in this research area — though he presently draws no income from the venture and funds its operation himself. This is disclosed in the interest of full transparency. The study is designed to be resistant to author bias: the universe is mechanically defined and survivorship-free, every screen is evaluated with the same pre-stated, benchmark-invariant statistics, null results are reported in full, and the complete dataset and replication pipeline are published (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20650537) so that any reader can independently reproduce — or refute — every result.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Which stock screens actually work? We audit sixteen fundamental screens on the complete, survivorship-free S&P 500 (2010–2024) and find that return on invested capital (ROIC) is the most predictive of them all. ROIC's rank correlation with five-year forward excess returns is +0.11, its top-minus-bottom quintile spread is +3.0 percentage points per year, and its edge holds in both halves of the period (Fama-MacBeth t = +5.9). The textbook sustainable-growth screen — ROIC × reinvestment rate — does not work: it multiplies a positive factor (profitability) by a negative one (reinvestment), and the two cancel; we call this the sustainable-growth paradox. Value was the weakest family of the era: book-to-market was the single worst screen tested (−0.13) — a faithful portrait of the quality-led 2010–2024 regime, not a verdict on value investing. The celebrated academic quality screens fade on large caps: ROE, gross profitability (Novy-Marx), accruals (Sloan), the Piotroski F-score, and asset growth all sit near zero, and ROIC beats ROE — the most popular quality metric — seventeen-to-one on identical firms. After risk adjustment, no screen earns significant alpha: every long-short portfolio's intercept against the Fama-French five factors plus momentum has |t| < 1, so on the large-cap S&P 500 these screens deliver factor tilts, not a free lunch.

The audit is built to be trusted. The universe is the complete point-in-time S&P 500 — every constituent-year, including firms later acquired or delisted — with dividend-reinvested total returns, filing-date entry, and CRSP-style delisting handling.
