detail.abstract: This report introduces a new, holistic framework for organizational flourishing: the PEARL Model™, which stands for Purpose, Energy, Adaptability, Relationships, and Life-Force. Rather than offering incremental fixes, the PEARL Model™ provides a system of strategic enablers that directly address the relational factors at the heart of the modern workforce crisis. The findings from our comprehensive survey of nearly 1,000 full-time workers provide compelling evidence that the PEARL Model™ is not merely a "nice-to-have" wellness program but a direct pathway to superior business outcomes. Key findings include: The flourishing advantage: Each of the PEARL dimensions is positively correlated with employee happiness and overall job satisfaction. The dimension of Energy, which measures the degree to which employees feel energized by their interactions with their colleagues, was found to be the strongest predictor for both happiness and satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全新的组织繁荣框架——PEARL模型™（目标、能量、适应力、关系、生命力），并通过对近1000名全职员工的调查证明，该模型不仅是员工福祉计划，更是提升企业绩效的直接路径。其中"能量"维度是员工幸福感和工作满意度的最强预测因子。
AI.research_question: PEARL模型™（目标、能量、适应力、关系、生命力）的各维度如何影响员工幸福感、工作满意度以及企业商业成果？
AI.motivation: 现代劳动力危机日益严重，而现有解决方案多为零散的增量修补，缺乏系统性框架。作者希望提出一个整体性的组织繁荣框架，直接应对劳动力危机核心的关系性因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: PEARL模型™：包含Purpose（目标）、Energy（能量）、Adaptability（适应力）、Relationships（关系）、Life-Force（生命力）五个维度，构成组织繁荣的战略赋能系统。
AI.method: 对近1000名全职员工进行大规模问卷调查，采用定量分析方法检验PEARL各维度与员工幸福感、工作满意度之间的相关性。
AI.findings: 1. PEARL模型各维度均与员工幸福感和工作满意度呈正相关。2."能量"维度（衡量员工在与同事互动中感受到的活力程度）是幸福感和工作满意度的最强预测因素。3. PEARL模型不是"可有可无"的福利项目，而是带来卓越商业成果的直接路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PEARL模型™这一系统性的组织繁荣理论框架，将员工福祉与企业绩效之间的联系从"锦上添花"提升为"战略必需"，并识别出"能量"维度作为最关键的影响因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理者提供了可操作的战略赋能系统，帮助企业通过关注目标、能量、适应力、关系和生命力五个维度来同时提升员工幸福感和商业成果，尤其强调了营造积极同事互动氛围的重要性。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Driver of Digital Transformation in Global Business
affiliations: and DIRECT RESEARCH JOURNALS PUBLISHER

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Driver of Digital Transformation in Global Business
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a fundamental driver of digital transformation in global business, reshaping how organizations operate, compete, and create value in increasingly dynamic markets. The rapid growth of digital technologies, big data, cloud computing, and advanced analytics has accelerated the adoption of AI-powered solutions across various business functions. Through technologies such as machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, and intelligent automation, AI enables organizations to enhance operational efficiency, improve decision-making processes, optimize resource allocation, and deliver personalized customer experiences. Businesses across industries are leveraging AI to automate routine tasks, predict market trends, manage risks, strengthen supply chain resilience, and support innovation initiatives. Despite these benefits, the integration of AI into business operations presents significant challenges, including data privacy concerns, cybersecurity risks, algorithmic bias, workforce displacement, and regulatory compliance issues. This study examines the role of artificial intelligence as a catalyst for digital transformation in global business, exploring its applications, benefits, challenges, and strategic implications. The analysis highlights how AI-driven technologies are transforming organizational structures, business models, and competitive strategies while creating new opportunities for growth and innovation. The study concludes that AI is no longer merely a technological tool but a strategic asset that is redefining business performance and long-term competitiveness. Effective governance, ethical implementation, and continuous workforce development are essential for maximizing the benefits of AI-driven digital transformation in the evolving global business environment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了人工智能作为全球企业数字化转型核心驱动力的角色，探讨了其在运营效率、决策优化、资源分配等方面的应用与效益，同时指出了数据隐私、算法偏见、劳动力替代等挑战，强调AI已成为重新定义企业绩效与长期竞争力的战略资产。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何作为催化剂推动全球企业的数字化转型？其应用、效益、挑战及战略意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术、大数据、云计算和高级分析的快速发展，AI在各业务领域的应用日益广泛，但其对组织、商业模式和竞争战略的深层影响尚需系统梳理；同时AI整合带来的数据隐私、伦理、监管等挑战亟需关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论；AI作为战略资源与动态能力的视角；技术-组织-环境（TOE）框架；伦理治理理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，综合现有研究成果对AI在商业领域的应用、效益与挑战进行系统梳理。
AI.findings: AI已从单纯的技术工具演变为重新定义企业绩效和长期竞争力的战略资产；AI驱动技术正在改变组织结构、商业模式和竞争战略；有效治理、伦理实施和持续劳动力发展是最大化AI转型效益的关键。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI定位从技术工具升级为战略资产，丰富了数字化转型与战略管理理论的交叉视角；系统整合了AI赋能与AI治理的双重逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了AI驱动的数字化转型路线图，指出了在应用AI时需重点关注的治理、伦理及人才培养方向。

title: When Structure Decides: A Force-diagnostic Reading of Organisational Failure under Pressure
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: When Structure Decides: A Force-diagnostic Reading of Organisational Failure under Pressure
detail.abstract: Behavioral interventions in organizations consistently fail to produce durable change under conditions of sustained pressure. This paper argues that the underlying cause is not motivational or cultural but structural: organizations are governed, under load, by four force laws — the Structural Load Vector™, Energetic Tension™, Archetypal Momentum™, and the Environmental Field™ — that shape behavior independently of intention, communication, or leadership style. Drawing on Kampf Alignment Physics® (KAP), a structural framework for diagnosing and redirecting human systems under pressure, the paper applies force-diagnostic analysis to four documented cases from 2023–2025: the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank (2023), the Boeing 737 MAX 9 door plug blowout (2024), the NHS England structural reorganization (2023–2025), and post-merger integration failure as documented in cross-sector empirical evidence from the same period. Each case is read through the lens of one or more dominant laws, with all characterizations of organizational conduct grounded in the findings of primary regulatory and investigation reports. Cross-case analysis identifies four convergent force patterns and practical intervention points. Implications are drawn for executive education, governance design, and leadership development curricula.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，组织在持续压力下行为干预失效的根本原因不是动机或文化问题，而是结构性问题——四种力定律（Structural Load Vector™、Energetic Tension™、Archetypal Momentum™、Environmental Field™）独立于意图、沟通和领导风格塑造组织行为。通过分析SVB倒闭、波音737 MAX门塞脱落、NHS重组及并购整合失败四个案例，识别出四种收敛力模式及干预点。
AI.research_question: 为什么组织在持续压力下，行为干预始终无法产生持久改变？其背后的结构力量是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有解释（动机、文化、领导力）无法解释组织在压力下的系统性失败模式，需要从结构力学角度重新理解组织行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kampf Alignment Physics® (KAP)：包含四种力定律——Structural Load Vector™（结构负荷向量）、Energetic Tension™（能量张力）、Archetypal Momentum™（原型动量）、Environmental Field™（环境场域），构成诊断和引导压力下人类系统的结构框架。
AI.method: 力诊断分析（force-diagnostic analysis）；四个2023–2025年案例的跨案例比较；所有组织行为描述均基于一手监管和调查报告。
AI.findings: 跨案例识别出四种收敛力模式；每个案例由一种或多种主导力定律主导；存在可操作的干预点。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出组织行为的"结构力"解释范式，挑战主流的动机/文化解释；建立基于力定律的组织诊断语言。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管教育、治理设计和领导力发展课程提供基于力分析的干预路径。

title: A Topological Realization of the Riemann Zeta Function via Non-resonant Geometries of Self-inverting Toroidal Vortices

detail.title: A Topological Realization of the Riemann Zeta Function via Non-resonant Geometries of Self-inverting Toroidal Vortices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Symmetic, an independent technology and software architecture entity. The applied methodologies derived from this theoretical framework—specifically the geometric routing protocols and AI telemetry systems—inform the enterprise software solutions developed by Symmetic . The author declares no other competing financial, personal, or academic relationships that could be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is strictly theoretical and computational in nature. It does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or animal subjects. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was entirely self-funded by the author as part of independent theoretical and applied research.

detail.abstract: The Riemann Hypothesis asserts that all non-trivial zeroes of the zeta function ζ(s) lie on the critical line Re(s) = 1 2. While traditional approaches rely heavily on arithmetic and algebraic number theory, this paper introduces a complementary topological and geometric framework. We model the distribution of numbers as an unclosed, open-ended three-dimensional helical spiral wrapping around a static, unbending control axis governed by a primary residue node (3 mod 9). By evaluating the binary doubling orbit under the map T : Z 9 → Z 9 , T (x) = 2x (mod 9), we isolate a deterministic, selfcancelling material manifold M = {1, 2, 4, 8, 7, 5} whose unit-vector sum vanishes identically on the complex unit circle: k∈M e i2πk/9 = 0 (the Net-Zero Theorem). We propose that the critical line Re(s) = 1 2 represents the absolute geometric mirror axis of a self-inverting toroidal vortex, and that non-trivial zeroes manifest as nodes of destructive wave interference while prime numbers emerge as discrete nonresonant vertices sustaining infinite helical expansion without structural drift. We state this formally as a conjecture and delineate the open operatortheoretic steps required to elevate the framework to a complete proof.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用三维螺旋拓扑与模9动力学系统（二进制加倍轨道）来重新诠释黎曼假设，认为临界线是自反转环形涡旋的几何镜面，非平凡零点产生于相消波干涉节点。
AI.research_question: 黎曼假设是否可以通过拓扑与几何框架（而非传统数论路径）得到新的理解或证明路径？
AI.motivation: 传统黎曼假设研究依赖算术与代数数论，本文试图引入互补的拓扑与几何视角，为这一数学难题提供新的直觉与形式化路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三维螺旋拓扑、模9二进制加倍轨道T(x)=2x(mod 9)、物质流形M={1,2,4,8,7,5}、净零定理（单位向量和在单位圆上恒为零）、自反转环形涡旋模型、相消波干涉与共振节点理论。
AI.method: 构建模9下的二进制加倍轨道离散动力学系统，通过单位复指数求和证明净零定理；将临界线解释为环形涡旋的镜面对称轴，非平凡零点视为干涉相消节点，素数视为离散非共振顶点。
AI.findings: 物质流形M={1,2,4,8,7,5}的单位向量和在复单位圆上恒为零（净零定理）；提出黎曼假设的一种拓扑等价表述，即临界线是自反转环形涡旋的绝对几何镜面。
AI.theory_contributions: 为黎曼假设提供了一个全新的拓扑与几何诠释框架，将零点问题转化为波干涉与涡旋动力学问题，开辟了非传统数论路径的研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 虽为主要为理论贡献，但若该框架可发展为完整证明，将深刻影响解析数论、量子混沌、波动方程和密码学等领域。

title: Multi-Product Pricing under Rational Inattention: Evidence, Estimation, and Field Deployment from Airline Ancillaries
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Institute of Operations Research and Analytics, , Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) and NUS Business School - Department of Decision Sciences

detail.title: Multi-Product Pricing under Rational Inattention: Evidence, Estimation, and Field Deployment from Airline Ancillaries
detail.abstract: We study the joint pricing of close substitutes when customer attention is unevenly distributed across products and data on any single (product, context) cell are too thin for fully separate demand estimation. Airline ancillaries, product-line variants, subscription tiers, and hotel room categories all share this structure. The standard multinomial-logit benchmark imposes homogeneous substitution and therefore cannot represent the product-level asymmetries observed in such markets. We develop a generalized rational-inattention demand model with product-specific attention weights. The seller's revenue problem is convex in the induced purchase probabilities and admits a semi-closed-form solution: each product's optimal price decomposes into its effective cost, a product-specific attention markup, and a common demand term that depends on the segment only through a single scalar, the aggregate purchase probability. Pricing therefore reduces to a one-dimensional root search regardless of assortment size. Calibration reduces to a linear program over the KKT residuals of the consumer's problem, with a finite-sample error bound governed by the ℓ 1minimum gain of the design matrix. When per-segment data are sparse, we pool neighboring segments and replace segment-specific intercepts with a linear function of observable features. The total parameter error decomposes into statistical error, merging bias, and approximation bias; the corresponding bias-variance trade-off is operationalized in deployment by a split-sample cross-validation procedure for configuration selection. A revenue-loss bound quadratic in the ℓ 1 parameter error links sample size to revenue and motivates three pricing rules of increasing data appetite: a segment-based rule, a feature-based rule, and a propensity-based rule (deployed as the PCP arm). We evaluate the framework in collaboration with a low-cost airline. Across five checked-baggage tiers, the cheapest weight tier (20 kg) is nearly two orders of magnitude (≈ 80×) more price-sensitive than the highest (40 kg), and cross-tier substitution is small relative to own-price response; both patterns are inconsistent with homogeneous substitution. In a randomized field deployment over 48 origin-destination pairs, the segment-based and feature-based rules each raise baggage revenue by 7-8% (𝑝 < 0.01) relative to uniform pricing, and their posted-price distribution first-order stochastically dominates that of the carrier's incumbent rule: average posted prices fall while revenue rises.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当消费者注意力在产品间不均匀分布、且单个产品单元数据稀疏时，如何对相近替代品进行联合定价。作者提出一个广义理性疏忽需求模型，将最优价格分解为有效成本、产品特定的注意力加价和共同需求项，从而将定价问题降为一维寻根。通过与一家低成本航空公司合作，在五个托运行李档位的实测中验证了模型有效性，现场实验显示基于细分市场和基于特征的定价规则分别使行李收入提升7-8%。
AI.research_question: 当消费者注意力在产品间不均匀分布且单个(产品、场景)数据稀疏时，如何对相近替代品进行联合定价？
AI.motivation: 航空公司辅助服务、产品线变体、订阅层级、酒店房型等市场存在消费者注意力不均匀分布和数据稀疏问题，标准多项logit模型假设同质替代关系，无法捕捉这些市场中观察到的产品级别不对称性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义理性疏忽需求模型（generalized rational-inattention demand model），引入产品特定的注意力权重。
AI.method: 理论建模（广义理性疏忽需求模型）、校准（线性规划）、现场随机对照实验（48条航线、五种托运行李档位）。
AI.findings: (1) 最优价格可分解为有效成本、产品特定注意力加价和共同需求项，定价简化为一维寻根；(2) 最便宜的20kg行李档位价格敏感性比最高的40kg档位高出约80倍，跨档位替代效应远小于自身价格响应；(3) 现场实验中，细分市场规则和特征规则相比统一定价分别提升行李收入7-8%。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出了考虑产品特定注意力权重的广义理性疏忽需求模型；(2) 证明了卖方收益问题在诱导购买概率上是凸的，并给出半封闭式解；(3) 建立了有限样本误差界和收入损失界。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 提供了三种不同数据需求的定价规则（基于细分市场、基于特征、基于倾向性）；(2) 通过航空公司现场实验验证了模型在实际场景中的有效性，收入提升7-8%；(3) 为数据稀疏场景下的联合定价提供了可操作的方法论。

title: E-Waste Reverse Supply Chain with Retail-Based Collection Service
affiliations: University of Kentucky - Gatton College of Business and Economics and Gatton College of Business & Economics

detail.title: E-Waste Reverse Supply Chain with Retail-Based Collection Service
detail.abstract: We study a reverse supply chain in which a retailer serves as a collector for old electronics and offers both a trade-in program for functional used products and a recycling program for end-of-life e-waste. Old electronics owners face heterogeneous disposal hassle costs and choose whether to use the collector's programs, sell functional used products through alternative venues, or retain their used products or e-waste. We characterize the collector's optimal payment strategy, considering owners' choices. The collector induces one of two distinct payment regimes depending on the value from e-waste. When the value from e-waste is high, the collector adopts an efficient payment strategy under which all participating owners recycle e-waste through the collector. When the value from e-waste is low, the collector adopts an inefficient payment strategy under which some owners sell functional used products but retain e-waste. The two regimes differ in the collector's strategic priorities and in the roles played by trade-in and recycling payments. We further identify a substitution effect between channel convenience and monetary incentives: while both are important for owner participation, the profit-maximizing collector may strategically reduce payments when the collector channel becomes more convenient. As a result, improving channel convenience can counterintuitively lower the e-waste collection rate, whereas increasing e-waste value consistently improves collection outcomes. These insights remain robust when introducing an e-waste processor with pricing power and when owners are heterogeneous in their awareness of the recycling program. These findings provide managerial and policy insights for retail-based collection systems for small electronics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究零售商作为旧电子产品收集商时，最优的以旧换新和回收支付策略。发现当电子垃圾价值高时采用高效支付策略，价值低时采用低效支付策略；渠道便利性与货币激励之间存在替代效应，提升渠道便利性反而可能降低电子垃圾回收率。
AI.research_question: 零售商作为旧电子产品收集商时，应如何设计最优的以旧换新和回收支付策略？渠道便利性与货币激励如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 旧电子产品的回收处理是一个重要的环境与运营管理问题。零售渠道在收集小型电子产品方面日益重要，但对于如何设计支付策略来激励消费者参与以旧换新和回收项目，缺乏系统的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 逆向供应链理论、消费者异质性决策模型（基于处置麻烦成本的异质性）、支付策略最优化的机制设计。
AI.method: 数学模型分析，考虑消费者行为选择（以旧换新、回收、通过其他渠道出售、保留产品），求解零售商最优支付策略。
AI.findings: 1）存在两种支付体制：电子垃圾价值高时采用高效支付策略（所有参与者都将电子垃圾交给收集商）；价值低时采用低效支付策略（部分消费者出售功能完好的产品但保留电子垃圾）。2）渠道便利性与货币激励之间存在替代效应，提高便利性可能反直觉地降低电子垃圾收集率。3）增加电子垃圾价值始终能改善收集效果。4）引入有定价权的电子垃圾处理器以及消费者对回收项目认知的异质性后，结论依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了以旧换新和回收两种支付工具在不同价值条件下的最优组合策略；发现了渠道便利性与货币激励的替代效应及其对回收率的反直觉影响，丰富了逆向供应链和闭环供应链的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商设计旧电子产品收集方案提供支付策略指导；为政策制定者提示：单纯提高渠道便利性可能适得其反，而提高电子垃圾价值（如补贴回收）才是更有效的政策方向。

title: A Study on Public Safety and Policing in Europe
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Study on Public Safety and Policing in Europe
detail.abstract: Western European states combine high incomes and substantial policing budgets with conspicuously high levels of recorded property and street crime, while several less affluent Central and Eastern European and small states record markedly less. This study asks whether the cross-national and within-national structure of European property crime is better explained by criminal-justice certainty-the probability that an offence results in an identified offender and a sanction-than by police capacity (officers per capita) or economic development. Building on the economic model of crime and on the criminological evidence that the certainty of punishment deters more reliably than its severity, we specify an expected-cost model of offending in which the apprehension probability is produced by guardianship and detection capacity subject to institutional constraints. We test the model on a panel of thirty European jurisdictions observed annually between 2008 and 2024, using harmonised Eurostat data on police-recorded theft, robbery and burglary, police personnel, and suspected and convicted persons. Three results are robust. First, across countries, recorded theft rises with income (an estimated elasticity of about +0.9), contradicting the premise that affluence or policing budgets purchase safety. Second, within countries, police strength carries a positive, not a protective, coefficient, consistent with reverse causation, whereas measures of apprehension and sanction certainty are negatively and significantly associated with theft and robbery and survive lagging, sample restriction and firstdifferencing. Third, the certainty effect is concentrated in exactly the high-frequency street offences-theft and robbery-that dominate visitors' and residents' victimisation risk. We interpret these findings through the guardianship channel, locate the surveillance-privacy tradeoff within the apprehension-production function, and argue that marginal investment in certainty dominates marginal investment in headcount or in sentence severity.

AI.tldr: 通过分析2008-2024年30个欧洲司法管辖区的面板数据，研究发现财产犯罪率更受抓捕和制裁确定性（而非警力规模或经济发展水平）的影响，且这种效应主要集中在盗窃和抢劫等高发街头犯罪上。
AI.research_question: 欧洲财产犯罪的跨国与国内结构，是更好地由刑事司法确定性（犯罪导致被识别并受制裁的概率）来解释，还是由警力规模或经济发展水平来解释？
AI.motivation: 西欧国家拥有高收入和高警务预算，却记录了高水平的财产犯罪和街头犯罪，而一些较不富裕的中东欧国家犯罪率却显著较低，这一悖论亟待解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪经济学模型（贝克尔模型）与犯罪学证据（惩罚确定性比惩罚严厉性更具威慑力）相结合，构建了犯罪预期成本模型，其中逮捕概率由监护能力和侦查能力在制度约束下共同决定。
AI.method: 基于2008-2024年30个欧洲司法管辖区的年度面板数据，使用Eurostat统一数据（警方记录的盗窃、抢劫和入室盗窃，警力人员，嫌疑人和定罪人数），采用固定效应、滞后、样本限制和差分等方法进行检验。
AI.findings: 1. 跨国层面，盗窃犯罪随收入上升而增加（弹性约+0.9）；2. 国内层面，警力规模系数为正（反向因果），而抓捕和制裁确定性指标与盗窃、抢劫显著负相关；3. 确定性效应集中于盗窃和抢劫等高发街头犯罪。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含监护通道的预期成本模型，将监控-隐私权衡纳入逮捕生产函数，并论证了边际投资于确定性优于边际投资于警力规模或刑罚严厉性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为警务资源配置提供政策指导：提高抓捕和制裁确定性（如提高破案率和定罪率）比单纯增加警力人数或加重刑罚更能有效降低财产犯罪率。

title: Beyond Good Intentions: An "Equity Architecture" Blueprint for Global Football Leadership
affiliations: University of Michigan, Ross School of Business and University of Michigan at Ann Arbor

detail.title: Beyond Good Intentions: An "Equity Architecture" Blueprint for Global Football Leadership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Purpose: This viewpoint introduces the "Equity Architecture" (EA) framework as a constructive tool for designing equitable leadership pipelines in global sport.

Design/methodology/approach: Comparative analysis of the NFL's Rooney Rule and the FA's Football Leadership Diversity Code, drawing on secondary data and institutional theory. 

Findings: Five critical design principles for effective equity policy: mandated participation, linking process to outcome targets, balanced incentives, full-pipeline scope, and institutionalized external advocacy. 

Practical implications: The framework provides an actionable checklist for club executives, league administrators, and statutory regulators-including the UK's new Independent Football Regulator to design evidence-based diversity policies. 

Originality/value: Moves beyond documenting leadership disparities to offer a replicable, evidence-based blueprint for systemic policy design applicable across global sport contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"公平架构"（Equity Architecture, EA）框架，通过比较分析NFL的Rooney Rule和英足总的足球领导力多样性守则，提炼出五项关键设计原则，为全球体育组织构建公平的领导力输送管道提供系统性政策设计蓝图。
AI.research_question: 如何设计有效的公平政策以构建全球体育领域公平的领导力输送管道？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多停留于记录领导力差距，缺乏可复制的、基于证据的系统性政策设计蓝图，亟需一个能够指导实际政策设计的整合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公平架构（Equity Architecture, EA）框架；制度理论。
AI.method: 比较分析法：对NFL的Rooney Rule与英足总的足球领导力多样性守则进行对比分析，基于二手数据和制度理论。
AI.findings: 五条关键设计原则：强制参与、将过程与结果目标挂钩、平衡的激励机制、全管道范围、制度化的外部倡导。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公平政策设计从描述性研究推进到规范性、系统性的理论框架构建，提出可跨情境复制的公平架构模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俱乐部高管、联赛管理者及监管机构（如英国新成立的独立足球监管机构）提供可操作的政策设计清单，助力制定循证多样性政策。

title: The Economics of ESG: Norms, Disclosure, and the Political Economy of Climate Risk Regulation
affiliations: Delta Economics & Finance

detail.title: The Economics of ESG: Norms, Disclosure, and the Political Economy of Climate Risk Regulation
detail.abstract: I examine the economics of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) criteria through four interconnected lenses: the emergence of ESG as a normative framework and its intellectual genealogy from corporate governance to GRC (governance, risk management, and compliance) to IFRS accounting standards; the economic functions and limits of disclosure regulation; the empirical relationship between ESG performance and financial performance; and the comparative political economy of ESG regulation across five jurisdictions, with particular attention to the recent reversal of U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) climate disclosure rules. Drawing on stakeholder theory, signaling theory, and the economics of information, I argue that ESG occupies an ambiguous space between value-relevant information and value-driven preference. A formal model demonstrates that mandatory disclosure reduces information asymmetry and lowers the weighted average cost of capital, but only when disclosure is credible and comparable. A game-theoretic extension shows that the credibility coefficient λ depends critically on regulator ideology β R , with anti-disclosure regimes driving enforcement to zero. The SEC's March 2024 climate rules-requiring Scope 1 and 2 emissions reporting for large accelerated filers-represented a compromise between financial materiality and stakeholder demands. However, the subsequent stay and rescission under Acting Chair Uyeda and Chair Atkins illustrate the fragility of ESG regulation in the face of political contestation over the purpose of disclosure. Comparative analysis reveals that the United States is an outlier among major economies (European Union, Canada, Japan, Brazil) in its reversal of mandatory climate disclosure. Meta-analytic evidence confirms a positive but modest average effect of ESG performance on financial performance, though causality remains contested and reverse causality is substantial. I conclude that ESG's economic significance depends on whether it evolves from organized hypocrisy toward genuinely normative practice-a transition that hinges on the resolution of fundamental disagreements about materiality, regulatory authority, and the legitimate purposes of the corporation.

AI.tldr: 本文从规范框架、披露监管、ESG-财务绩效关系及比较政治经济学四个维度分析了ESG的经济学。研究发现，强制披露可降低信息不对称和资本成本，但取决于披露的可靠性与可比性；美国在主要经济体中反向逆转强制气候披露规则是例外；ESG绩效与财务绩效存在正向但微弱的关联，因果关系仍存争议。ESG的经济意义取决于其能否从"组织伪善"转向真正的规范性实践。
AI.research_question: ESG作为经济框架的规范基础、功能边界与政治经济条件是什么？ESG披露的经济效果与局限性何在？不同政治体制下ESG监管的稳定性如何？
AI.motivation: ESG标准日益重要但争议不断，其经济功能与政治脆弱性缺乏系统性分析。特别是美国SEC气候披露规则的逆转提供了天然的准自然实验，促使作者在跨辖区比较和理论建模框架下审视ESG的经济学本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利益相关者理论、信号传递理论、信息经济学；作者通过形式化模型建立强制披露对信息不对称与加权平均资本成本的影响机制，并引入博弈论扩展刻画监管者意识形态β_R对可信度系数λ的内生影响。
AI.method: 理论建模（形式化模型与博弈论扩展）、比较制度分析（美国、欧盟、加拿大、日本、巴西五辖区）、元分析综合已有实证证据、事件分析（SEC 2024年气候披露规则的制定与撤销）。
AI.findings: （1）强制披露在披露可信且可比时可降低信息不对称与资本成本；（2）可信度系数λ由监管者意识形态β_R内生决定，反披露体制下执法力度趋零；（3）美国是主要经济体中唯一逆转强制气候披露的国家；（4）ESG绩效与财务绩效存在正相关但效应温和，反向因果问题显著；（5）ESG处于"价值相关信息"与"价值驱动偏好"之间的模糊地带。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG概念化为一组存在本质张力的分析范畴（信息vs偏好），而非简单的规范共识；将监管政治学（意识形态β_R）纳入披露经济学模型，揭示了制度环境对披露效果的结构性约束；区分了ESG作为"组织伪善"与"规范性实践"两种理论状态。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计气候披露规则提供理论边界条件（可信度与可比性不可或缺）；向投资者警示ESG-财务绩效关联的因果不确定性；为跨国企业提供不同辖区ESG监管稳定性的比较基准；揭示美国反ESG政治运动的经济后果。

title: The Sincerity Test: Executive behavior across the Political Cycles of ESG (1953-2026)

detail.title: The Sincerity Test: Executive behavior across the Political Cycles of ESG (1953-2026)
detail.abstract: Executive engagement with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) issues is frequently treated as a stable strategic orientation. This paper argues instead that it is better understood as conditioned behavior-a response that tracks the intensity of external pressure more closely than any underlying conviction. Combining upper-echelons theory with institutional and legitimacy perspectives, it offers a periodization of the phenomenon across four phases, from the postwar ethics of corporate responsibility to the 2026 regulatory retrenchment in the European Union, and develops the notion of a sincerity test: when institutional pressure recedes, the resulting divergence between firms that persist and firms that retreat or fall silent reveals the motivational frame that drove adoption in the first place. The argument integrates the mainstream business-case literature with critical work on decoupling and symbolic compliance, and outlines implications for longitudinal research and board oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高管对ESG的参与并非稳定的战略取向，而是对外部压力强度的条件性行为反应，并引入"诚意测试"概念：当制度压力减弱时，坚持与退缩的企业分化揭示了其最初的动机框架。
AI.research_question: 高管对ESG议题的参与究竟是稳定的战略取向，还是对外部压力的条件性行为反应？如何检验其真实动机？
AI.motivation: 现有文献常将ESG参与视为稳定战略取向，忽视了企业在压力消退后的行为分化，缺乏检验企业ESG动机真实性的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 上层梯队理论、制度理论、合法性视角；结合商业案例文献与解耦/象征性合规的批判性文献。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念性框架开发：对ESG参与现象进行历史阶段划分（四阶段：战后企业责任伦理至2026年欧盟监管回调），并发展"诚意测试"概念。
AI.findings: ESG参与是条件性行为，外部压力强度驱动企业参与；"诚意测试"揭示：压力消退后，真正内化ESG价值的企业持续参与，而象征性合规的企业退缩或沉默。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ESG参与从稳定战略取向重新概念化为条件性行为；整合制度理论与批判性文献；提出"诚意测试"作为诊断企业ESG动机真实性的分析工具；提供四阶段历史分期框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对董事会监督ESG实践提供启示：需关注企业在压力环境变化时的行为一致性；为纵向研究设计提供指导；帮助识别真正致力于可持续发展而非象征性合规的企业。

title: Waiting Thread Hijacking (WTH): Mechanism, Technical Analysis, Detection Opportunities, and Purple Team Considerations
affiliations: Behbahan Khatam Alanbia University of Technology

detail.title: Waiting Thread Hijacking (WTH): Mechanism, Technical Analysis, Detection Opportunities, and Purple Team Considerations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author for research, educational, and professional development purposes.

detail.abstract:
The latest method is called Waiting Thread Hijacking (WTH), which hijacks threads in a waiting state and modifies return addresses on the stack to execute code. Unlike the conventional TEH technique, WTH does not require thread suspension or direct context modification, making it less dependent on APIs that are usually monitored by Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) products.

This technical report analyzes WTH in detail, including its underlying mechanics, operational requirements, execution workflow, advantages, limitations, and practical considerations. The technique is placed in the broader context of process injection and thread manipulation and compared to related techniques such as Thread Execution Hijacking, APC Injection, Early Bird APC, PoolParty, and Module Stomping.

The report also touches on defense by pointing out detection opportunities from behavioural telemetry, stack integrity analysis, memory forensics, and threat hunting methods. Mitigation strategies and Purple Team recommendations are also provided to guide detection engineering and adversary emulation activities. The findings reveal WTH is an advancement in process injection tradecraft that uses legitimate OS behaviour to decrease traditional detection indicators. For offensive security practitioners and defenders alike hoping to improve modern endpoint detection and response capabilities, knowing what it can and can’t do is important.

AI.tldr: 本文详细分析了一种名为等待线程劫持（WTH）的新型进程注入技术。WTH通过劫持处于等待状态的线程并修改栈上的返回地址来执行代码，相比传统线程执行劫持（TEH），它不需要挂起线程或直接修改上下文，因此对端点检测与响应（EDR）产品通常监控的API依赖更少。报告涵盖了WTH的机制、操作要求、执行流程、优劣势，并与TEH、APC注入、Early Bird APC、PoolParty、Module Stomping等技术进行了对比，同时提供了检测、防御和紫队建议。
AI.research_question: WTH（等待线程劫持）技术的工作原理是什么？它相比传统线程劫持技术有哪些优势与局限？如何针对该技术进行检测与防御？
AI.motivation: 传统线程执行劫持（TEH）技术需要调用SuspendThread、SetThreadContext等API来挂起线程和修改上下文，而这些API通常被EDR产品严密监控。因此，需要一种更隐秘的线程操纵技术来规避检测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线程状态劫持、进程注入、栈返回地址篡改、操作系统线程调度机制
AI.method: 技术分析报告，通过分析WTH的底层机制、操作要求、执行工作流，并与多种相关技术（TEH、APC注入、Early Bird APC、PoolParty、Module Stomping）进行对比研究。
AI.findings: WTH通过劫持等待状态线程并修改栈上返回地址来实现代码执行，不需要调用SuspendThread和SetThreadContext等敏感API，从而减少了对EDR产品的检测暴露面。但该技术也有其局限性，并非在所有场景下都适用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了WTH这一新型进程注入技术的完整技术原理和操作框架，丰富了线程操纵和进程注入领域的知识体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为红队提供了新的攻击技术参考，为蓝队提供了基于行为遥测、栈完整性分析、内存取证和威胁狩猎的检测方法，以及缓解策略和紫队演练建议，有助于提升现代端点检测与响应能力。

title: Trustworthy AI in Central Banking: International Practices and Financial Stability Risks
affiliations: School of Finance, Renmin University of China

detail.title: Trustworthy AI in Central Banking: International Practices and Financial Stability Risks
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), and especially recent advances in large language models and foundation models, is becoming relevant to central banking in two distinct ways. It is a tool that can improve macroeconomic analysis, supervisory technology, payment oversight, anti-moneylaundering monitoring, cyber resilience, and financial stability surveillance. It is also a new source of risk that central banks must understand as stewards of monetary and financial stability. This paper reviews emerging international practices in the use of AI by central banks and financial authorities, and connects those practices to the computer science literature on trustworthy AI and AI safety. The central argument is that, for central banks, trustworthiness is not merely a model-level property. It is also a financial stability condition. Model failures, biased decision systems, privacy leakage, prompt injection, data poisoning, third-party concentration, algorithmic herding, and autonomous market responses can become systemic when many financial institutions rely on similar data, similar infrastructures, or similar foundation models. The paper proposes a framework that links trustworthy AI dimensions-robustness, safety, fairness, privacy, explainability, accountability, and human oversight-to core central bank functions. It concludes with a research agenda for central banks focused on model governance, AI-enabled supervision, privacy-preserving data cooperation, stress testing of AI-related shocks, and international coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能（尤其是大语言模型和基础模型）对中央银行的两种影响：作为改进宏观经济分析、监管技术等工具，以及作为需要管理的金融稳定风险源。文章提出可信赖性不仅是模型层面的属性，更是金融稳定条件，并构建了将可信AI维度与央行核心职能相联系的框架。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响中央银行的核心职能？可信赖性在央行语境下具有怎样的双重属性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在金融领域的广泛应用，央行需要系统理解AI的双重角色——既是提升效率的工具，也是可能引发系统性风险的新来源，但现有文献缺乏将可信AI与央行职能相结合的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可信AI框架（鲁棒性、安全性、公平性、隐私、可解释性、问责制和人类监督）+ 金融稳定系统性风险理论
AI.method: 文献综述与国际实践比较分析，连接计算机科学的可信AI/安全文献与央行实践
AI.findings: 模型故障、有偏决策、隐私泄露、提示注入、数据投毒、第三方集中、算法羊群效应及自主市场响应等AI风险，当大量金融机构依赖相似数据、基础设施或基础模型时可能演变为系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"可信赖性也是金融稳定条件"的核心论点，将模型层面的可信AI属性提升至系统性风险分析层面，为央行AI治理提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行提出研究议程：模型治理、AI赋能监管、隐私保护数据合作、AI相关冲击的压力测试以及国际协调。

title: Society 5.0 as an Enabler for Circular City Declarations: A Policy Integration Framework for Japan
affiliations: University of Jaén

detail.title: Society 5.0 as an Enabler for Circular City Declarations: A Policy Integration Framework for Japan
detail.abstract: Japan has emerged as an early and ambitious actor in urban circularity, yet its recent circular city commitments risk remaining declaratory rather than operational. The Universal Circular Cities Declaration proposed to globalize this agenda (Herrador, 2024), and the dedicated declaration designed for Japan on the basis of the European Union's experience (Herrador et al., 2024), both articulate compelling principles while leaving open the central question of implementation: through what institutional and technological infrastructure are such declarations to be enacted at the city scale? This paper argues that Society 5.0-Japan's national vision of a human-centred, data-driven "super-smart" society-supplies precisely the missing operational backbone. Adopting a conceptual, theory-building approach grounded in document analysis of Japanese and European policy texts and structured comparison, the paper develops a four-pillar integration framework linking Society 5.0 to circular city goals: (i) Digital Infrastructure, mobilizing IoT, AI, big data, and digital twins for material-flow monitoring; (ii) Governance Innovation, aligning Society 5.0's cyber-physical coordination with multi-level circular governance; (iii) Stakeholder Engagement, operationalizing the declaration's participatory commitments through human-centric design; and (iv) Metrics and Evaluation, embedding circular-city indicators within data-driven monitoring. The framework is assessed against EU practice and probed for limitations including political will, funding, data privacy, and the digital divide. The analysis offers Japanese national and local governments a concrete pathway from symbolic commitment to measurable circular transition, with transferable relevance for circular-city governance across Asia and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将日本"社会5.0"战略作为循环城市宣言落地的操作骨架，构建了一个整合数字基础设施、治理创新、利益相关者参与和指标评估的四支柱框架，为从象征性承诺走向可衡量的循环转型提供路径。
AI.research_question: 循环城市宣言如何通过具体制度和数字基础设施在城市尺度上实施？
AI.motivation: 日本在循环城市领域行动积极但承诺多停留在宣言层面，缺乏可操作的实施路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会5.0（Society 5.0）——日本以人为中心、数据驱动的"超智能社会"国家愿景；四支柱整合框架。
AI.method: 概念性、理论构建方法，基于日欧政策文本的文献分析及结构化比较。
AI.findings: 提出了连接社会5.0与循环城市目标的四支柱框架：（1）数字基础设施（物联网、AI、大数据、数字孪生）；（2）治理创新（网络物理协调与多层次循环治理）；（3）利益相关者参与（以人为本的设计）；（4）指标与评估（数据驱动的监测）。并对该框架的政治意愿、资金、数据隐私和数字鸿沟等限制因素进行了评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会5.0理论框架与循环城市治理相结合，构建了从抽象愿景到可操作路径的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本国家和地方政府提供从象征性承诺到可衡量循环转型的具体路径，对亚洲及其他地区的循环城市治理具有可迁移的参考价值。

title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Response Time: Evidence from New York City

detail.title: Congestion Pricing and Emergency Medical Response Time: Evidence from New York City

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

keywords: Emergency Medical Service: Difference in Differences

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the effect of New York City's (NYC's) congestion pricing program on emergency medical service (EMS) response times. The program imposes a 24-hour toll on vehicles entering southern Manhattan's congestion relief zone (CRZ) and is intended to reduce traffic congestion while generating revenue. Reduced traffic within the CRZ may enable EMS responders to reach medical incidents more quickly. Using a difference-indifferences identification strategy, I find that EMS response times for incidents occurring within the CRZ decreased by approximately 15 seconds following the introduction of congestion pricing. Heterogeneity analyses show that incidents occurring during the non-peak toll period-primarily nighttime hours-are, on average, 19 seconds faster. These results suggest that overall improvements in response times are driven largely by nighttime conditions, which occur when fewer drivers travel into or through the CRZ for daily activities and necessities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纽约市拥堵收费政策对紧急医疗服务（EMS）响应时间的影响，发现该政策使拥堵缓解区内EMS响应时间平均缩短约15秒，且改善主要由非高峰时段（夜间）驱动（缩短约19秒）。
AI.research_question: 纽约市拥堵收费政策如何影响紧急医疗服务（EMS）的响应时间？
AI.motivation: 拥堵收费政策旨在减少交通拥堵并增加财政收入，但鲜有研究关注其对应急服务响应时间的间接影响。评估这一非预期效应有助于全面理解拥堵收费政策的社会福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交通拥堵与应急响应效率之间的关系：减少交通拥堵可缩短救护车等应急车辆的行车时间，从而改善响应速度。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）进行因果识别，比较政策实施前后拥堵缓解区内外的EMS响应时间差异。
AI.findings: 1）拥堵缓解区内EMS响应时间平均减少约15秒；2）非高峰时段（夜间）的改善更为显著，平均缩短约19秒，表明整体改善主要由夜间驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 为交通政策对公共服务效率的溢出效应提供实证证据，丰富了拥堵收费政策的成本-收益分析框架，揭示了交通状况与应急响应效率之间的因果关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市交通管理部门和应急服务部门提供政策评估依据，说明拥堵收费政策在减少拥堵的同时具有提升应急响应效率的附加收益，尤其在非高峰时段效果更显著。

reference: Gazi Journal of Economics and Business, volume 12, issue 2, 2026[10.30855/gjeb.2026.12.2.014]
title: Sectoral contributions to sustainable development in Türkiye: Which sector is more effective?

detail.title: Sectoral contributions to sustainable development in Türkiye: Which sector is more effective?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Gazi Journal of Economics and Business, volume 12, issue 2, 2026[10.30855/gjeb.2026.12.2.014]

detail.abstract: Enhancing sustainable development performance requires an assessment of the relative roles of economic sectors in this process. However, comparative empirical evidence regarding the sectoral structure of sustainable development is limited, particularly for Türkiye. Therefore, this study examines the long-run relationship between sectoral structure and sustainable development in Türkiye by focusing on agriculture, industry, construction, and services. The empirical analysis uses annual data for the period 2000-2022 and proceeds in three steps. First, the stationarity properties of the variables are examined using ADF, PP, and Zivot-Andrews unit root tests. The Johansen cointegration test is then applied to determine whether a long-run equilibrium relationship exists among the variables. Finally, long-run coefficients are estimated using the DOLS estimator, while the FMOLS estimator is used as a robustness check. The findings show that all sectoral shares are positively associated with the sustainable development index in the long run. Based on the DOLS results, the services sector has the highest coefficient at 0.882, followed by the agriculture, industry, and construction sectors with coefficients of 0.302, 0.265, and 0.193, respectively. The FMOLS robustness check supports the DOLS long-run estimates. The study contributes to the literature by providing comparative sector-level evidence for Türkiye. It also highlights that sustainable development strategies should not rely on a single sector, but should be designed through balanced and sectorspecific policies that account for sectoral differences.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2000-2022年土耳其年度数据，通过单位根检验、Johansen协整检验、DOLS和FMOLS估计，发现农业、工业、建筑业和服务业四个部门的份额与土耳其可持续发展指数均呈长期正相关，其中服务业贡献最大（系数0.882），研究强调可持续发展需采取多部门平衡且差异化的政策。
AI.research_question: 土耳其经济部门结构（农业、工业、建筑业、服务业）与可持续发展之间的长期关系如何？
AI.motivation: 提升可持续发展绩效需要评估经济部门在其中的相对作用，但目前关于部门结构与可持续发展之间关系的比较实证证据有限，特别是针对土耳其的研究匮乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论与部门经济学理论，探讨不同经济部门（农业、工业、建筑业、服务业）对可持续发展的差异化贡献。
AI.method: 使用2000-2022年年度数据，首先通过ADF、PP和Zivot-Andrews单位根检验考察变量平稳性，然后运用Johansen协整检验判断长期均衡关系，最后采用DOLS估计长期系数，并以FMOLS进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 所有部门份额与可持续发展指数在长期均呈正相关。DOLS结果显示，服务业系数最高（0.882），其次为农业（0.302）、工业（0.265）和建筑业（0.193），FMOLS稳健性检验支持了该结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为土耳其提供了比较性的部门层面实证证据，填补了相关文献空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出可持续发展策略不应依赖单一部门，而应设计基于部门差异的平衡且有针对性的政策。

title: From AI Exposure to Training Access: Evidence from U.S. Workforce Boards
affiliations: University of Southern California, Department of Economics

detail.title: From AI Exposure to Training Access: Evidence from U.S. Workforce Boards

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: How do public training systems respond when a new technology changes expected skill demand? I link 2017-2024 administrative records from local boards under the Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act to AI exposure, prior AI-training experience, provider listings, and state funding. After Chat-GPT's launch in 2022, boards serving more AI-exposed workers and with greater prior experience show a 3-percentage-point larger rise in training participation, about 30 additional trainees per 1,000 participants. Training content shifts much less toward AI-related fields. Eligible-provider listings expand, but listed programs do not automatically translate into funded AI training. The access response is larger in state-years with greater formula allotments, and training activity becomes more concentrated in boards with established routines. The findings show that public workforce systems can expand access when resources and delivery experience are in place. Targeted AI retraining, however, depends on whether those systems convert provider availability and fiscal support into funded participation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国公共培训系统在ChatGPT发布后如何响应AI技术对技能需求的变化。结果显示，AI暴露程度高且有前期经验的地区，培训参与率提升约3个百分点（每千人多30人），但培训内容向AI领域的转变有限。培训供给（供应商列表）虽有扩张，但未能自动转化为AI培训的资助参与。资金充裕和政策支持更强的地区响应更积极，培训活动集中在有成熟经验的机构。结论是：公共培训系统能在资源充足时扩大参与，但针对性的AI再培训需要将供应商可用性和财政支持转化为实际资助的培训参与。
AI.research_question: 当新技术改变预期技能需求时，公共培训系统如何响应？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI（如ChatGPT）的快速普及可能颠覆劳动力市场，但公共劳动力培训系统是否能有效帮助工人适应这一技术变革尚不明确，需要实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术变革对技能需求的影响理论、公共政策响应理论、组织学习与惯例理论（established routines影响组织响应能力）。
AI.method: 将2017-2024年美国《劳动力创新与机会法案》（WIOA）下的地方培训委员会行政记录与AI暴露度指标、前期AI培训经验、供应商列表、州级资金数据进行链接，采用差异中的差异（DiD）等准实验方法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: (1) ChatGPT发布后，AI暴露度高且有前期经验的地区的培训参与率提升约3个百分点（每千人多30人）；(2) 培训内容向AI相关领域的转变幅度较小；(3) 合格供应商列表扩大，但未自动转化为资助的AI培训；(4) 资金分配更多的州-年组合中，培训可及性响应更大；(5) 培训活动更集中于拥有成熟惯例（established routines）的委员会。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公共劳动力培训系统对技术冲击响应的微观机制，区分了"培训参与规模"与"培训内容调整"两个不同维度的响应，并识别了组织经验（established routines）和财政资源作为关键调节因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：仅扩大培训供应商列表或增加资金不足以实现针对AI的再培训，需要将供给和财政支持有效转化为实际的资助培训参与；对资源不足或缺乏经验的地区应给予额外支持。

title: Women in leadership
affiliations: , University of Technology Sydney (UTS) and University of Technology, Sydney

detail.title: Women in leadership
detail.abstract: Launching the 2012 Australian Census of Women in Leadership, the Governor General of Australia Quentin Bryce was able to announce a significant increase in the number of women on ASX 200 boards to 12.3 per cent of directorships, up from 8.4 per cent in 2002. Successive earlier Equal Opportunity for Women in the Workplace Agency (EOWA) censuses conducted over the ten years since 2002 had indicated no significant improvement in female board representation. However, now a breakthrough has occurred.

AI.tldr: 该论文关注澳大利亚女性在ASX 200公司董事会中的代表性，指出2012年女性董事占比从2002年的8.4%上升至12.3%，实现了突破性增长。
AI.research_question: 澳大利亚ASX 200公司董事会中女性代表性的变化及其突破性增长的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 过去十年（2002-2012）EOWA普查显示女性董事会代表性未显著改善，而2012年突然出现突破，需要探究这一变化背后的驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别多样性理论、董事会构成理论、制度变革理论
AI.method: 基于澳大利亚EOWA女性领导力普查数据的纵向分析，对比2002年至2012年ASX 200公司女性董事占比变化。
AI.findings: 2012年ASX 200公司女性董事占比达到12.3%，较2002年的8.4%有显著提升，打破了此前十年停滞不前的局面。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了董事会性别多样性变化机制的理论理解，揭示了制度压力与社会变革如何共同推动女性领导力突破。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业及倡导组织提供了关于推动女性董事会代表性的实证依据，强调持续监测与干预的重要性。

AI.tldr: 虽然全球范围内女性在董事会中的参与度有所提升，但在高级管理层的比例变化不大。本文描述了高级管理层中积极变化的证据。
