AI.theoretical_framework: 性别多样性、公司治理、组织行为学相关理论
AI.method: 文献综述、实证数据分析
AI.findings: 女性在董事会参与度上升，但高级管理层比例变化有限；不过也存在一些积极变化的证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了性别多样性与组织层级关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定性别平等政策提供了实证依据，指出了董事会与高管层性别比例差异的问题。

title: Does Deep Arbitrage Stabilize or Destabilize Perpetual Futures Markets?

detail.title: Does Deep Arbitrage Stabilize or Destabilize Perpetual Futures Markets?
detail.abstract: A perpetual futures market can be priced efficiently and still run. This paper integrates two findings that pull in opposite directions: (1) deeper arbitrage capacity stabilizes the funding rate and the underlying bubble, and (2) larger positions raise the hazard of auto-deleveraging, the rule confiscating winning positions to close uncollateralized losses. Embedding a global-games run stage in an entry model of arbitrage capacity yields a solvency ceiling: the market limits its own depth. Equilibrium run risk is hump-shaped in lendable supply, and a single elasticity ratio locates where restraining entry raises welfare. A mutualized buffer levy reconciles depth with safety.

AI.tldr: 永续合约市场存在一个"自限深度"机制：套利容量越深，资金费率越稳定，但大额头寸也越容易触发自动去杠杆（ADL）清算。本文通过全局博弈模型证明，市场存在一个偿付能力上限，最优福利点取决于单一的弹性比率，而共同化的缓冲税可以调和深度与安全性。
AI.research_question: 永续合约市场如何在套利深度（稳定效应）与自动去杠杆风险（不稳定效应）之间实现均衡？市场深度是否存在内生性上限？
AI.motivation: 现有文献分别关注资金费率稳定性和清算风险，但未将两者统一分析。本文发现两者存在内在张力：更深的市场稳定价格但放大清算风险，需要理论整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全局博弈理论（global games）+ 套利容量进入模型（entry model of arbitrage capacity），引入自动去杠杆（ADL）规则作为清算机制。
AI.method: 理论建模：将全局博弈的"挤兑阶段"嵌入套利者进入决策模型，推导均衡条件。
AI.findings: 1. 市场存在自限的偿付能力上限（solvency ceiling）；2. 均衡挤兑风险与可贷供给呈驼峰形（hump-shaped）关系；3. 存在一个单一弹性比率，能定位最优福利点；4. 共同化缓冲基金可调和深度与安全性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将ADL清算机制与套利深度纳入统一框架，揭示了永续合约市场的内生脆弱性（自限深度），拓展了全球博弈在加密金融中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为永续合约交易所提供政策建议：通过征收共同化缓冲税（mutualized buffer levy）可以在不牺牲市场深度的前提下降低系统性清算风险。

title: Household Financial Fragility in India: A Composite Index and a Bayesian Early-Warning LSTM
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology Madras

detail.title: Household Financial Fragility in India: A Composite Index and a Bayesian Early-Warning LSTM
detail.abstract: Household financial fragility-the inability to absorb modest income or expense shocks-is a central determinant of welfare in low-and middle-income economies, yet survey-based measures of it are scarce for Indian households. Using the second wave of the India Human Development Survey (IHDS-II, 2011-12, 𝑁 = 42,152 households), we construct a six-component Financial Fragility Index (FFI) combining debt burden, consumption stress, asset deficit, employment concentration, dependency pressure, and a distress-borrowing flag; components are z-standardised, equally weighted, and quartile-binned into four fragility states. Three classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, isotonic-calibrated LightGBM) predict the binary Fragile/Distressed label from a disjoint non-financial covariate set, with a held-out ROC-AUC of 0.751 / 0.754 / 0.760 respectively and a leave-states-out generalisation AUC of 0.736±0.015. We then extend the cross-sectional baseline into a Bayesian temporal early-warning system (Sect. 4): a macro-anchored monthly trajectory simulator with Poisson-distributed medical, disaster, and crop-failure shocks builds 24-month per-household panels; a two-layer LSTM with Monte-Carlo Dropout forecasts whether the household will cross the high-fragility threshold in the next three months; and a credible-interval decision rule converts the posterior into a Low / Medium / High triage tier. The LSTM attains a 3-month-ahead ROC-AUC of 0.982-beating naive carry-forward, a per-household Kalman filter, and an NGBoost benchmark-and the resulting High tier captures 89% of all stress events at a 97% per-tier purity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度人类发展调查数据构建了六维家庭金融脆弱性指数（FFI），并分别采用逻辑回归、随机森林和LightGBM分类器以及贝叶斯时间预警系统（LSTM）对家庭脆弱性进行跨期预测，其中LSTM在三个月预警中AUC达到0.982。
AI.research_question: 如何构建并预测印度中低收入家庭金融脆弱性？
AI.motivation: 印度家庭金融脆弱性的调查数据稀缺，而该指标对中低收入经济体福利至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融脆弱性指数（FFI）、贝叶斯时间序列预警系统、LSTM深度学习模型
AI.method: 1. 基于IHDS-II数据，构建六维FFI（债务负担、消费压力、资产赤字、就业集中度、依赖压力、困境借款），z标准化等权加总，四分位分箱为四个脆弱状态。2. 采用逻辑回归、随机森林、校准LightGBM三类分类器预测二元脆弱/困境标签。3. 构建贝叶斯月度轨迹模拟器，结合泊松分布冲击，使用双层LSTM+Monte-Carlo Dropout进行三个月前瞻预测，并生成低/中/高三阶分诊。
AI.findings: 非财务协变量基线下ROC-AUC分别为0.751/0.754/0.760，跨州泛化AUC为0.736±0.015。LSTM三个月前瞻AUC达0.982，优于朴素向前推、卡尔曼滤波和NGBoost基线，高阶分诊捕捉89%的压力事件，纯度达97%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了面向中低收入家庭的多维金融脆弱性指数及其预测方法论，将传统静态测量拓展为动态贝叶斯预警系统。
AI.practical_contributions: 可为印度乃至类似中低收入经济体的政策制定者提供家庭金融脆弱性的早期识别与分诊工具，有助于提前干预并降低福利损失。

title: The Callaway-Sant'Anna (CS-DiD) Difference-in-Differences Estimator: A Practical Guide for Young Researchers

detail.title: The Callaway-Sant'Anna (CS-DiD) Difference-in-Differences Estimator: A Practical Guide for Young Researchers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, clinical trials, or sensitive patient data. All econometric evaluations are conducted on fully simulated synthetic panel data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It is entirely self-funded.

detail.abstract: This study addresses a fundamental design decision encountered when applying the group-time difference-indifferences (CS-DiD) estimator developed by Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021)-namely, the choice of matching method used to achieve pre-treatment balance-in a practical format aimed at young researchers. The standard Coarsened Exact Matching (CEM) method used in the literature (Iacus, King, and Porro, 2012) is compared directly against the Tolerance-Based Exact Matching approach proposed in the author's earlier work, using a parallel simulation on a hypothetical-synthetic panel. The comparison is conducted in terms of standardized mean difference (SMD) balance and final treatment effect (ATT) estimates. The findings show that the choice of matching method directly affects the accuracy of the CS-DiD output, and that no single method is superior under all conditions. The data used in this study are entirely synthetic.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了CEM和TBEM两种匹配方法对CS-DiD估计量的影响，发现匹配方法的选择直接影响ATT估计精度，且不存在普遍最优的方法。
AI.research_question: 应用Callaway和Sant'Anna（2021）的组群时间双重差分（CS-DiD）估计量时，匹配方法的选择（CEM vs. TBEM）如何影响预处理平衡性和最终处理效应估计？
AI.motivation: CS-DiD估计量中匹配方法的选择是基础性设计决策，但不同匹配方法的比较研究不足，尤其是针对年轻研究者的实用指导缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: CS-DiD估计量、Coarsened Exact Matching (CEM)、Tolerance-Based Exact Matching (TBEM)、标准化均值差（SMD）平衡性评估。
AI.method: 基于假设-合成面板数据的平行模拟，比较CEM和TBEM两种匹配方法在SMD平衡性和ATT估计方面的表现。
AI.findings: 匹配方法的选择直接影响CS-DiD输出的准确性；不存在单一方法在所有条件下都优越。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了匹配方法选择与CS-DiD估计精度之间的关联，为双重差分方法的方法论选择提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为年轻研究者提供了在不同条件下选择匹配方法的实用指导，强调方法选择的情境依赖性。

title: What Predicts World Cup Success?

detail.title: What Predicts World Cup Success?
detail.abstract: A popular view in sports economics, associated with Kuper and Szymanski's Soccernomics, holds that a country's wealth and population are key drivers of its success in international football: larger populations provide bigger talent pools, and richer countries can better fund youth development. This paper tests that claim using 63 countries that played at least three FIFA World Cup matches across the eight tournaments from 1994 to 2022. A regression of points-per-game on log population and log GDP per capita (2023) explains only 13.5% of the crosscountry variation. Adding a single variable, a country's total number of FIFA World Cup matches played all-time (a proxy for accumulated footballing infrastructure), raises the explained variation to 52.9%, and in a combined model this variable is the only statistically significant predictor (p < 0.001), while population and GDP per capita become indistinguishable from zero. The results suggest that current economic resources matter far less for World Cup performance than a country's accumulated history at this level.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1994-2022年八届世界杯63个参赛国的数据，发现国家财富和人口对足球成功的解释力很弱（仅13.5%），而累积的世界杯参赛场次（作为足球基础设施的代理变量）能解释52.9%的差异，且是唯一显著的预测因子。
AI.research_question: 国家财富（人均GDP）和人口规模是否是国际足球成功的核心驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 检验《足球经济学》中广为流传的观点——财富和人口是足球成功的决定因素，并探索更重要的解释变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体育经济学中的人才池理论（人口规模）与资源投入理论（财富水平）；累积基础设施假说。
AI.method: 基于63个在1994-2022年八届世界杯中至少参赛3场的国家数据，以场均积分为因变量，对人口对数、人均GDP对数及累积世界杯参赛场次进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 人口和人均GDP仅解释13.5%的差异；加入累积世界杯参赛场次后解释力升至52.9%；在联合模型中，唯有累积参赛场次是统计显著的预测因子（p<0.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统体育经济学中"资源决定论"的观点，提出"累积历史/基础设施"假说，即长期的制度性积累比当前经济资源更重要。
AI.practical_contributions: 对各国足球发展政策有启示：长期持续参与高水平赛事、积累赛事经验与基础设施，比单纯依赖经济投入或人口红利更能提升国际竞争力。

title: Credit Lines With(out) Deposits
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Fisher College of Business and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Credit Lines With(out) Deposits
detail.abstract: Classic theories of commitment financing establish a synergy between making credit lines and taking deposits. We empirically document that private credit lenders are increasingly providing commitment financing to their portfolio companies despite not using deposit financing. The utilization rates and maturities of their credit commitments are comparable to those of banks, and borrowers draw upon them in stressful times. We show that private credit lenders provide this liquidity using a combination of credit lines from banks, uncalled capital commitments, fund advisor support, and fund equity inflows. Although credit lines from banks are ultimately deposit-backed, our findings indicate that private credit lenders are able to substitute, at least in part, alternative funding sources for bank deposit-backed financing.

AI.tldr: 本文发现私募信贷机构虽不依赖存款融资，却能通过银行信贷额度、未催缴资本承诺、基金顾问支持和基金权益流入等替代资金来源，为其投资组合公司提供与银行相当的承诺融资服务，部分替代了传统银行基于存款的承诺融资功能。
AI.research_question: 私募信贷机构如何在不使用存款融资的情况下为其投资组合公司提供承诺融资？
AI.motivation: 经典的承诺融资理论认为信贷发放与存款吸收之间存在协同效应，但现实中私募信贷机构越来越多地提供承诺融资却不依赖存款，这一现象挑战了传统理论，需要新的解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 承诺融资理论、金融中介理论、流动性供给理论
AI.method: 实证分析，利用私募信贷市场数据比较私募信贷机构与银行的信贷承诺利用率、期限等特征，并追踪私募信贷机构的流动性资金来源。
AI.findings: （1）私募信贷机构提供的信贷承诺在利用率和期限上与银行相当；（2）借款人在压力时期会提取这些承诺；（3）私募信贷机构通过银行信贷额度、未催缴资本承诺、基金顾问支持和基金权益流入等组合方式提供流动性；（4）尽管银行信贷额度最终仍依赖存款，但私募信贷机构已能部分替代存款融资。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了承诺融资与存款融资必须绑定的传统理论，揭示了私募信贷机构通过多元替代资金来源实现流动性供给的新机制，拓展了对金融中介流动性创造的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解影子银行体系中的流动性风险提供了依据；为私募信贷机构设计融资策略和风险管理提供了参考；为企业和投资者评估私募信贷市场的稳定性和可持续性提供了洞见。

title: A Non-Hegelian Dialectic of Progressive Adequation: Toward a Methodology of Scholarly Framework Development
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: A Non-Hegelian Dialectic of Progressive Adequation: Toward a Methodology of Scholarly Framework Development
detail.abstract: This paper articulates a dialectical method operative in the development of metatheoretical frameworks, distinguishing it from the Hegelian tradition that has dominated philosophical accounts of dialectic in scholarly discourse. The method is characterized by five move-types (clarification, correction, reduction, addition, integration), a dual-track initiation structure (revelatory and confirmatory), a rhythm of alternating accretion and sculpting phases, and a succession of individually open-ended movements that nonetheless converge onto something. The engine of the dialectic is not negation — as in Hegel — but insufficiency and generative inner pressure; tension is one mechanism among several, not the sole driver of movement. The method is multidimensional, iterative, constructive-developmental in orientation, and keeps first-order commitments outside its structure — making it an uncommitted instrument capable of serving many different intellectual projects. Its emancipatory dimension is structural rather than teleological: multidimensionality itself enacts freedom by opening genuine possibility space that uni-dimensional methods foreclose. A genuinely novel feature is the role of AI as an always-on dialectical partner — a structural condition that makes a qualitatively different mode of dialectical practice possible. The method’s relationship to prior traditions is characterized as transcend-and-include: preserving what is genuinely valid in each tradition while going beyond its limitations. Partial resonances are drawn from Socratic maieutics, Peircean inquiry, Gadamerian hermeneutics, Lakatosian methodology, and Basseches’ dialectical thinking — the closest partial predecessor in structural conception. Thirteen structural departures from Hegel are identified. The paper did not emerge through philosophical reasoning but through reflexive examination of actual practice, and the method has no established lineage — a recurring structural feature of work that originates outside established traditions. The paper is itself an instance of the method it describes.

AI.tldr: 本文阐述了一种用于元理论框架发展的辩证法方法，区别于黑格尔传统。该方法包括五种移动类型、双轨启动结构、交替节奏、开放性运动序列，其驱动力不是否定而是不充分性与生成性内在压力。文章还探讨了AI作为辩证伙伴的角色，并指出该方法与苏格拉底助产术、皮尔士探究、伽达默尔解释学等传统呈"超越并包含"关系。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种区别于黑格尔传统的、适用于元理论框架发展的辩证法方法？
AI.motivation: 现有辩证法传统（尤其是黑格尔传统）以否定为核心驱动力，以单一维度为主导，难以充分服务于多样化的元理论建构需求。作者通过反思自身实践，提出一种更开放、多维、非目的论的辩证方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 辩证法方法论（非黑格尔式）：五种移动类型（澄清、修正、还原、添加、整合）、双轨启动（揭示性与确认性）、交替节奏（累积与雕琢）、开放性运动序列。驱动力为"不充分性与生成性内在压力"，而非否定。
AI.method: 反思性审视（reflexive examination of actual practice），而非纯哲学推理。论文本身即是其所描述方法的一次实例化应用。
AI.findings: 该方法具有多维性、迭代性、建构-发展取向；保持一阶承诺在外，作为"非承诺工具"服务于不同知识项目；解放维度是结构性的而非目的论的；AI可作为始终在线的辩证伙伴；与黑格尔传统存在13个结构性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出一种不同于黑格尔传统的全新辩证法模型；将AI纳入辩证方法的"结构性条件"，开辟了 qualitatively different 的辩证实践模式；明确该方法与苏格拉底、皮尔士、伽达默尔、拉卡托斯、Basseches等传统的"超越并包含"关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者提供了一种可服务于多种知识项目的"非承诺性"方法论工具；AI作为辩证伙伴的引入为学术实践提供了新的可能性；多维解放性为突破单一维度方法的局限性提供了路径。

title: Beyond Propensity Scores: A Tolerance-Based Exact Matching Approach to Impact Evaluation

detail.title: Beyond Propensity Scores: A Tolerance-Based Exact Matching Approach to Impact Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses a hypothetical, synthetic dataset constructed for methodological illustration purposes. No human participants or administrative data were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted within the author's official capacity at the Ministry of Industry and Technology of the Republic of Turkey.

detail.abstract: Impact evaluation relies on credible counterfactual construction, and propensity score matching has long served as the default tool for this task. Recent criticism, most notably the "propensity score paradox" identified by King and Nielsen (2019), has questioned whether propensity score matching reliably improves covariate balance relative to simpler alternatives. This paper develops and applies a tolerance-based exact matching approach that departs from coarsened exact matching at one specific point: categorical variables are matched exactly, while numerical variables are matched within fixed tolerance bands (typically five to ten percent) rather than fixed-width bins. The approach is combined with the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) differencein-differences estimator to allow for staggered treatment timing. Using a hypothetical, synthetic dataset constructed to reflect the structure of administrative firm-level data, three matching specifications are compared against propensity score matching. The tolerance-based approach achieves substantially tighter covariate balance (standardized mean differences between 0.00 and 0.08) but retains a smaller matched sample (n=71), while propensity score matching achieves looser balance (0.22-0.28) with a larger sample (n=386). The paper does not claim that one method dominates the other; rather, it argues that the trade-off between balance and sample size should be made explicit and auditable, and that the tolerance-based approach offers a transparent alternative for settings where the propensity score's statistical opacity is a practical concern.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于容差范围的精确匹配方法（Tolerance-Based Exact Matching），以替代传统的倾向得分匹配（PSM）。该方法将分类变量精确匹配、数值变量在固定容差带（5-10%）内匹配，结合Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021)的 staggered DiD 估计量。通过合成数据实验发现，该方法能实现更紧的协变量平衡（标准化均值差0.00-0.08），但样本量较小（n=71）；而PSM平衡较差（0.22-0.28）但样本量更大（n=386）。论文主张平衡性与样本量之间的权衡应当透明且可审计。
AI.research_question: 在反事实构建中，基于容差范围的精确匹配方法相较于倾向得分匹配，在协变量平衡性和样本量之间如何权衡？该方法能否提供一种更透明、可审计的替代方案？
AI.motivation: King & Nielsen (2019)指出的"倾向得分悖论"质疑了PSM在改善协变量平衡方面的可靠性，因此需要开发一种更透明、更易于审计的匹配方法作为替代。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反事实框架与因果推断；倾向得分匹配理论；精确匹配与粗化精确匹配（CEM）；容差匹配法；Staggered DiD（Callaway & Sant'Anna, 2021）
AI.method: 基于合成数据（模拟行政企业层面数据结构）的实验设计；比较三种匹配规格 vs. 倾向得分匹配；使用标准化均值差（SMD）评估协变量平衡性；结合staggered DiD估计量处理交错处理时间。
AI.findings: 容差精确匹配实现了更紧的协变量平衡（SMD 0.00-0.08），但保留样本较小（n=71）；PSM平衡性较松散（SMD 0.22-0.28）但样本量更大（n=386）。两种方法各有优劣，不存在绝对主导关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证回应了"倾向得分悖论"的批评，展示了PSM在平衡性上的局限性。2. 提出了平衡性与样本量之间系统性权衡的分析框架，推动匹配方法选择的理论透明化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实务研究者提供了一种可操作、易审计的替代匹配方法。2. 强调了匹配方法选择中透明度和可审计性的重要性。3. 结合staggered DiD提供了在交错处理时间情境下的实用工具组合。

title: Alternating Swap Rights: How Repeated Exercise Can Reduce Deadweight Loss

detail.title: Alternating Swap Rights: How Repeated Exercise Can Reduce Deadweight Loss
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Alternating Swap Right Option (ASRO), a repeated-exercise extension of the Reciprocal Swap Right Option (RSRO). In the ASRO, exercise does not terminate the contract. Instead, exercise reverses the parties’ positions, transfers the exclusive exercise right to the counterparty, and allows the game to continue until maturity. Although repeated exercise is mechanically feasible, backward-induction verification for horizons up to (T \leq 5) shows that equilibrium exercise is concentrated at the penultimate period and occurs at most once. The mechanism works through a credible deterrence effect: early exercise gives the counterparty the next exercise right, making retaliation possible and rendering early exercise unattractive. Under symmetric binomial dynamics, randomized initial allocation of the exercise right preserves ex ante fairness, while the no-exercise threshold remains identical to that of the RSRO, (c^* = 2(T-1)\sigma). Within the verified horizons, the ASRO strictly reduces exercise probability and deadweight loss relative to the RSRO for all (c < c^*). The results suggest that expanding the exercise opportunity set can tighten equilibrium behavior by making exercise self-deterring. A full proof of exercise concentration for arbitrary finite horizons, together with continuous-time and multi-party extensions, remains open.

AI.tldr: 本文提出交替交换权利期权（ASRO），允许重复行权但博弈均衡显示行权集中在倒数第二期且最多一次。通过可信威慑效应，早期行权赋予对手方报复能力，从而抑制早期行权，减少行权概率和无谓损失。
AI.research_question: 在重复行权可操作的情况下，均衡行权行为何时发生？扩大行权机会集能否抑制早期行权？
AI.motivation: 现有互换权利期权（RSRO）行权即终止合约，ASRO通过允许重复行权，研究能否通过扩大行权机会来改善均衡效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的逆向归纳法、可信威慑效应、期权定价理论
AI.method: 理论建模，通过逆向归纳验证有限期界（T≤5）的均衡，对称二项式动态设定下的均衡分析
AI.findings: (1) 均衡行权集中在倒数第二期且最多一次；(2) 通过可信威慑效应，早期行权会赋予对手后续行权权，使报复可行；(3) 随机初始分配行权权维持事前公平；(4) 不行权阈值与RSRO相同（c^*=2(T-1)σ）；(5) ASRO在c<c^*时严格降低行权概率和无谓损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"可信威慑"机制解释为何扩大行权机会反而使行权行为更集中；将"期权行权"与"博弈中的威慑"相联系，丰富了期权合约设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融合约设计提供新思路：通过引入重复行权和角色互换机制，可以在不改变不行权阈值的前提下有效降低行权概率和交易成本，提升合约效率。

title: The Shadow Value of Attention: Recommendation Ranking with Inventory Dynamics
affiliations: University of California, Davis - Graduate School of Management and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill

detail.title: The Shadow Value of Attention: Recommendation Ranking with Inventory Dynamics
detail.abstract: Recommendation engines and inventory systems are typically optimized separately: the former allocate scarce consumer attention to stimulate demand, while the latter manage the operating costs created by that demand. We study recommendation order as a dynamic exposure-allocation problem for an online retailer selling N substitutable products. Demand depends on product demand potential and recommendation position; the firm earns margins, incurs holding and backlog costs, and replenishes inventory at fixed-plus-linear cost. We formulate the problem as a discounted continuous-time Markov decision process whose state space grows exponentially in N. To obtain a tractable policy, we relax the coupled ranking problem into a multi-mode restless-bandit problem with one-copy-per-position constraints. We show that replenishment has a threshold structure, the relaxed single-product problem admits a partition over inventory states, and the relaxation yields a closed-form index for each product-position-inventory state. The index measures the shadow value of assigning recommendation attention by internalizing demand potential, margin, inventory state, backlog cost, replenishment cost, and the incremental attention created by a higher position. The resulting policy converts an exponentially large dynamic program into a scalable assignment rule. In a four-product benchmark solvable by exact dynamic programming, a bootstrapped index closely tracks the optimum, with an average optimality gap of 3%, while reducing weighted-average cost by 92% relative to demand-only ranking and by 94% relative to myopic control. In large-catalog simulations, the index improves on static demand- and margin-based rankings, reducing discounted cost per item by up to 65.6% under stressed demand.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在线零售商在销售N种可替代产品时，将推荐排序与库存动态联合优化的问题。通过将问题建模为多模式无休止赌博机问题，提出了一个可扩展的闭式索引策略，在4产品基准中将最优性差距控制在3%以内，在大规模模拟中相比基准策略降低高达65.6%的成本。
AI.research_question: 在线零售商如何联合优化推荐排序与库存补货决策，以平衡需求刺激与运营成本？
AI.motivation: 推荐系统和库存系统通常被独立优化，前者分配稀缺的消费者注意力以刺激需求，后者管理由需求产生的运营成本。这种分离优化忽略了二者之间的相互依赖性，可能导致次优决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间马尔可夫决策过程、多模式无休止赌博机问题、闭式索引策略
AI.method: 将耦合的排序问题松弛为带"每位置一拷贝"约束的多模式无休止赌博机问题，推导出每个产品-位置-库存状态的闭式索引，从而将指数级动态规划转化为可扩展的分配规则。
AI.findings: 补货具有阈值结构；松弛后的单产品问题可在库存状态上划分；索引值内化了需求潜力、利润、库存状态、积压成本、补货成本以及更高位置带来的增量注意力。在4产品基准中平均最优性差距为3%，相比纯需求排序降低成本92%，相比短视控制降低成本94%。大规模模拟中，相比静态需求和利润排序，在压力需求下每件产品折现成本降低高达65.6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将推荐排序与库存补货的联合优化建模为可解的多模式无休止赌博机问题，并推导出闭式索引解，为动态曝光分配问题提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展、易实施的分配规则，能够将指数级复杂的联合优化问题转化为实时可行的策略，显著降低运营成本，对大规模在线零售平台具有直接应用价值。

title: The Scale Scissors: A Dynamic Framework for the Firm Scale-Productivity Gap

detail.title: The Scale Scissors: A Dynamic Framework for the Firm Scale-Productivity Gap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not use real administrative or institutional data; the illustrative figures reflect published finding ranges in the literature. No human participants were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted within the author's official capacity at the Ministry of Industry and Technology of the Republic of Turkey.

detail.abstract: This study frames the gap between firm scale and productivity through the concept of a "scale scissors." The gap is not static but a process that opens and closes over time. Three mechanisms are proposed: the threshold effect, the crisis multiplier, and catch-up potential. The conceptual framework unifies scattered findings in the literature into a single model and explains why the scissors hardens into persistent inequality. The study proposes a scale-period-channel-sensitive logic of policy intervention. The framework is conceptual; it makes no causal claim, and empirical testing is left to future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“规模剪刀差”概念，将企业规模与生产率之间的差距视为一个动态打开与闭合的过程，并通过阈值效应、危机乘数和追赶潜力三种机制解释其为何会固化为持久不平等，最后提出规模-时期-渠道敏感的政策干预逻辑。
AI.research_question: 企业规模与生产率之间的差距（规模剪刀差）是如何动态演化并固化为持久不平等的？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对企业规模与生产率之间差距的研究较为分散，缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释这种差距的动态变化及其固化为持久不平等的过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 规模剪刀差概念；阈值效应、危机乘数、追赶潜力三种机制；规模-时期-渠道敏感的政策干预逻辑。
AI.method: 概念性框架研究，未进行实证检验，不作因果推断。
AI.findings: 规模剪刀差是动态过程而非静态现象；三种机制解释了剪刀差如何固化为持久不平等；提出了差异化政策干预逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了文献中关于企业规模与生产率差距的分散发现，提出了统一的概念模型；揭示了差距动态演化并固化的内在机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了规模-时期-渠道敏感的政策干预逻辑，为政策制定者针对不同情况设计差异化干预措施提供了理论指导。

title: Nuclear Deterrence Stability in South Asia: Does Strategic Superiority Matter in the India-Pakistan Rivalry?
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Nuclear Deterrence Stability in South Asia: Does Strategic Superiority Matter in the India-Pakistan Rivalry?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently without any funding, sponsorship, or financial support from any organization, institution, or individual. No personal or financial relationships exist that may have influenced the design, conduct, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or any primary data collection requiring ethical approval. It is a theoretical and empirical analysis based entirely on publicly available secondary sources and published academic literature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This article interrogates whether strategic nuclear superiority-defined beyond assured second-strike capability-translates into geopolitical and crisis-bargaining advantages in the India-Pakistan dyad. Engaging with Matthew Kroenig's Superiority-Brinkmanship Synthesis Theory (SBST), this study argues that the South Asian nuclear context presents a structural anomaly that fundamentally challenges SBST's predictive utility outside the great-power framework in which it was developed. Drawing on five crisis episodes from 1998 to 2025-including the landmark Pahalgam-Operation Sindoor crisis of May 2025and employing comparative case analysis, nuclear posture modeling, and a novel Asymmetric Deterrence Index (ADI), this paper advances three original theses. First, that in geographically compressed, asymmetric nuclear dyads, superiority paradoxically heightens instability. Second, that Pakistan's Full-Spectrum Deterrence (FSD) doctrine collapses the escalation ladder-a phenomenon termed deterrence compression. Third, that the 2025 crisis revealed a nuclear silence pattern not captured by existing theory. The article proposes Contextual Deterrence Theory (CDT) as a revised framework calibrated for asymmetric nuclear dyads.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了战略核优势在不对称核二元体（如印巴）中能转化为地缘政治和危机谈判优势的既有理论，提出"情境威慑理论"（CDT）作为修正框架。
AI.research_question: 战略核优势（超越确保第二次打击能力的定义）是否能在印巴二元体中转化为地缘政治和危机谈判优势？
AI.motivation: Kroenig的"优势-边缘政策综合理论"（SBST）是在大国竞争框架下发展的，其在南亚不对称核环境中的适用性受到质疑。2025年5月印巴Pahalgam-Operation Sindoor危机提供了新的检验案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 优势-边缘政策综合理论（SBST）；全谱威慑（FSD）学说；情境威慑理论（CDT）——本文提出的新理论框架。
AI.method: 比较案例分析（1998-2025年五次危机事件）；核态势建模；新颖的不对称威慑指数（ADI）。
AI.findings: 第一，在地理压缩、不对称的核二元体中，核优势反而加剧不稳定；第二，巴基斯坦的FSD学说"折叠"了升级阶梯，作者称之为"威慑压缩"现象；第三，2025年危机显示出既有理论未能捕捉的"核沉默"模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出情境威慑理论（CDT），作为针对不对称核二元体校准的修正框架；提出"威慑压缩"新概念；识别"核沉默"新模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南亚核稳定政策制定提供理论依据；提示决策者在大国框架之外需要针对不对称二元体制定差异化威慑策略。

title: The Physical Limits of Compute: Dynamic Risk Contagion Networks Between Semiconductor and Energy Infrastructure Assets Under the AI Super Cycle
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Physical Limits of Compute: Dynamic Risk Contagion Networks Between Semiconductor and Energy Infrastructure Assets Under the AI Super Cycle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: As generative AI transitions into large-scale commercialization and hyperscale data center construction, the binding constraint on compute expansion has shifted materially from chip supply to power availability. Using daily return data from January 2023 to June 2026 (N=874), this paper employs a DCC-GARCH(1,1) framework to examine the time-varying co-movement between semiconductor assets (SOXX) and energy infrastructure assets (URA-global uranium/nuclear, and XLU-utilities). The results reveal a pronounced structural regime shift: the dynamic conditional correlation between SOXX and URA averaged just 0.284 during the first eighteen months of the sample, but rose to 0.518 in the post-2024H2 period-a near-doubling that coincides with high-profile announcements of nuclear power restarts and private grid construction by major technology firms. A two-sample t-test confirms this shift is statistically significant (t=3.395, p<0.001). Individual GARCH(1,1)-t estimates document strong volatility persistence across all three assets (α+β≈0.95-1.00), and sub-period analysis shows that the SOXX-XLU correlation also widened from near-zero (0.006) to 0.139 over the same horizon. These findings document an emerging physical-financial nexus: AI mania is crossing the boundary of the virtual economy to generate measurable volatility co-movement in the physical infrastructure of energy supply. The results carry direct implications for cross-asset allocation, factor model construction, and systemic risk monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DCC-GARCH模型研究2023年1月至2026年6月半导体资产（SOXX）与能源基础设施资产（铀/核能URA、公用事业XLU）之间的动态相关性，发现2024年下半年后两者相关性显著增强，表明AI热潮正从虚拟经济向实体能源基础设施传导，形成"物理-金融"新关联。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI大规模商业化背景下，半导体资产与能源基础设施资产之间的时变联动关系如何演化？是否存在结构性断点？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI进入大规模商业化和超大规模数据中心建设阶段，算力扩张的约束已从芯片供应转向电力供应。这一转变可能重塑半导体与能源基础设施之间的金融关联，但现有文献缺乏对这一新兴"物理-金融"联动的实证分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: DCC-GARCH动态条件相关模型；GARCH(1,1)-t波动率模型；两样本t检验。
AI.method: 使用2023年1月至2026年6月日度收益率数据（N=874），采用DCC-GARCH(1,1)框架估计半导体指数（SOXX）与铀/核能指数（URA）及公用事业指数（XLU）之间的动态条件相关性，并进行子样本期间分析和统计显著性检验。
AI.findings: （1）SOXX与URA的动态条件相关性从样本前18个月的0.284跃升至2024年下半年的0.518，近乎翻倍；（2）两样本t检验确认该结构性断点统计显著（t=3.395, p<0.001）；（3）各资产均呈现强波动持续性（α+β≈0.95-1.00）；（4）SOXX-XLU相关性同期从接近零（0.006）扩大至0.139。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示AI热潮从虚拟经济向实体能源基础设施传导的"物理-金融"联动机制，证实了算力扩张瓶颈从芯片到电力的转变已在金融市场中形成可测量的波动率共动模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究发现对跨资产配置、因子模型构建和系统性风险监测具有直接启示，提示投资者和政策制定者关注AI驱动的能源基础设施投资风险与机遇。

title: Cointegration, Spread Dynamics, and GARCH-Type Volatility Modeling: An Empirical Econometrics Framework

detail.title: Cointegration, Spread Dynamics, and GARCH-Type Volatility Modeling: An Empirical Econometrics Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interest or personal relationship that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, patients, personal data collection, or clinical procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified methodological framework for studying cointegration, timevarying hedge ratios, and GARCH-type volatility dynamics in mean-reverting financial spreads. When asset prices are integrated of order one, the identification of cointegrated relationships and the estimation of spread dynamics are sensitive to the choice of testing procedure, volatility proxy, and evaluation criterion. Using Monte Carlo simulations together with an illustrative empirical design based on foreign exchange and equity markets, the paper compares Engle-Granger and Johansen procedures, static and Kalman-filter-based hedge-ratio estimation, and alternative specifications for modeling conditional heteroskedasticity in the spread residual. The results indicate that model rankings are criterion-dependent: statistical loss functions, economic performance measures, and tail-risk criteria can yield materially different preferred specifications. Model confidence set evidence further suggests that, in finite samples, multiple plausible models may remain empirically indistinguishable. The paper contributes to the econometrics of cointegrated financial systems by integrating spread-volatility modeling, criterion sensitivity, and model uncertainty within a common evaluation framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的方法论框架，研究均值回归金融价差中的协整、时变对冲比率和GARCH类波动率动态。通过蒙特卡洛模拟和外汇与股票市场的实证设计，比较了Engle-Granger与Johansen协整检验、静态与卡尔曼滤波对冲比率估计，以及多种条件异方差模型。结果表明，模型排名依赖于评价标准（统计损失、经济绩效、尾部风险），且有限样本中多个候选模型可能难以区分。
AI.research_question: 在均值回归金融价差中，协整检验程序、时变对冲比率估计方法以及GARCH类波动率模型的选取，如何受到评价标准（统计、经济、尾部风险）的影响？在有限样本下，是否存在多个难以区分的竞争模型？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对协整价差建模中的估计方法（如Engle-Granger vs. Johansen、静态 vs. 时变对冲比率）和波动率建模选择缺乏统一的比较框架，且评价标准各异，导致实证结论不一致。本文旨在整合这些维度，系统评估方法选择与评价标准之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整理论（Engle-Granger两步法、Johansen极大似然法）、状态空间模型与卡尔曼滤波（时变对冲比率）、GARCH族模型（条件异方差建模）、模型置信集（Model Confidence Set）方法。
AI.method: 蒙特卡洛模拟（系统比较不同方法的有限样本表现）+ 实证分析（外汇市场和股票市场价差数据），采用多种评价标准（统计损失函数、经济绩效指标、尾部风险标准），并运用模型置信集进行模型比较。
AI.findings: (1) 模型排名高度依赖于评价标准，统计损失、经济绩效和尾部风险指标可能选出不同的最优模型；(2) 模型置信集证据表明，有限样本下多个候选模型可能仍然难以区分；(3) 协整检验程序、对冲比率估计方法和波动率模型之间的交互作用显著影响价差建模效果。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将协整检验、时变对冲比率估计和GARCH波动率建模整合到一个统一的评估框架中；(2) 揭示了评价标准依赖性对模型选择的影响；(3) 通过模型置信集方法刻画了有限样本下的模型不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务中金融价差建模（如外汇和股票市场套利策略）提供了方法选择的实证依据，提醒研究者注意评价标准的选择会显著影响结论，建议在模型比较时采用多标准评估并关注模型不确定性。

title: Regional Productivity Convergence in Turkey: A Provincial-Level Beta Analysis

detail.title: Regional Productivity Convergence in Turkey: A Provincial-Level Beta Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses administrative firm-level data. No human participants were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was conducted within the author's official capacity at the Ministry of Industry and Technology of the Republic of Turkey.

detail.abstract: This study examines the convergence dynamics of provincial-level labor productivity in Turkey over the period 2006-2024. Using 11.92 million firm-year observations drawn from the Entrepreneurship Information System (GBS), a beta convergence regression is estimated across 81 provinces. The findings point to a statistically significant convergence process (β=-0.0384, p<0.0001); the annual convergence rate is calculated at 6.53%, implying a half-life of approximately 10.6 years. This rate is more than three times the roughly 2% annual convergence rate established in the classic work of Barro and Sala-i-Martin (1992) and widely accepted in the literature. The finding indicates that productivity gaps across provinces in Turkey are closing at a relatively rapid pace, though this speed does not imply that regional inequality has been eliminated. The study presents a descriptive convergence analysis and does not claim a causal mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2006-2024年间1192万条企业-年度观测数据，估计土耳其81个省份的劳动生产率β收敛，发现显著收敛过程（β=-0.0384），年收敛速度6.53%，半衰期约10.6年，速度是Barro和Sala-i-Martin（1992）经典结果的3倍以上。
AI.research_question: 土耳其各省份劳动生产率是否存在收敛趋势？收敛速度如何？
AI.motivation: 检验土耳其省级劳动生产率的收敛动态，并将其收敛速度与经典文献中的基准结果进行比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: β收敛理论（Barro & Sala-i-Martin, 1992），即落后经济体或地区以更快的增长速度追赶领先者。
AI.method: 基于土耳其创业信息系统（GBS）1192万条企业-年度观测数据，估计81个省份的β收敛回归模型。
AI.findings: 存在统计显著的收敛过程（β=-0.0384, p<0.0001），年收敛速度6.53%，半衰期约10.6年，速度约为经典文献2%基准的3倍以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家（土耳其）省级层面劳动生产率快速收敛的新证据，拓展了β收敛理论的实证范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土耳其区域经济政策制定提供参考，表明省级间生产率差距正以较快速度缩小，但需注意区域不平等尚未完全消除。

title: Bridging Theory and Action: Managing Cross-Cultural Differences in a Global Project Meeting
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bridging Theory and Action: Managing Cross-Cultural Differences in a Global Project Meeting
detail.abstract: This paper examines the critical role of cross-cultural leadership and cultural intelligence (CQ) in mitigating friction and fostering inclusive collaboration within global project environments. Utilizing Geert Hofstede’s six-dimensional framework of national culture, this study analyzes how distinct variations in key dimensions—specifically Power Distance, Uncertainty Avoidance, and Individualism versus Collectivism—manifest as communication and operational friction among diverse team members, such as those from the United States, India, Japan, and Brazil. By integrating theoretical frameworks from cross-cultural communication with the actionable leadership principles outlined in Kouzes and Posner’s Exemplary Leadership model, this paper explores practical strategies for global managers. The findings highlight the necessity of cultivating cultural intelligence to navigate misalignments in authority, risk tolerance, and team dynamics. Ultimately, this research provides a strategic roadmap for international project managers seeking to transform cultural diversity from a point of friction into a driver of cohesive, high-performing global team collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨跨文化领导力和文化智商（CQ）在减少全球项目团队摩擦、促进包容性协作中的关键作用，并基于Hofstede六维文化框架和Kouzes & Posner卓越领导力模型，为国际项目经理提供将文化多样性转化为团队凝聚力的战略路线图。
AI.research_question: 跨文化领导力与文化智商如何在全球项目环境中减少团队摩擦、促进包容性协作？
AI.motivation: 全球项目环境中文化多样性常导致沟通与运营摩擦，亟需系统性的理论框架与实践策略来帮助管理者将文化差异转化为团队优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: Geert Hofstede的六维国家文化框架（重点聚焦权力距离、不确定性规避、个人主义与集体主义三个维度）；跨文化沟通理论；Kouzes和Posner的卓越领导力模型。
AI.method: 理论整合与案例比较分析（以美国、印度、日本、巴西等不同文化背景的团队成员为例进行跨文化维度对比分析）。
AI.findings: 培养文化智商对于应对权威认知偏差、风险容忍度差异和团队动态失调至关重要；文化多样性可通过有效的跨文化领导策略从摩擦点转化为高绩效全球团队协作的驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Hofstede文化维度理论与Kouzes & Posner卓越领导力模型进行整合，填补了跨文化领导力在具体实践策略层面的理论衔接空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际项目经理提供了可操作的战略路线图，帮助管理者识别并化解因文化维度差异（权力距离、不确定性规避、个人主义/集体主义）引发的团队摩擦，从而提升全球团队的协作效能。

title: Carbon Price Uncertainty and Stock Market Volatility Transmission: A GJR-GARCH-X and DCC Approach with Evidence from China's ETS

detail.title: Carbon Price Uncertainty and Stock Market Volatility Transmission: A GJR-GARCH-X and DCC Approach with Evidence from China's ETS

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines whether carbon price uncertainty transmits to stock market volatility in China's high-emission sectors following the launch of the national Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS) in July 2021. Using 1,072 daily observations on China Carbon Allowance (CEA) prices and Shenwan sector indices for electricity, steel, and cement over the period July 2021-December 2025, we document three findings. First, full-sample GJR-GARCH-X estimates yield statistically insignificant delta coefficients across all three sectors (|delta| ≤ 0.0085, p > 0.30), an informative null consistent with thin ETS trading and Phase 1 restriction to the power sector only. Second, event-window analysis around annual compliance deadlines reveals time-varying transmission: carbon uncertainty significantly amplifies electricity volatility in the 60-day window preceding the 2023 deadline (delta = 0.0448, p = 0.033) and the 60-day window following the 2024 deadline (delta = 0.0981, p = 0.008). Third, Asymmetric Slope CAViaR-X models demonstrate that carbon price uncertainty significantly shifts the extreme left tail of electricity returns (delta = 0.0473, p < 0.001 at the 1% quantile) even in the full sample where conditional mean-variance effects are absent. Our results distinguish between a dormant average variance channel and an active tail-risk channel, with implications for climate stress testing and carbon-aware portfolio risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国全国碳排放权交易体系（ETS）启动后，碳价不确定性是否传导至高排放行业（电力、钢铁、水泥）的股市波动。发现全样本下均值方差效应不显著，但在履约截止日窗口期碳不确定性显著放大电力股波动，且尾部风险渠道显著存在。
AI.research_question: 中国全国碳市场启动后，碳价不确定性是否会传导至高排放行业的股市波动？
AI.motivation: 碳市场作为气候政策工具，其价格波动是否影响金融市场稳定性，尤其是高排放行业的股票风险，对气候压力测试和碳敏感投资组合管理具有重要实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: GJR-GARCH-X模型（条件均值方差）、事件窗口分析（履约截止日）、Asymmetric Slope CAViaR-X模型（极端尾部风险）
AI.method: 使用2021年7月至2025年12月共1,072个日度观测数据，对中国碳配额（CEA）价格与申万行业指数（电力、钢铁、水泥）进行全样本GJR-GARCH-X回归、事件窗口分析以及非对称斜率CAViaR-X尾部风险建模。
AI.findings: （1）全样本下碳不确定性对三行业股市波动的均值条件效应统计不显著；（2）事件窗口分析发现，碳不确定性在2023年履约截止日前60天和2024年截止日后60天显著放大电力股波动；（3）CAViaR-X模型显示，在全样本中碳不确定性对电力股收益的极端左尾（1%分位数）具有显著正向影响，即尾部风险渠道活跃。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"休眠的平均方差渠道"与"活跃的尾部风险渠道"两个传导机制，揭示了碳不确定性对股市的传导存在非对称性——均值层面不显著但极端风险层面显著。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候压力测试提供了碳-金融风险传导的实证依据，建议碳敏感投资组合管理者关注尾部风险而非仅关注平均波动效应，碳市场监管者应关注履约周期对金融市场的冲击。

title: Reverse Fiduciary Risk in Nonprofit Governance: A Position Paper

detail.title: Reverse Fiduciary Risk in Nonprofit Governance: A Position Paper
detail.abstract:
Nonprofit governance theory traditionally assumes a one-directional model of fiduciary vulnerability in which organizations must be protected from the potential misconduct or negligence of their directors. This article challenges that assumption by introducing Reverse Fiduciary Risk, a new concept describing the structural vulnerability of fiduciaries in volunteer-dependent nonprofits. In many small organizations, directors and officers perform essential operational, administrative, and managerial work without compensation, reimbursement, or formal recognition. Their unpaid labour becomes the organization’s de facto workforce, creating a form of structural dependence that inverts the conventional fiduciary relationship.

Drawing on governance theory, volunteerism scholarship, and the doctrine of unjust enrichment, the article demonstrates how this dependence exposes fiduciaries to economic, emotional, and reputational harm. It argues that the presumption of gratuitous intent—long used to dismiss claims arising from volunteer labour—fails to account for situations in which fiduciary contributions are essential rather than discretionary. Through an illustrative case study and doctrinal analysis, the article shows how reverse fiduciary risk shapes board dynamics, fuels internal disputes, and may give rise to restitutionary claims when organizations are enriched at the expense of their fiduciaries.

By naming and theorizing reverse fiduciary risk, the article fills a critical gap in nonprofit governance scholarship and offers a framework for more equitable, transparent, and sustainable organizational practices. It calls for governance reforms that acknowledge the economic value of volunteer labour, protect fiduciaries from structural exploitation, and strengthen the long-term health of the nonprofit sector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"反向受托风险"概念，挑战非营利组织治理中传统的单向受托脆弱性假设，揭示在依赖志愿者的非营利组织中，受托人（董事、高管）因无偿提供关键劳动而面临经济、情感和声誉伤害的结构性脆弱性，并论证了组织不当得利下的返还请求权基础。
AI.research_question: 在志愿者密集型非营利组织中，受托人因无偿提供必要运营劳动而产生的结构性脆弱性如何形成，以及这种"反向受托风险"如何影响治理实践与法律救济？
AI.motivation: 传统非营利治理理论假设组织需要被保护免受受托人（董事）的过失或不当行为侵害，但这一单向视角忽略了在依赖志愿者的组织中，受托人反而因无偿劳动而被组织"剥削"的现实悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、志愿服务学术研究、不当得利原则。
AI.method: 概念建构、示范案例研究、教义学分析。
AI.findings: 1. 反向受托风险使受托人暴露于经济、情感和声誉三重伤害；2. "无偿推定"（gratuitous intent）的传统假设无法解释受托人贡献具有必要性而非任意性的情形；3. 组织因受托人无偿劳动而受益时，可能触发不当得利返还请求权。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次命名并理论化"反向受托风险"概念，填补非营利治理学术的关键空白，挑战并完善了传统的单向受托脆弱性模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁治理改革：承认志愿者劳动的经济价值、保护受托人免受结构性剥削、促进非营利部门更公平、透明和可持续的实践。

title: Can Explainable Artificial Intelligence Restore Applicant Trust? A Research Proposal Examining the Effects of Explainability on Procedural Justice, Organizational Attraction, and Intention to Apply
affiliations: Work Research Institute

detail.title: Can Explainable Artificial Intelligence Restore Applicant Trust? A Research Proposal Examining the Effects of Explainability on Procedural Justice, Organizational Attraction, and Intention to Apply
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being adopted in recruitment and selection processes. Although organizations use AI-enabled hiring systems to improve efficiency and consistency, recent research indicates that applicants often react less favorably to AI-based hiring than to human-based hiring. Prior studies have identified trust and procedural justice as key psychological mechanisms underlying these reactions. However, little research has investigated whether explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) can mitigate applicants' concerns regarding AIenabled hiring decisions. Drawing upon Signaling Theory and Organizational Justice Theory, the present research proposes that explainability enhances trust in AI and procedural justice perceptions, which subsequently improve organizational attraction and intentions to apply. A randomized experimental design comparing human recruiters, AI recruiters without explanations, and explainable AI recruiters is proposed. The study contributes to the growing literature on AI-enabled recruitment by moving beyond documenting negative applicant reactions and examining a theoretically grounded intervention capable of improving applicant perceptions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可解释人工智能（XAI）能否缓解求职者对AI招聘的负面反应，通过信号理论和组织公平理论提出解释性可以增强信任和程序公平感知，进而提升组织吸引力和求职意向，并设计了随机实验进行验证。
AI.research_question: 可解释人工智能（XAI）能否缓解求职者对AI招聘决策的担忧，以及其通过信任和程序公平感知影响组织吸引力和求职意向的心理机制。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在招聘中被广泛采用以提高效率，但研究表明求职者对AI招聘的反应通常不如人类招聘积极。现有研究已识别信任和程序公平是关键心理机制，但鲜有研究探索可解释AI是否能改善求职者的感知。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（Signaling Theory）和组织公平理论（Organizational Justice Theory）。
AI.method: 随机实验设计，比较三种条件：人类招聘者、不提供解释的AI招聘者、可解释AI招聘者。
AI.findings: 提出假设：可解释性能够增强求职者对AI的信任和程序公平感知，进而提升组织吸引力和求职意向。研究尚处于提出阶段，待实验验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信号理论和组织公平理论应用于可解释AI招聘情境，为理解解释性如何影响求职者反应提供理论基础；超越以往仅记录负面反应的视角，探索理论驱动的干预措施。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在招聘中设计和实施可解释AI系统提供指导，帮助改善求职者体验和组织吸引力。

title: The Ossification Frontier for Operational Processes

detail.title: The Ossification Frontier for Operational Processes
detail.abstract: This paper studies the ossification decision in recurring operational processes: once flexible execution is available, which parts should be hardened into standardized process capital, which should remain adaptive, and when should that boundary move? Generative AI makes this problem especially salient with the prevalent use of model-mediated execution, but the framework applies more broadly to dynamic standardization problems beyond AI. We formulate a hidden-state dynamic process-design model in which a manager chooses the width of a standardized backbone, preserves scarce specialist capacity for uncovered and failed cases, and can audit to learn whether expansion to standardization is safe. The model features a latent reliability frontier, stochastic failures, failure-induced rework, convex congestion, redesign frictions, and targeted frontier audits. Several results emerge. First, the relevant expansion criterion is queue-adjusted reliability, not raw predictive accuracy. Second, when failures generate su!ciently costly recovery work, higher workload can induce a retreat to the core: the optimal backbone narrows rather than widens to protect specialist capacity. Third, exception-process design is a first-order complement to standardization: reducing recovery burden can expand the safe scope of standardization without improving predictive performance. Fourth, learning is localized at the boundary and depends on environmental durability: routine operation reveals only what is already standardized, so targeted frontier audits are most valuable when codified gains are su!ciently persistent. Under economically interpretable monotonicity conditions, these forces imply a cuto" width within the ranked design space. A numerical study and an empirical design show how the framework can be implemented with enterprise workflow data.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在反复性运营流程中，哪些部分应被标准化为流程资本、哪些应保持灵活适应、以及边界何时移动的"骨化决策"。结合生成式AI的模型中介执行场景，提出了一个隐藏状态动态流程设计模型，揭示了基于队列调整可靠性的标准化扩张准则、高工作量可能导致标准化倒退、异常流程设计与标准化互补、以及边界学习需要定向审计等关键发现。
AI.research_question: 在反复性运营流程中，当灵活执行成为可能时，哪些部分应被固化为标准化的流程资本，哪些应保持适应性，以及标准化与适应性的边界何时应移动？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的普及使模型中介执行变得普遍，这使"什么应该标准化、什么应该保持灵活"的骨化问题格外突出。现有的动态标准化问题缺乏一个统一的理论框架来指导这一决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 隐藏状态动态流程设计模型，包含潜在可靠性边界、随机失败、失败导致的返工、凸性拥塞、重新设计摩擦和边界审计等要素。
AI.method: 数学模型（隐藏状态动态流程设计模型）+ 数值研究 + 实证设计（使用企业工作流数据）
AI.findings: 1) 标准化扩张的判据是队列调整后的可靠性，而非原始预测准确性；2) 当失败产生足够昂贵的恢复工作时，高工作量会导致标准化退回到核心（骨干变窄而非变宽）；3) 异常流程设计与标准化是互补关系，降低恢复负担可在不提升预测性能的情况下扩大标准化安全范围；4) 学习是局部的且依赖环境持久性，边界审计在标准化收益足够持久时最有价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"队列调整可靠性"这一新的标准化扩张判据，揭示了工作量与标准化深度之间的非单调关系（倒U型），建立了异常流程设计与标准化之间的互补性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业使用AI模型中介执行时提供了标准化决策框架，指导管理者如何根据工作负载、失败成本和环境变化来动态调整标准化边界，可利用现有工作流数据实现。

title: The Unified AI Adoption Model: Bridging Individual and Organizational AI Readiness
affiliations: Virginia Commonwealth University

detail.title: The Unified AI Adoption Model: Bridging Individual and Organizational AI Readiness
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) implementation is often treated as a tool-selection problem, yet research on technology uptake, human-AI interaction, organizational change, and AI risk management suggests that outcomes depend on the relationship among people, workflows, governance, and institutional purpose. This article develops the Unified AI Adoption Model, a dual-level approach that integrates the Personal AI Adoption Framework (PAAF) and the Scalable AI Adoption Framework (SAAF). PAAF guides individuals through seven stages-Familiarize, Learn, Evaluate, Experiment, Protect, Ingrain, and Grow-while SAAF guides organizations through Discover, Fund, Plan, Experiment, Guardrail, Scale, and Govern. The article positions AI uptake as a coordinated learning and governance process rather than a onetime deployment. The analysis draws from technology acceptance theory, diffusion of innovations, AI literacy, cognitive offloading, human-AI collaboration, change management, and current U.S. federal AI guidance. A government-sector scenario involving a state human services agency illustrates how the model can support case-processing assistance while preserving human review, privacy, accessibility, transparency, and public trust. The article concludes with implications for practice and a research agenda for empirically testing AI maturity across individual and organizational levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一AI采纳模型（UAM），包含个人层面的七阶段框架（PAAF）和组织层面的七阶段框架（SAAF），将AI采纳定位为协调的学习与治理过程，而非一次性部署。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个整合个人与组织层面的统一AI采纳模型，以指导AI技术从个人到组织规模化落地的全过程？
AI.motivation: 现有研究常将AI实施视为工具选择问题，忽视了人、工作流程、治理与制度目标之间的复杂关系。需要提供一个系统性的双层面模型来指导AI采纳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受理论、创新扩散理论、AI素养、认知卸载、人机协作、组织变革管理、美国联邦AI治理指南
AI.method: 理论整合与模型构建，结合政府部门的场景案例进行说明
AI.findings: 提出UAM模型：PAAF（个人层面：熟悉→学习→评估→实验→保护→内化→成长）与SAAF（组织层面：发现→资助→规划→实验→护栏→规模化→治理），AI采纳是协调的学习与治理过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了技术采纳、人机交互、组织变革和AI治理等多条理论线索，提出双层面、过程导向的AI采纳理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人和组织提供了分阶段、可操作的AI采纳路线图；通过政府部门案例展示了如何在保障人工审查、隐私、透明度与公众信任的前提下推进AI。

title: Can Blockchain Help Resolve Modern Slavery in Supply Chains?
affiliations: and University of New South Wales (UNSW) - UNSW Law & Justice

detail.title: Can Blockchain Help Resolve Modern Slavery in Supply Chains?
detail.abstract: While blockchain was designed as a ledger for cryptocurrency transactions, it can record transactions of anything of value. Blockchain is increasingly used to prove the integrity of commodities, tracing their supply chain journey from the source to the end user. Yet, transferring this technology from a cryptocurrency context to a supply chain setting is not without difficulties. This article explores the implications for multinational and transnational companies in using blockchain as a means to address modern slavery. The research identifies five challenges: verification, inclusion, trust, privacy, and normativity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将区块链技术从加密货币背景应用于供应链管理以解决现代奴隶制问题时所面临的五大挑战：验证、包容性、信任、隐私和规范性。
AI.research_question: 跨国公司利用区块链技术解决现代奴隶制问题面临哪些挑战和影响？
AI.motivation: 区块链被越来越多地用于追踪商品供应链以证明其完整性，但从加密货币环境转移到供应链环境并非易事，需要深入研究其实际应用中的障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区块链技术理论、供应链管理理论、现代奴隶制治理理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论探讨（基于文献和案例的定性分析）
AI.findings: 识别出五大挑战：验证（如何确保上链数据的真实性）、包容性（供应链各方参与能力不平等）、信任（去中心化系统与现实信任机制的矛盾）、隐私（数据公开与商业机密保护的冲突）、规范性（缺乏统一的法规标准）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区块链技术应用研究从加密货币领域拓展到供应链人权治理领域，提出系统性的挑战分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司在供应链中应用区块链技术解决现代奴隶制问题提供了风险预警和实施指导，帮助企业认识技术转移的关键障碍。

title: War Lingering Beyond Ripeness: A Receiver-Provider Theory of Conflict Persistence Poison for the Fighters, Meat for the Suppliers
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: War Lingering Beyond Ripeness: A Receiver-Provider Theory of Conflict Persistence Poison for the Fighters, Meat for the Suppliers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, institutional affiliations, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical and conceptual contribution. It does not involve human participants, human subjects, personal data, animal subjects, interviews, surveys, experiments, or case-study participants requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently conceived, developed, written, and submitted by the author.

detail.abstract:
Conventional accounts of military technology suggest that advances in precision weapons, real-time intelligence, and modern logistics should compress the duration of armed conflicts by enabling rapid and decisive outcomes. Yet a number of contemporary conflicts have proven remarkably persistent. This paper proposes a theoretical framework, the Bohra Asymmetric Utility Model (BAUM) v1.5, as one possible explanation for this puzzle.

The central proposition is that a conflict may become increasingly costly, and even irrational, for those directly engaged in fighting it while remaining beneficial for actors that supply the inputs sustaining it. BAUM formalizes this possibility through a distinction between Receivers—direct conflict participants who bear the costs of continued warfare—and Providers—actors whose welfare may be positively associated with the continuation of supply relationships linked to the conflict. The framework introduces the concepts of the Poison–Meat Divergence and the No Coordination Assumption, under which conflict persistence may emerge from the aggregation of individually rational incentive structures without requiring coordination, collusion, or conspiracy among Providers.

The paper situates the Receiver–Provider distinction in relation to existing ripeness and spoiler theories and develops a formal conceptual model describing divergent utility trajectories between Receivers and Providers over time. The framework is presented as a theoretical contribution intended to generate testable hypotheses for future research rather than as an empirical explanation of any particular conflict. The paper argues that the Receiver–Provider distinction may offer a useful analytical lens for examining why some conflicts appear to persist beyond points at which they have become increasingly costly for the parties directly engaged in fighting them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bohra非对称效用模型（BAUM v1.5），通过区分"接收者"（直接参战方）和"提供者"（维持冲突的供应方）来解释为何许多现代冲突在技术上应更快结束却持续拖延——当战争对直接参战方变得昂贵甚至非理性时，对供应方仍可能有利可图。
AI.research_question: 为什么在精确武器、实时情报和现代后勤能够实现快速决定性结果的背景下，许多当代冲突仍然异常持久？
AI.motivation: 传统军事技术理论预测战争时间应被压缩，但现实中有大量冲突持续存在，这一矛盾缺乏令人满意的理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: BAUM v1.5模型；接收者（Receiver）与提供者（Provider）区分；毒肉分歧（Poison–Meat Divergence）；无协调假设（No Coordination Assumption）；成熟理论（Ripeness Theory）与破坏者理论（Spoiler Theory）的关联。
AI.method: 理论建构与形式化概念建模，提出可检验的假设，而非对特定冲突的经验验证。
AI.findings: 冲突可能对直接参战的接收方越来越昂贵甚至非理性，但对提供物资支持冲突的提供方仍然有益；这种效用分歧无需提供方之间的共谋或协调，仅凭个体理性激励的加总即可导致冲突持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了接收者-提供者这一新的分析区分，为理解冲突持续性问题提供了超越传统成熟/破坏者理论的补充性理论视角；形式化了"毒肉分歧"和"无协调假设"等新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和冲突分析者提供了一种识别冲突中不同利益相关者效用分歧的分析框架，有助于理解为何某些冲突难以通过针对直接参战方的传统干预手段解决。

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了消费者保护法中信息标签（如清真标签、劣质商品标签、必需品标签和奢侈品标签）对消费者权益保护的重要性，并以某公寓拖欠费用纠纷的非诉讼和解案例为切入点，分析了双方通过谈判重新协商权利义务、达成互利和解的过程。
AI.research_question: 消费者保护法如何在公寓拖欠费用的非诉讼和解中发挥作用？信息标签（质量标签）如何影响消费者保护？
AI.motivation: 消费者是经济活动的核心，但消费者与生产者之间存在信息不对称，需要法律强制力保障消费者权益，尤其是在全球化时代下信任机制的建立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者保护法（特别是关于商品/服务质量标签的规定）、机会理论（producers see opportunities to achieve mutual benefits）、互惠原则（principle of reciprocity）
AI.method: 案例分析法：以“Mrs. MP与PT. X（PT. Y的子公司）之间的公寓拖欠费用非诉讼和解”为具体案例，分析消费者保护法在庭外和解中的应用。
AI.findings: 通过谈判，争议双方可以重新审视权利义务，在互惠原则的基础上通过书面协议达成互利和解；信息标签（如Halal标签、劣质商品标签等）是消费者保护的重要手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 将消费者保护法与信息标签制度相结合，丰富了消费者权益保护的理论视角；强调机会理论与互惠原则在非诉讼纠纷解决中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公寓开发商和消费者之间的拖欠费用纠纷提供了非诉讼和解的实践路径；建议生产者/服务提供者应依法标注商品质量信息，以促进公平交易和消费者信任。

title: Digital Sovereignty, Somebody Else's Problem? Politicized Dependency and the Operational Limits of Public-Sector Autonomy
affiliations: and

detail.title: Digital Sovereignty, Somebody Else's Problem? Politicized Dependency and the Operational Limits of Public-Sector Autonomy
detail.abstract: Politicized dependency pre-existing digital dependencies are reclassified as risks to public autonomy, control and continuity Ownership displacement no single actor owns the full translation from political sovereignty concern to executable digital choice Responsibility downstream continuity, implementation, risk mitigation, residual dependence Control distributed elsewhere mandate, budget, risk acceptance, interpretive clarity, alternatives Asymmetric accountability public organizations remain responsible for outcomes without equivalent control over conditions mismatch between responsibility and control Note. The figure summarizes the central mechanism of the study. Digital sovereignty politicizes pre-existing digital dependencies by redefining them as risks to public autonomy, control and continuity. This produces ownership displacement because no single actor controls the full translation from political concern to executable organizational choice. Public organizations remain responsible for continuity and implementation, while mandate, budget, risk acceptance, interpretive clarity and workable alternatives remain distributed elsewhere. The resulting mismatch is asymmetric accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了数字主权如何将既有的数字依赖重新界定为对公共自主权、控制权和持续性的风险，导致所有权错位（没有任何单一行为体掌控从政治关切到可执行数字选择的完整转化），从而产生责任与控制权不匹配的非对称问责困境。
AI.research_question: 数字主权如何通过重新界定数字依赖，导致公共组织面临责任与控制权不匹配的非对称问责困境？
AI.motivation: 随着数字主权成为各国政府的核心政治关切，公共组织在推动数字化转型时面临日益复杂的依赖关系，但现有研究对由此产生的问责困境关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治化的依赖关系、所有权错位、非对称问责
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论构建
AI.findings: 数字主权将已有的数字依赖政治化，重新定义为风险；所有权发生错位，没有单一主体能控制从政治关切到可执行选择的完整链条；公共组织负责连续性实施，但授权、预算、风险接受、解释清晰度和替代方案等关键要素分散在其他主体手中，形成非对称问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"非对称问责"概念，揭示了数字主权政策实施中责任与控制权分离的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注数字主权实施过程中公共组织面临的权责不匹配问题，需在设计阶段明确控制权分配与问责机制。

title: Intent-Aligned Evaluation of Clinical Predictive Models: A Phase-Based Methodological Framework
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Intent-Aligned Evaluation of Clinical Predictive Models: A Phase-Based Methodological Framework
detail.abstract: ObjectivePredictive models in healthcare fail to transition from development into clinical practice impact iwhen their development and evaluation misalign with the model’s intended clinical purpose. A screening model, for example, may be inappropriately evaluated using criteria suited to a treatment recommendation system, given that precision requirements differ. We provide a solution to this misalignment with a methodological framework that aligns evaluation criteria with a predictive model’s declared clinical intent, defined as the clinical purpose and use context of the model, specified at study inception.MethodsWe developed the framework in a phased approach of (1) targeted literature review of reporting guidelines, staged-evaluation frameworks, and implementation science models for predictive models in healthcare; (2) iterative refinement through co-author input from clinical, methodological, and implementation perspectives; and (3) retrospective simulated application of the framework to four predictive models drawn from prior clinical research, comparing standard practice with framework-informed steps.ResultsThe framework specifies five lifecycle phases of a predictive model for clinical application (proof of concept, design and preliminary testing, performance and safety testing, large-scale evaluation, and post-deployment monitoring) and four types of intent (real-time decision support, screening, clinical research, and translation). It includes explicit re-entry rules for retrained or repurposed models, and integrated assessment of prediction heterogeneity, human-AI interaction effects, and system entanglement at specific phases. A four-step operational procedure (intent declaration, phase assignment, selection of phase- and intent-appropriate criteria, and documentation of advancement decisions) supports application during model development. Retrospective application to different predictive models illustrates that the framework produces different implications for action across intent categories and lifecycle stages than a standard non-specific approach would yield.ConclusionThe framework offers a structured methodology for aligning predictive-model evaluation with declared clinical intent, complementing existing frameworks and consensus principles for trustworthy healthcare AI. Prospective application of the framework by independent teams can assess its usability, inter-rater consistency in intent and phase assignment, and effects on downstream evaluation decisions so that the framework can be employed broadly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个方法论框架，用于将预测模型的评估标准与其声明的临床意图（临床目的和使用情境）对齐，通过五个生命周期阶段和四种意图类型，帮助解决医疗AI模型从开发到临床实践的转化失败问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过方法论框架将医疗预测模型的评估与其声明的临床意图对齐，以促进模型从开发成功过渡到临床实践？
AI.motivation: 医疗预测模型在从开发转向临床实践时常常失败，根本原因在于模型的开发和评估与其预期的临床目的不匹配。例如，筛查模型被不适当地用适合治疗推荐系统的标准来评估。这种错位导致了许多有前景的模型无法真正落地。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架包含五个生命周期阶段（概念验证、设计与初步测试、性能与安全测试、大规模评估、部署后监测）和四种意图类型（实时决策支持、筛查、临床研究、转化），并设有明确的重新进入规则、预测异质性评估、人机交互效应和系统纠缠分析。
AI.method: 分阶段开发：(1) 针对医疗预测模型的报告指南、分阶段评估框架和实施科学模型进行靶向文献综述；(2) 通过合著者从临床、方法论和实施视角进行迭代完善；(3) 对四个来自先前临床研究的预测模型进行回顾性模拟应用，比较标准实践与框架指导步骤的差异。
AI.findings: 框架指定了五阶段和四意图类型，包含明确的重新进入规则，以及预测异质性、人机交互效应和系统纠缠的综合评估。四步操作程序（意图声明、阶段分配、选择阶段与意图适配的标准、记录进展决策）支持开发过程中的应用。回顾性应用表明，该框架比标准非特异性方法在不同意图和生命周期阶段产生了不同的行动含义。
AI.theory_contributions: 为医疗AI预测模型的评估提供了结构化的阶段-意图对齐方法论，补充了现有的报告指南和可信赖AI共识原则，明确了评估标准应根据模型的临床意图和生命周期阶段动态调整。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的四步骤流程，帮助研究人员和临床开发者从模型开发初期就明确声明临床意图，选择适当的评估标准，并做出是否推进的决策，从而降低模型从开发到临床应用的转化失败率。

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 71
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In Europe, how and when a given security and the relevant rights incorporated into it come into existence is mostly left to national law. The creation of debt securities generally implies a contractual relationship between the issuer and the securities holder. As such, all the contractual elements required under the relevant legal system (in particular the necessary presence of a counterparty and the payment of a subscription price) must be in place for the debt securities to exist.  In some instances, issuers may want to retain their own debt securities from the outset  in their treasury, for example to use these securities as collateral to obtain central bank liquidity. Legally, unless there are explicit exemptions or specific regimes, retaining debt securities at issuance generally requires going through an issuance and repurchase process, and results in an issuance settled with a counterparty to bring to existence the debt securities, followed by an immediate repurchase by the issuer from that counterparty. Recent legislative developments in Luxembourg provide an alternative issuance path for the European Stability Mechanism and the European Commission.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧洲债务证券发行中，发行人如何在保留自身债务证券（如用于央行流动性抵押）时绕开传统的"发行-回购"流程。卢森堡最近的立法为欧洲稳定机制（ESM）和欧盟委员会提供了替代性发行路径。
AI.research_question: 在欧洲法律框架下，债务证券发行人如何在发行时直接保留自身证券，而不需要经过先向对手方发行再立即回购的流程？
AI.motivation: 发行人（如ESM和欧盟委员会）希望将自身发行的债务证券保留在库房中作为抵押品以获得央行流动性，但传统法律路径要求必须存在对手方并完成认购付款，导致繁琐的发行-回购流程。需要探索更高效的替代路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲债务证券发行的合同法基础（契约关系、对手方要求、认购价款支付）；卢森堡新立法的制度创新。
AI.method: 法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis），比较法视角，案例研究（卢森堡立法改革）。
AI.findings: 传统上发行人自留债务证券需经过"发行给对手方-立即回购"的两步流程；卢森堡新立法为ESM和欧盟委员会提供了免除这一繁琐流程的替代发行路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了债务证券创设中合同法要素（对手方存在、认购价款支付）对发行人自留证券行为的法律约束，以及立法如何在制度层面突破这一约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲债务证券发行人（特别是国际组织和超国家机构）提供了简化自留证券发行的法律方案，降低了交易成本和操作复杂性。

title: Estranged Prudence: Operational Proxies and the Abstraction of Fiduciary Judgment

detail.title: Estranged Prudence: Operational Proxies and the Abstraction of Fiduciary Judgment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
This Essay examines how late-twentieth-century fiduciary practice at institutional-investor scale did not alter the governing doctrine of prudence but changed what became visible as proof of prudence. Prudence remains a doctrine of fiduciary judgment exercised with loyalty, for the exclusive benefit of beneficiaries, under circumstances then prevailing. Yet institutional fiduciary practice increasingly demonstrates compliance through operational proxies — including diversification, benchmarking, consultant review, delegation, and portfolio theory — that may be relevant evidence of prudence without being substitutes for fiduciary judgment itself.

Using trust-law prudence as a baseline and the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) as a contemporary application, the Essay examines whether operational demonstrations of compliance continue to make beneficiary-oriented fiduciary judgment visible or instead function as practical substitutes for it. The Essay argues that fiduciary doctrine remains formally intact, but that institutional demonstrations of prudence increasingly rely upon administrable proxies whose relationship to fiduciary judgment is indirect, assumed, or difficult to observe.

The resulting concern is not doctrinal change but doctrinal visibility. If prudence remains a conduct standard, the conduct required by prudence must remain capable of being observed, evaluated, and enforced.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了晚期二十世纪机构投资者规模的受托实践并未改变审慎义务的法律原则，但改变了什么能被视为审慎的证据。尽管审慎仍是受托人判断的准则，但机构实践越来越依赖多元化、基准测试、顾问审查、委托和投资组合理论等操作性指标来证明合规性，这些指标可能只是审慎的相关证据，不能替代受托人判断本身。
AI.research_question: 在机构投资者规模下，操作性合规指标（如多元化、基准测试等）是否仍然能够使以受益人利益为导向的受托人判断可见，还是实际上充当了其替代品？
AI.motivation: 晚近机构投资者的受托实践虽然表面上维持了审慎义务的法律教义，但合规证明方式发生了转变。这种转变可能导致审慎义务作为行为标准的可观察性、可评估性和可执行性受到侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信托法中的审慎义务（prudence doctrine）、《雇员退休收入保障法》（ERISA）、受托人判断（fiduciary judgment）理论
AI.method: 法律教义分析与案例研究相结合，以信托法中的审慎义务为基线，以ERISA为当代适用场景进行规范性分析。
AI.findings: 审慎义务的教义形式上保持完整，但机构层面证明审慎的方式越来越依赖操作性指标（如多元化、基准测试、顾问审查、委托和投资组合理论），这些指标与受托人判断之间的关系是间接的、假设的或难以观察的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"教义可见性"（doctrinal visibility）这一概念，区分了教义的形式完整性与教义在实践中是否可观察、可评估和可执行之间的张力。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示法律实践者和监管者：操作性合规指标不能替代受托人判断本身，需要关注审慎义务在机构实践中的可观察性和可执行性问题。

title: Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS), Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Decision Risk and Operations, Peking University and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - School of Engineering

detail.title: Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving

publicationDetails.detailsText: Sauder School of Business Working Paper Forthcoming

detail.abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving, each request accumulates persistent graphics processing unit (GPU) memory during service as its key-value cache grows with every generated token. Under high concurrency, aggregate memory usage therefore increases endogenously over time: the service process itself creates future capacity pressure. When memory capacity is exceeded, systems evict active requests, discarding cached state and restarting them later, which wastes computation and reduces throughput. We develop a discrete-time dynamical model of memory-constrained LLM inference that captures admission, memory growth, and eviction under continuous batching. In the saturated-input regime, the system admits both eviction-free fixed points and limit cycles with evictions. For homogeneous workloads, we show that the eviction-free equilibrium is unstable and that, except for a Lebesgue-measure-zero exact-capture set, the system converges to a unique worst-case limit cycle that is asymptotically stable outside this exceptional set, with throughput losses as large as 50%. For heterogeneous workloads, we prove a stability criterion in the two-class common-input setting and explain how the survival-polynomial mechanism generalizes to multiple classes and heterogeneous-input lengths. Under an input-dominated scaling regime, coprime decoding lengths stabilize the eviction-free equilibrium, while non-coprime lengths create synchronized modes that drive instability. These results characterize when workload heterogeneity desynchronizes completions and helps stabilize memory-constrained serving. More broadly, we identify service-induced congestion as a structural instability mechanism and derive scheduling design principles for sustaining high throughput.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了内存受限的LLM推理离散时间动力学模型，分析了连续批处理下的请求接纳、KV缓存增长与驱逐机制。研究发现：同质负载下无驱逐均衡点不稳定，系统几乎必然收敛到最坏情况的极限环，吞吐损失高达50%；异质负载下，互质的解码长度可稳定系统，非互质长度则引发同步不稳定性。
AI.research_question: 在LLM服务中，KV缓存导致的内存压力如何从服务过程本身内生地产生容量约束？这种服务引发的拥塞（service-induced congestion）的动力学机制是什么？如何设计调度策略以在高吞吐下维持稳定？
AI.motivation: LLM推理中每个请求的KV缓存随生成token增长，高并发下聚合内存使用随时间内生增长，导致内存超限后驱逐请求、丢弃缓存并重新开始，浪费算力并降低吞吐。现有研究缺乏对这一自激式内存压力动态系统的理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散时间动力学系统理论（固定点与极限环分析）、Lebesgue测度理论、多项式动力系统稳定性分析、排队论中的连续批处理模型。
AI.method: 构建离散时间动力学模型形式化描述请求接纳、内存增长与驱逐的闭环过程；通过不动点分析和稳定性理论推导系统演化行为；利用数论（互质/非互质解码长度）分析调度策略对稳定性的影响。
AI.findings: (1) 同质负载下无驱逐均衡点不稳定，系统几乎必然收敛到唯一的最坏情况极限环，吞吐损失达50%；(2) 异质负载双类场景下给出稳定性判据；(3) 互质解码长度稳定无驱逐均衡，非互质长度引发同步不稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将LLM推理中的内存拥塞问题建模为动力学系统，识别出"服务引发的拥塞"（service-induced congestion）这一结构性失稳机制，证明了内存压力内生的自激振荡特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出调度设计原则：通过设计互质的解码长度来打破同步模式，稳定内存受限下的LLM推理服务，维持高吞吐。
